title: Manager, Investigations
description: Manager, Investigations J. Wray & Nephew Kingston and St. Andrew Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 25/09/2026 Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save This position is responsible for leading timely, objective and well-documented investigations into loss events, theft, fraud, misconduct, security breaches, procedural breaches, illicit/counterfeit rum matters and other incidents that affect JWN people, assets, brands, products and profitability. General Description of the Role The Manager, Investigations is responsible for leading timely, objective and well-documented investigations into loss events, theft, fraud, misconduct, security breaches, procedural breaches, illicit/counterfeit rum matters and other incidents that affect JWN people, assets, brands, products and profitability. The role identifies root causes, supports corrective actions and strengthens controls to prevent recurrence. Operating Context J. Wray & Nephew operates a vertically integrated, multi-site manufacturing, warehousing, distribution and commercial environment. The security and loss prevention function must protect people, products, brands, physical assets, regulatory certifications and business continuity across Kingston, New Yarmouth, Appleton, JSAERE and off-premises warehouses, while partnering with Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Legal, Commercial, Quality, EHS, external security providers and law enforcement. Mission - Objectives To protect JWN by investigating, resolving and preventing loss-related incidents, security breaches, procedural failures and illicit brand activity through fact-based investigations, strong evidence handling, effective law-enforcement partnerships and actionable root-cause recommendations. Performance Indicators - Criteria Investigations are completed objectively, confidentially, professionally and within agreed response and closure timelines. Incident reports, evidence files, root-cause findings and corrective action recommendations are complete, accurate and auditable. Theft, procedure breach, fraud, counterfeit and illicit rum matters are escalated and actioned with appropriate internal and external partners. Investigation learnings are translated into improved controls, training, communication and policy enforcement. Stakeholders receive timely, factual updates while confidentiality, due process and evidence integrity are preserved. Key Roles and Responsibilities Investigations and Incident Management Lead investigations into theft, fraud, misconduct, procedural breaches, security breaches, loss events, inventory discrepancies, brand protection matters and other incidents. Develop investigation plans, conduct interviews, review CCTV/access control/vehicle tracking records, gather evidence and prepare factual investigation reports. Identify root causes, control gaps and accountability considerations, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Maintain a secure case management system, investigation log, evidence records and closure tracker. Coordinate with HR, Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, Quality, Supply Chain and site leaders depending on the nature of the matter. Brand Protection and Illicit Trade Response Lead and coordinate activities related to illicit/counterfeit rum trade, including intelligence gathering, product purchase/testing coordination and field visits to bars, wholesale outlets, supermarkets, events and other relevant locations. Partner with Counter Terrorism and Organized Crime, Customs, Excise, Tax Administration, Police and other agencies to investigate and disrupt illicit product activity. Perform training and awareness sessions to empower authorities to identify and prosecute illicit trade activities. Support collection, transport and documentation of samples in partnership with Quality and government forensic/lab stakeholders. Prepare reports and intelligence briefings for internal leadership and external authorities while preserving confidentiality and evidence integrity. Compliance, Audits and Control Testing Conduct audits and spot checks to validate the effectiveness of loss prevention measures, security procedures, AEO requirements, Food Defense controls, seal controls and key/access controls. Support supplier/site risk assessments, internal AEO audits, Food Defense activities, contractor orientations and regulatory compliance monitoring. Review incident patterns and exception reports to identify recurring vulnerabilities, weak controls or emerging threats. Track corrective actions to closure and periodically validate sustainability of improvements. Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting Develop effective relationships with law enforcement, regulatory agencies, professional bodies and private sector counterparts. Prepare monthly investigation dashboards, incident trend analyses, loss summaries and recommendations for the Manager, Security, Investigations, and Risk Management. Provide investigation awareness training and guidance to employees, contractors and managers on reporting, evidence preservation and procedural compliance. Support company sponsored events by identifying investigation or intelligence risks and advising on preventive actions where needed. Support to Risk Management Collaborate with the Manager, Security to ensure immediate physical security findings are addressed and evidence is preserved. Support policy updates, SOP improvements and training materials based on investigation findings and loss trends. Authority Open, coordinate and close investigations in accordance with approved protocols and escalation criteria. Request relevant records, footage, logs, documentation and statements required for investigations, subject to company policy and legal guidance. Escalate serious findings, suspected misconduct, significant losses and legal/regulatory matters to the Manager, Security, Investigations, and Risk Management. Recommend disciplinary, control, policy, training or supplier/contractor action based on factual findings and stakeholder review to the relevant HR partner. Key Relationships Internal : Manager, Security, Investigations, and Risk Management; Manager, Security; Human Resources; Legal; Internal Audit; Finance and Procurement; Quality and Technical teams; Supply Chain, Production, Warehousing, Logistics and Commercial teams External : Police, SIB, Customs, Excise and Tax Administration; Government forensic laboratories and related state agencies; Security contractors and investigators; Distributors, suppliers and trade contacts; Professional bodies such as ASIS International Experience Required 5-7 years of experience in investigations, corporate security, loss prevention, law enforcement, audit, anti-fraud, military or related field. Experience conducting interviews, preparing investigation reports, handling sensitive evidence and working with law enforcement or regulatory bodies. Experience with manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, counterfeit/illicit trade, brand protection or regulated environments is preferred. Education / Professional Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Studies, Security Management, Criminal Justice or related discipline is preferred. Professional certification such as PCI, CFE, CPP, PSP or equivalent investigation/security qualification is preferred. Training in interviewing, investigation report writing, evidence handling, chain of custody, root-cause analysis and QHSE/Food Defense requirements is an asset. Competencies Technical Investigation principles, interviewing, statement taking and evidence handling Case management, incident trend analysis and root-cause analysis CCTV, access control, vehicle tracking and digital record review AEO, Food Defense, seal/key controls, supplier risk assessments and audit practices Microsoft Office, data analysis and report preparation Professional / Functional Confidentiality, integrity, objectivity and sound judgement Clear written and verbal communication Analytical thinking and problem solving Relationship building with internal stakeholders and agencies Ability to manage sensitive matters under pressure Managerial Coordinating multi-party investigations Influencing corrective action without direct authority Prioritizing investigations based on risk and business impact Performance orientation and continuous improvement Compliance and control mindset Working Conditions May be required to visit trade locations, warehouses, plants, distilleries, farms, sponsored events, bars, wholesalers and supermarkets for investigation or intelligence purposes. May be exposed to hostile or sensitive situations, heat, noise, dust, debris, hazardous chemicals or areas requiring PPE. Will require work outside normal hours, weekends or public holidays for urgent incidents, evidence collection or law-enforcement activity. Must maintain confidentiality and professional conduct in all interactions and documentation. Other Must comply with all QHSE, Food Safety, Fire Safety and Emergency Preparedness requirements. Must preserve confidentiality, due process, evidence integrity and unbiased reporting at all times. Must be able to produce clear reports suitable for management, HR, Legal, Internal Audit and external authorities. Ref: Mgr, Investigations Apply Now

description: Technical Support Analyst - Remote Influx Manchester / St. Ann / St. James 75000 - 85000 Permanent full-time Updated 15/10/2026 HRD Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save We’re hiring a Technical Support Analyst in Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, or Jamaica. Join our global team to troubleshoot technical issues, manage tickets, and grow your IT skills in a fully remote role. Location: Colombia, Argentina, Brazil & Jamaica Work Mode: Remote – BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) Department: Operations / Delivery Reports to: Team Leader About Influx Influx is a global customer experience and operations partner that helps fast-growing companies scale their support, operations, and back-office teams with world-class talent. We operate across multiple countries and time zones, providing opportunities for professionals to work with international clients, modern technologies, and diverse teams At Influx, we believe that people are our greatest asset. We invest heavily in training, leadership development, and continuous improvement to help our team members grow both professionally and personally. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance — while maintaining a strong focus on work-life balance and long-term career growt h About the Role Are you passionate about technology and enjoy solving problems? We're looking for a Technical Support Analyst to join our team and help ensure a smooth and reliable experience for our customers. In this role, you'll be responsible for investigating technical issues, managing support tickets, documenting troubleshooting steps, and collaborating with technical teams to resolve incidents efficiently. You'll have the opportunity to strengthen your technical skills while working with enterprise customers and learning about modern IT infrastructure and SaaS environments. We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in IT support, a structured approach to problem-solving, and a strong sense of ownership. You don't need to know everything already — we're looking for someone eager to learn, communicate effectively, and know when to escalate an issue. What You'll Do Manage support tickets: Receive, investigate, prioritize, and track technical support requests using ticketing platforms. Troubleshoot technical issues: Perform initial investigations involving operating systems, connectivity, networking, servers, and SaaS applications. Document findings: Record reported symptoms, troubleshooting steps, available logs, and test results to ensure clear and complete incident documentation. Collaborate with technical teams: Escalate complex issues to the appropriate teams, providing the information needed to support efficient resolution. Communicate with customers: Provide clear, professional updates regarding ticket status, troubleshooting progress, and next steps. Follow established procedures: Apply support guidelines consistently while maintaining accurate records and ensuring appropriate follow-up. Take ownership: Monitor open tickets, follow through on pending actions, and ensure effective handoffs until the issue reaches the appropriate resolution stage. What We're Looking For Experience: 1–2 years of experience in Technical Support, IT Help Desk, Service Desk, SaaS Support, or a similar role. Technical foundations: Basic knowledge of operating systems, networking, servers, and technical troubleshooting. Ticket management: Experience using ticketing platforms such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar tools. Technical documentation: Ability to clearly document symptoms, troubleshooting steps, logs, and test results before escalating an issue. English proficiency: B2 level or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively in both written and spoken English with enterprise customers and global technical teams. Nice-to-Have Skills The following skills are a plus, but they are not required to apply : Linux: Familiarity with basic commands, processes, file systems, and log analysis. Networking: Understanding of IP addressing, DNS, TCP/IP, connectivity, and latency. Cloud and infrastructure: Basic understanding of cloud computing, IT infrastructure, and SaaS services. Containers and Kubernetes: Introductory knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes concepts. B2B technical support: Previous experience handling technical incidents for business customers. The Qualities That Will Help You Succeed Attention to detail: You follow procedures carefully and ensure documentation is accurate and complete. Analytical thinking: You approach technical problems logically, investigate potential causes, and follow a structured troubleshooting process. Communication under pressure: You remain professional and communicate clearly, even when handling urgent or complex incidents. Ownership and accountability: You take responsibility for your assigned tickets, follow up on pending actions, and ensure smooth handoffs. Sound escalation judgment: You recognize the limits of your technical knowledge and escalate issues promptly when additional expertise is required. Technical Requirements (BYOD) Reliable and stable internet connection. Computer with minimum Intel Core i5 processor or equivalent. Noise-canceling headset. A fully functional laptop and reliable high-speed internet are required (Windows operating system only; iOS is not supported). Working Conditions & Benefits 100% remote work modality. Stable employment contract. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Why Join Us? Be part of a fast-growing global organization with international exposure. Work with innovative clients and cutting-edge tools. Build a long-term career with continuous learning and development opportunities. Enjoy a remote-first culture that values accountability, autonomy, and performance. description: FISHERIES ANALYST, INTEGRATED PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION UNIT (IPIU) CARICOM Implementation Agency for Crime and Security (IMPACS) Port-of-Spain Commission Only Permanent full-time Updated 02/11/2026 HUMAN RESOURCES Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save FISHERIES ANALYST, INTEGRATED PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION UNIT (IPIU) JOB OPPORTUNITY The Caribbean Community (CARICOM) Implementation Agency for Crime and Security (IMPACS) established by Heads of Government, is seeking suitably qualified individuals to fill the following position at its sub-agency, the Regional Intelligence Fusion Centre (RIFC), with assigned duty station in Trinidad and Tobago: FISHERIES ANALYST, INTEGRATED PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION UNIT (IPIU) OPEN TO ALL CARICOM NATIONALS PROJECT SUMMARY The United States (US) Department of State, Bureau of Western Hemisphere Affairs, through the Caribbean Foreign Assistance Unit of the United States Embassy in Santo Domingo approved the project entitled ‘Turning on the Lights (ToL): Advancing Fish and Flags Through Enhanced Maritime Visibility, Fisheries Governance and Regional Oversight in the Caribbean.’ The project is designed to achieve the following key security outcomes: Strengthened Regional Fisheries Governance and Regulatory Frameworks for Maritime Visibility and Fisheries Oversight. Enhanced Maritime Domain Awareness and flag and fisheries oversight effectiveness. Strengthened Regional Cooperation, Information Sharing, and Collective Action Against Fisheries Crime. As part of the project start-up activities, the establishment of the Integrated Project Implementation Unit (IPIU) necessitates the recruitment of suitably qualified personnel to support the effective implementation of the project. JOB SUMMARY The Fisheries Analyst, IPIU will contribute to CARICOM IMPACS’ intelligence gathering, intelligence analysis, and capacity building operations. The incumbent will also be responsible for conducting research, collecting and analyzing fisheries-related data, and providing technical and policy advice on fisheries management and sustainability and understanding of global fishing operations and supply and value chain activities that affect the security of the Caribbean region. The Fisheries Analyst, IPIU will contribute to formulation, implementation of fisheries policies, the strengthening of maritime transparency, regional maritime domain awareness and fisheries governance in the Caribbean. The Fisheries Analyst, IPIU will report to the Project Manager, IPIU and the Environmental Crimes Lead. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES A. Fisheries Research and Data Analysis Conduct research and analysis on fisheries resources, production, consumption, trade and market trends at the national, regional and international levels. Conduct policy research and prepare technical recommendations on fisheries governance and institutional development. Collect, compile, validate and analyse quantitative and qualitative fisheries data on illegal unreported and unregulated fishing and fisheries crime, emerging regional and global trends, challenges and opportunities. Assess fisheries production, stock assessments, fishing effort and resource utilization to support sustainable fisheries management, marine conservation and responsible resource utilization. Develop and maintain fisheries databases, statistical reports, analytical and information management systems. Monitor developments in fisheries management, aquaculture, marine biodiversity and related sectors. Identify emerging trends, patterns, threats and vulnerabilities associated with fisheries and environmental crimes within the Caribbean region. Monitor movement of fishing vessels and vessels engaged in fishing activity in the region through available systems. Analyse and report on effects of environmental crimes on fisheries management. Identify data gaps and recommend improvements to fisheries data collection, reporting and monitoring systems. Contribute to intelligence analysis and outputs, as required. B. Policy Development and Technical Support Provide technical and analytical support in the development, review and implementation of fisheries policies, strategies, programmes and action plans. Analyse national, regional and international fisheries proposals, policies, legislation, agreements and regulatory frameworks. Identify legal and regulatory loopholes facilitating illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing and fisheries crime Monitor and analyse regional and international developments affecting fisheries, including climate change, illegal unreported and unregulated fishing, and emerging marine resource management issues. Identify and analyse the convergence of illegal unreported and unregulated fishing with greater criminality, other environmental issues and the effects to the Caribbean Community. Contribute to the preparation of policy briefs, position papers, technical submissions and intelligence and advisory reports Support efforts to strengthen regional cooperation and harmonization of fisheries management approaches. Sales and business development •               Meet or exceed assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the territory and product categories. •               Plan a daily schedule to visit and call existing and prospective customers, and present, promote and sell RSPL products with clear, solid arguments. •               Find and pursue new business: hardware stores, contractors, builders, plumbers, electricians, farmers, property developers, schools, hotels and government agencies. •               Generate leads, follow up promptly and turn prospects into repeat accounts. •               Cross-sell and upsell RSPL's own manufactured plastic products with complementary hardware lines. •               Prepare quotations and tenders, and submit sales contracts and orders for approval. 2. Customer and account management •               Build and keep strong, long-term relationships with trade and retail customers to secure future sales. •               Tell customers about products, prices, promotions, availability and credit terms. •               Resolve customer queries, complaints and returns quickly, and escalate where needed, to keep satisfaction high. •               Keep customer records and contact history up to date in the company's sales or CRM system. •               Seek customer feedback and use it to improve service. 3. Superstore and retail support •               Serve walk-in and trade customers on the superstore floor during assigned shifts, especially peak periods and promotions. •               Help with merchandising, product displays, shelf pricing and signage so the store meets RSPL standards. •               Help plan and run promotions, product launches, in-store events, trade days and exhibitions. •               Advise customers on product selection, specifications, quantities and installation basics for hardware and building projects. •               Report stock shortages, slow-moving lines and damaged goods to the Superstore Supervisor and Procurement. 4. Orders, delivery, credit and collections •               Complete all sales paperwork and system entries correctly and on time, including orders, invoices and credit applications. •               Check stock with the warehouse and production team, estimate delivery dates and arrange delivery schedules. •               Follow RSPL's credit policy and check customer credit limits before confirming orders. •               Collect deposits and outstanding balances from customers on time, and help Accounts Receivable recover overdue debts. •               Handle cash, cheques and payment documents according to company controls. 5. Market intelligence and reporting •               Monitor competitors' pricing, products, new launches, delivery schedules, credit terms and merchandising. •               Submit daily call reports, weekly work plans, monthly sales reports and annual territory analyses. •               Report on customer needs, problems and interests, and on the potential for new products and services. •               Recommend changes to products, pricing, services and policies based on results and market trends. 6. Product knowledge and professional development •               Learn RSPL's products, processes, pricing and promotion guidelines thoroughly, including technical features and benefits. •               Keep up with hardware, construction and building-supplies trends. •               Attend training, workshops and supplier product sessions, and apply what you learn. 7. Teamwork, compliance and conduct •               Work with sales colleagues and other departments on joint sales efforts, large orders and customer service. •               Follow company policies, health and safety rules, and anti-fraud and cash-handling controls. •               Look after any company property or samples you are given. •               Represent RSPL professionally at all times and keep a positive, team-focused attitude. •               Carry out any other reasonable duties your manager assigns in line with the role. This job description sets out the main duties of the role. It does not list every task. Management may change it to meet business needs, after consulting the job holder. Required Skills •               Selling and negotiation: Strong selling, persuasion and negotiation skills; able to close deals and handle objections •               Communication: Excellent spoken and written communication; able to tailor and deliver presentations to different audiences •               Customer focus: Puts the customer first; builds trust and long-term relationships; open to feedback •               Drive and results: Highly motivated, competitive and target-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset •               Organisation: Good at prioritising, managing time and planning a territory; accurate with paperwork •               Product and technical aptitude: Quick to learn plastics and hardware products, and able to explain specifications and uses •               Numeracy: Confident with pricing, discounts, margins, quotations and basic sales maths •               Technology: Good working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); comfortable with point-of-sale, CRM and mobile ordering tools •               Teamwork: A team player who works well with other departments •               Adaptability: Works well in a fast-paced, changing start-up environment •               Integrity: Honest and trustworthy in handling cash, credit and customer information Key Performance Indicators Performance is reviewed monthly against targets that the Sales Manager sets for each period. •               Sales revenue (Monthly): Actual sales against target (J$), by territory and category •               New accounts (Monthly): Number of new active trade accounts opened •               Customer coverage (Weekly): Planned customer visits and calls completed •               Gross margin (Monthly): Margin achieved against the price list, with discounts kept within approved limits •               Collections (Monthly): Percentage of balances collected within credit terms, and debtor days •               Cross-selling (Quarterly): Share of sales that include RSPL-manufactured products •               Customer satisfaction (Quarterly): Complaints resolved within the agreed time, and customer feedback •               Reporting (Weekly / monthly): Call reports, work plans and territory reports submitted on time and accurately Educational Requirements, Qualifications & Experience Required •               At least five (5) CSEC/CXC General Proficiency passes, including Mathematics and English Language. •               An associate degree or diploma in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience. •               At least two (2) years' proven sales experience, with a record of meeting targets. •               A valid Jamaican driver's licence and a clean driving record. •               Your own reliable motor vehicle in good working condition, for field travel. •               A valid Police Record, and satisfactory references. Preferred •               A BSc in Sales and Marketing, Business Administration or equivalent. •               Three (3) or more years' sales experience in a large commercial, industrial or manufacturing company. •               Experience selling hardware, building materials, plumbing, electrical or construction supplies, or in a superstore or retail setting. •               An existing network of contractors, builders or hardware retailers in Jamaica. •               Training in customer service, professional selling or credit and collections. Working Conditions & Physical Requirements •               The role mixes field travel with time on the superstore floor and in the office. •               The job holder will drive daily and visit customer sites, including construction sites and farms. They must wear the required personal protective equipment (PPE) on site. •               They must be able to stand and walk for long periods during store shifts. •               They must be able to lift and move product samples and display items of up to 23 kg (50 lb), using safe lifting practices. •               Some work on Saturdays, public holidays, evenings and at trade events will be needed during peak periods and promotions. Les analystes de Gartner sont des chefs de file de l’industrie qui créent des analyses incontournables, des prédictions de marché et des meilleures pratiques pour un vaste éventail d’organisations de premier plan à l’échelle mondiale. title: Aerodynamics & CFD Software Engineering Specialist
description: Aerodynamics & CFD Software Engineering Specialist (MSc/PhD) Location: United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom Department: Talent Solutions Workplace: remote Employment Type: contract Description About Gramian Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs. About the Job We are seeking highly skilled Aerodynamics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Specialists with strong programming capabilities to contribute to a specialized AI training project focused on aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python-based computational workflows. This role is particularly suited to engineers who combine a solid understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics with practical software development and coding skills. You will create, solve, review, and validate engineering tasks using programmatic, command-line-based workflows. Typical assignments may involve analyzing airfoils, preparing computational domains and meshes, defining boundary conditions, running CFD simulations, calculating lift and drag, and validating whether resulting flow fields are numerically stable and physically realistic. Practical coding ability is essential. We are looking for engineers who can actively write Python code, automate engineering workflows, and work with computational tools—not simply candidates who hold relevant academic degrees without the ability to implement technical solutions. Previous AI experience is not required. LOCATION: Remote – US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Southeast Asia, and APAC WORKLOAD: Approximately 15 hours per week. SCHEDULE: Flexible; choose your working days and hours, including weekends. COMPENSATION MODEL: Output-based, with payment per task that meets project specifications. PROJECT: AI training focused on aerodynamics, CFD, engineering simulation, and Python. AI EXPERIENCE: Not required. Key Responsibilities Solve and validate complex aerodynamic and fluid dynamics problems. Translate physical engineering requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings. Execute CFD and aerodynamic analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools. Write Python code to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation. Develop scripts and computational workflows for engineering analysis. Calculate and interpret aerodynamic quantities, including lift, drag, pressure distributions, and flow characteristics. Evaluate mesh quality, numerical convergence, solver stability, and physical validity of simulation results. Diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs. Select and justify modeling assumptions, mesh strategies, boundary conditions, and solver configurations. Document technical methodologies, engineering decisions, and simulation results. Requirements Candidates should meet one of the following educational pathways: Pathway 1: Master's or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with a specialization in aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids. Pathway 2: Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, combined with at least 1–2 years of relevant aerodynamics-specific professional or research experience. Additional requirements: Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics. Practical experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses. Strong practical proficiency in Python, including the ability to write and debug code independently. Experience using Python for scientific computing, engineering automation, or computational analysis. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library accessible through a command-line interface, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings. Ability to diagnose numerical convergence issues, unstable solutions, and physically invalid results. Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly. Professional English proficiency at C1 level or higher.

title: Business Data Analyst, Loans
description: Business Data Analyst, Loans Location: Canada; Remote (United States) Department: Operations About the Role The Business Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing, mapping, validating, and supporting the migration of client data during core banking system conversions. This role serves as a critical liaison between clients, project teams, and technical resources to ensure accurate data conversion, effective communication, and a seamless implementation experience. The successful candidate will lead data discovery sessions and workshops, gather and document business requirements, analyze source data, troubleshoot conversion issues, and provide ongoing support throughout the project lifecycle. This position requires strong analytical abilities, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What You'll Do Analyze client data and business processes to support core banking system conversions. Conduct client workshops and discovery sessions to gather requirements and understand current business practices. Document business requirements, decisions, conversion rules, and project deliverables. Perform data mapping from legacy banking systems to the target core banking platform. Validate and reconcile converted data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Investigate and resolve data-related issues, exceptions, and conversion discrepancies. Collaborate with project managers, consultants, developers, and client stakeholders throughout the implementation process. Participate in testing activities, including system testing, conversion testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Track, manage, and resolve project tickets and support requests within established timelines. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to internal teams and clients. Provide recommendations for process improvements and conversion best practices. Support client training, go-live activities, and post-conversion warranty support. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge-sharing activities within the organization. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications Required Experience in business analysis, data analysis, data conversion, or banking operations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements. Strong knowledge in consumer, residential, and commercial lending. Proficiency working with data sets, spreadsheets, databases, and reporting tools. Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and client discussions. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment. Intermediate experience in SQL and data querying tools. Preferred Experience with core banking systems, banking operations, or financial institutions. Experience supporting banking system implementations, mergers, or conversions. Familiarity with ticketing and project management platforms. Experience converting clients to or from Fiserv DNA. Previous consulting experience working directly with clients. About the Company About BanQsi BanQsi is a banking technology consulting firm that partners with financial institutions to implement and optimize core banking solutions. We specialize in system implementations, conversions, integrations, and consulting services, helping our clients successfully navigate complex projects with confidence. At BanQsi, our people are what set us apart. As a fully remote team, we believe in hiring great people, giving them the tools they need to succeed, and trusting them to do what they do best. We foster a collaborative, supportive environment where ideas are welcomed, growth is encouraged, and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We're proud of the relationships we've built with both our clients and our team members. As we continue to grow across North America, we're looking for individuals who are driven, collaborative, and excited to help shape the future of banking technology.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management
description: Staff Software Engineer - Identity & Access Management Location: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Department: Engineering Why join us Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Engineering at Brex Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems. What you’ll do The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations. As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences. Where you’ll work This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work! Responsibilities Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows. Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support. Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows. Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams. Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions. Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries. title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
description: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering Location: Remote, Canada (EST) OR Remote, US (EST) OR Remote, UK Department: Engineering About CircleCI Engineering CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. About Delivery Engineering Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil. Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on. We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization. What You'll Do Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on. Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate. Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done. Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns. Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage. Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows. What You'll Bring Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work. Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics. A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption. Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration. A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed. Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along. This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone. Sound like you? You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. This role is particularly suited to engineers who combine a solid understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics with practical software development and coding skills. You will create, solve, review, and validate engineering tasks using programmatic, command-line-based workflows. Typical assignments may involve analyzing airfoils, preparing computational domains and meshes, defining boundary conditions, running CFD simulations, calculating lift and drag, and validating whether resulting flow fields are numerically stable and physically realistic. Practical coding ability is essential. We are looking for engineers who can actively write Python code, automate engineering workflows, and work with computational tools—not simply candidates who hold relevant academic degrees without the ability to implement technical solutions. Previous AI experience is not required. LOCATION: Remote – US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Southeast Asia, and APAC WORKLOAD: Approximately 15 hours per week. SCHEDULE: Flexible; choose your working days and hours, including weekends. COMPENSATION MODEL: Output-based, with payment per task that meets project specifications. PROJECT: AI training focused on aerodynamics, CFD, engineering simulation, and Python. AI EXPERIENCE: Not required. title: Marketing and Data Analyst (Remote)
description: Marketing & Data Analyst Team: Marketing Location: Canada Commitment: Full-time Workplace Type: remote This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing & Data Analyst based in Canada. This is a hands-on analytics role responsible for connecting marketing performance, product behavior, and customer retention data. You will own reporting and tracking across acquisition channels and help ensure business decisions are based on accurate, reliable information. The role spans the full customer journey, including acquisition, funnels, conversion, subscriptions, retention, and lifetime value. You will combine analytical expertise with technical tracking skills across tools such as GTM, GA4, Mixpanel, BigQuery, and marketing platforms. You will investigate discrepancies, troubleshoot tracking issues, and continuously improve data quality across reporting systems. Your analysis will help marketing, product, and business teams identify opportunities, evaluate experiments, and improve performance. The position is ideal for an independent, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working at the intersection of data, technology, and growth. Accountabilities Own marketing and product analytics, tracking, and reporting across acquisition channels. Analyze performance throughout the customer journey, from acquisition and funnel conversion through subscription performance, retention, and lifetime value. Track and analyze key metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV, cohorts, rebills, cancellations, refunds, and churn. Identify performance trends, changes, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement. Translate complex datasets into clear reports and actionable insights for marketing, product, and business teams. Analyze user behavior and acquisition funnels to identify conversion opportunities. Evaluate A/B tests across landing pages, pricing structures, and customer journeys. Assess experiment results and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Monitor attribution across Meta, Google, internal data sources, and other acquisition platforms. Investigate discrepancies between marketing platforms and internal reporting systems. Improve attribution consistency and help ensure business teams rely on appropriate data for decision-making. Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot tracking through Google Tag Manager. Configure and manage Meta and Google pixels, Conversion APIs, and related marketing integrations. Support both client-side and server-side event tracking. Implement and troubleshoot event deduplication processes. Maintain integrations between analytics and marketing platforms. Proactively monitor data quality and consistency across reporting systems. Investigate and resolve tracking and data discrepancies before they affect business decisions. Work with large marketing and customer datasets to identify meaningful patterns and business opportunities. Continuously improve analytics, reporting, and tracking processes as the business and acquisition channels evolve. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience in marketing analytics, product analytics, data analytics, or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with Mixpanel, GA4, or comparable analytics platforms. Experience analyzing funnels, events, user behavior, conversion rates, and customer journeys. Strong practical experience with Google Tag Manager, including event setup and debugging. Experience with web and server-side tracking implementations. Hands-on experience with Meta and Google pixels and Conversion APIs. Experience integrating analytics and marketing platforms. Strong understanding of attribution across paid media platforms and internal data sources. Solid knowledge of CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV, retention, churn, cohorts, rebills, cancellations, refunds, and subscription performance. Hands-on experience working with BigQuery, GCP, and large marketing or customer datasets. Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data. Strong proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve data and tracking issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with marketing, product, and business stakeholders. Comfortable working independently in a hands-on, fast-moving environment. Experience in telehealth, healthcare, or another subscription-based health business is a plus. Understanding of healthcare marketing and data compliance is advantageous. Experience with Tableau or Looker Studio is a plus. Familiarity with TikTok, Snapchat, or other paid media tracking platforms is beneficial. Experience with affiliate tracking or Everflow is an advantage. Benefits: Full-time position. Remote work arrangement. Working hours from 14:00 to 22:00 EEST (Kyiv time) . Opportunity to own analytics across marketing, product, acquisition, and retention. Hands-on role with significant responsibility for tracking, reporting, and data quality. Opportunity to work with modern analytics, attribution, tracking, and marketing technologies. Direct impact on marketing and business decision-making through actionable data insights. title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Data Engineer Intern (Summer 2027) Location: Toronto, Canada Department: Early Talent At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Interns work side-by-side with top engineers in the industry while having autonomy from the get-go. They contribute to user-facing products and are able to see their work go live quickly. Lyft fosters a collaborative environment in the office, so there's always a sharp mind eager to hear about your next idea. So what's yours? Responsibilities: Own your project, while checking in with other team members throughout the day with questions and updates You leave the code in a better state than when you found it (progressive refactor) You value reliability, ensured by testing Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and distribute knowledge Continuous integration and deployment Go home knowing that your work today is meaningfully improving the lives of every Lyft driver and every Lyft passenger! Experience: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or related major from a university in Canada (required) , with a graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required) . For any candidates who are master's students who worked between their bachelor's and master's programs: candidates should also have less than 2 years of relevant full-time work experience Available during Summer 2027 for an internship in Toronto Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals Knowledge of SQL and data modeling fundamentals Experience working with databases Excellent communication skills Interest in solving large scale data problems in a real world scenario Passion for community, sustainability, and/or transportation Benefits: Mental health benefits In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request. Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is CAD $40 - CAD $45 per hour. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process. Lyft may use artificial intelligence to screen applicants, however, Lyft employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions. This is a new position.

description: Senior Engineering Manager, Billing Department: Engineering Organization Location: Remote: United States, San Francisco HQ, Remote: Canada Compensation: $236K – $295K • Offers Equity Employment Type: FullTime At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. Applying to Render We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. About the Role Billing is mission-critical to Render’s success. Every service, database, and workload that runs on Render ends up on an invoice, and customers trust us to get that invoice right. As Senior Engineering Manager for the Billing team, you’ll lead the organization that makes sure customers are billed accurately, reliably, and transparently as Render scales. You’ll set the multi-quarter strategy and own the technical direction, people, and execution behind Render’s usage-based billing systems: how usage is captured, how it flows through our data pipelines and third-party billing platforms, and how it lands as a correct charge. You’ll be Engineering’s senior partner to Finance, Product, and Customer Experience leadership, turning pricing, reporting, and customer needs into a roadmap your team can ship. This role is for a seasoned technical leader who wants to build the organization, the leaders, and the systems that keep billing right as usage, pricing, and our customer base keep growing. What You’ll Do Lead and grow the Billing engineering team, which owns how Render turns platform usage into accurate charges: usage capture, data pipelines, third-party billing platforms (Orb, Metronome, Stripe, or similar), and invoicing Own the roadmap for Render’s billing systems, from usage metering through invoicing, reconciliation, and financial reporting Drive billing correctness and reliability: build the monitoring, reconciliation, and testing that catch errors before customers do Partner with Finance, Product, and Customer Experience to align the roadmap with pricing, reporting, and customer needs Hire and develop engineers to support planned team growth, while keeping the team’s focus clear as billing scope expands Make key architectural decisions, balancing long-term billing platform investment against near-term pricing launches and fixes Build a strong performance management and career development practice for a team that includes senior ICs What We’re Looking For Strong people leadership — the top priority for this role Hands-on enough to review code, prototype, and contribute directly when it helps the team Comfort operating in ambiguity, with adaptability and a growth mindset Proven experience building and scaling teams, ideally growing a group from a handful of engineers into a larger org Experience managing engineers; including senior and staff engineers; hiring, and performance management Hands-on experience with usage-based billing, payments, or other revenue-critical systems, including third-party platforms like Orb, Metronome, or Stripe Ability to partner closely with Finance, Product, and Customer Experience without needing to fill those functions yourself Strong business instincts, with the ability to connect engineering investment to billing accuracy, revenue, and customer trust Background from either a startup or a larger company is fine. What matters is experience and ability to operate in a fast-paced environment Nice-to-Haves Experience leading a billing platform migration or a pricing model change. Familiarity with financial reconciliation and reporting processes. Background in distributed systems or event-driven architectures. Experience building for developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DevTools. description: Finance Data Analyst Location: Montreal, Bangalore, Warsaw Department: Finance Position Overview: We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically minded finance professional to join the Financial Planning & Analysis team at Squarepoint, a leading quantitative investment manager. The individual should have a solid understanding of financial data management and reconciliation, with experience working across finance systems and a confidence in ensuring data is accurate, well-structured, and fit for purpose. The role will focus on improving the quality and integrity of contract and financial data, as well as owning the tracking and loading of leasehold improvement spend, with outputs that directly improve the reliability of FP&A forecasting, reporting, and invoice processing across the business. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who takes pride in data accuracy, enjoys investigating and resolving financial misalignments, and is motivated by the opportunity to create tangible and lasting improvements in data quality and process. The role offers real visibility across the finance function and the chance to work with a broad range of stakeholders, making a meaningful impact on the quality of information that underpins decision-making across the business. Reviewing actual ledger postings against contract data to identify and resolve misalignments in financial attributions, ensuring contracts are correctly tagged at source across all relevant dimensions. Reviewing contract run rates against contracted values, engaging with business owners to understand and document variances and revise contract values where necessary. Reviewing inactive contracts to assess whether they should remain active, reducing noise in the data and improving forecast reliability. Collaborating with the Technology team to explore opportunities to improve recording of contract data in a way that enables more granular and accurate reporting. Working with external partners to ensure the monthly leasehold improvement trackers are completed accurately and capture all required information for FP&A and stakeholders. Loading leasehold improvement data into the FP&A forecasting platform on a monthly basis, ensuring it reconciles correctly and is available for stakeholder reporting and analysis. Required qualifications: Relevant experience in a finance, FP&A, or financial control role, with a solid understanding of how financial data flows between systems and feeds into reporting and forecasting. Experience reconciling financial data across systems, with the ability to identify root causes of misalignments and work with stakeholders to resolve them. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Strong communication skills with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships across all levels of the business. High personal standards, strong attention to detail and a desire to exceed expectations. An independent mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing processes and propose improvements. A well-structured, proactive work ethic with the ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment. A curious mindset and a natural interest in understanding the wider business. Open to technology and motivated to find ways to streamline and improve processes. Familiarity with LLM tools in either a professional or personal context. Familiarity with a CRM or contract management system, and experience using a financial planning or EPM tool, would be advantageous. Experience with data visualisation, including graphs and dashboards, would be advantageous.

description: Data Analyst, Intern Location: Toronto Department: 5112 General University Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the team Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background. What you’ll do As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Responsibilities Analyze data and running experiments to drive impact Ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly Create metrics, reports, and dashboards to inform and run the business Extend Stripe’s metrics semantic layer Build new data assets and improve existing data assets to support decision-making, products, and business processes Assess the impact of decisions, product launches, and product improvements using business analytics and A/B testing Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements Enrolled in a quantitative Bachelor’s or Master's degree program (e.g. Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028 Experience with SQL Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment Preferred qualifications Experience writing and debugging data pipelines Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

description: Senior Data Engineer Location: Brighton, United Kingdom, Montreal, Canada, Copenhagen, Denmark, London, United Kingdom Time Type: Full time Job Description Job Description L'opportunité Développeur(se) de données Sénior appelé(e) à diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de notre plateforme de données essentielle aux activités de l'entreprise. Occuper un rôle avec une grande autonomie, intégré(e) à une équipe de développeur(se)s logiciel et de données sénior, en collaboration sur les enjeux et les solutions liés à la plateforme de données. Transformer des exigences complexes et parfois ambiguës en architectures de données robustes. Nous dire ce qui doit être construit, plutôt que l'inverse. Contribuer à un usage efficace des données, un axe central pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise; cette équipe se situe exactement à cet endroit stratégique et offre des solutions de grande qualité qui résolvent de véritables enjeux d'affaires et des problèmes vécus par la clientèle à travers des milliers de titres Unity. Ce que vous allez faire Collaborer avec les parties prenantes plutôt que simplement recevoir des billets JIRA; définir l'espace-problème, proposer des solutions techniques et en assurer la prise en charge jusqu'en production Détecter les goulots d'étranglement dans les flux de données et les occasions d'amélioration Proposer et livrer des améliorations architecturales Influencer la feuille de route vers l'excellence technique en développement de données Ce que nous recherchons Posséder de solides bases en développement logiciel appliqué aux données Maîtriser les technologies de diffusion de données en continu, comme Kafka et Flink Travailler de manière autonome tout en étant efficace au sein d'une équipe Avoir de l'expérience auprès de parties prenantes non techniques et savoir traduire leurs besoins en exigences techniques pour une livraison à l'échelle de l'équipe Information supplémentaire Le support à la relocalisation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste Un visa de travail ou un parrainage de l'immigration n'est pas disponible pour ce poste The opportunity Senior Data Engineer to lead design and implementation of our business-critical data platform. High autonomy role, embedded in a team of senior software and data engineers, collaborating on the data platform problem and solution space. Translating complex, ambiguous requirements into resilient data engineering architecture designs. Tell us what needs built, not the other way around. Effective use of data is a core focus for the broader company, and this team sits precisely in that space and delivers high-quality solutions that solve real business problems and customer problems across thousands of Unity titles. What you'll be doing Not just handed JIRA tickets; you will be partnering with stakeholders, defining the problem space, pitching technical solutions and owning them through to production Identify data bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement Pitch and deliver architectural improvements Influence the roadmap towards technical excellence in data engineering What we're looking for Strong software engineering fundamentals applied to data Expertise working with data streaming technologies such as Kafka and Flink Autonomous and effective in a team setting Experience working with non-technical stakeholders and translating their needs to technical requirements for team-wide delivery Additional information Relocation support is not available for this position Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: £55,700 - £69,600 GBP gross Zone B: £63,700 - £79,600 GBP gross Zone A: kr639,400 - kr799,300 DKK gross Zone A: CA$103,000 - CA$ 128,000CAD gross Zone B: CA$111,100 - CA$ 136,100CAD gross Cette fourchette correspond au salaire de base prévu pour ce poste. title: Business Analyst
description:
• Have you had a career break of 12+ months?
  • Do you have 5+ years of commercial experience in industry?
  • Are you ready to re-join the workforce with training and career coaching included?

Then you’ll want to hear about the UK’s leading Returners Programme and how it helps 100+ returners restart their careers every year.

Our Returners Programme is specifically designed to support professionals returning to work after a career break. Having restarted over 500 careers since 2016, our Returners Team are here to support you through every stage of the journey, ensuring you have the confidence, skills and opportunity to step back into a successful and rewarding career in business or technology.

FDM is a business and technology consultancy that services the industry across five core specialisms. Each of our Practices provides our Returners with a career path in their most suited field, so we can help you develop and build on your previous skills and experience across multiple capabilities.

The FDM Practices

  • Software Engineering
  • Change & Transformation
  • IT Operations
  • Data & Analytics
  • Risk, Regulation & Compliance

You’ll join FDM as a Consultant and provide services to our clients relating to your field and Practice.
