title: Trainee Ai Engineer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer - No Experience Needed!

Ready to launch a future-proof career in AI - even if you have zero experience?

We’re looking for ambitious individuals ready to break into the world of artificial intelligence and data science. Our industry-leading AI Traineeship is designed to take you from complete beginner to a highly employable Junior AI Engineer, with full training provided and a guaranteed job offer (£25K-£45K starting salary) within 20 miles of your location.

Whether you're working full-time, part-time, or currently unemployed, our flexible, self-paced program allows you to train around your lifestyle and be job-ready in as little as 6-12 months.

How it works - your journey to AI successStep 1: Discover AI

Start your journey with our beginner-friendly mini-course bundle. Explore the fundamentals of AI through interactive videos, presentations, and quizzes - all accessible anytime, anywhere, through our easy-to-use online platform.

Step 2: Full-Stack AI Mastery

Dive deeper with in-demand technical skills including Python programming, data handling, machine learning, and version control with Git and GitHub. You’ll work on hands-on mini projects that mirror real-world challenges, helping you build confidence and a strong portfolio as you learn.

Step 3: Get Certified

Prepare for and earn your Microsoft AI-900: Azure AI Fundamentals certification, an internationally recognised qualification that proves your knowledge and boosts your credibility with employers.

Step 4: Real-World Projects

Showcase your new skills with two industry-based, practical projects assigned by your personal tutor. These projects are designed to give you real, portfolio-worthy experience, making you stand out to employers from day one.

Your guaranteed future

After completing your training, you'll be placed in a Junior AI Engineer role with a guaranteed starting salary of £25K-£45K. We work with top employers across the UK to ensure you get matched with a role close to home.

We guarantee a job offer upon completion or 100% of your course fees refunded.

We’re proud to have helped over 1,000 people each year transform their careers. Explore our success stories on our website and see what your future could look like.

Ready to future-proof your career?

If you’re passionate about tech and ready to break into one of the fastest-growing industries in the world, apply now. One of our friendly advisors will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
Job Description

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. That means creating investment solutions that are well designed, carefully managed and focused on delivering good outcomes for customers.

As an Investment Analyst within AJ Bell Investments, you’ll play an important part in shaping and managing our discretionary portfolios. Working closely with the Head of Investment Solutions and colleagues across Investments, you’ll turn market insight, research and data into practical portfolio decisions, helping ensure our investment solutions remain robust, relevant and straightforward for the people who invest with us.

It’s a varied role combining investment analysis, portfolio implementation and product governance, with the opportunity to contribute ideas, challenge thinking and help us continually improve how we invest for our customers.

What you’ll do

  • Help shape our managed portfolios, supporting strategic and tactical asset allocation and translating investment thinking into effective portfolio implementation.
  • Turn research into investment decisions, working closely with the Research team to develop appropriate portfolio implementation strategies.
  • Support strong investment governance, helping design and monitor Investment Policy Statements and ensuring portfolios remain aligned with their objectives.
  • Bring investment data to life, developing meaningful management information, capital market assumptions reporting and clear insights that support informed decision-making.
  • Put portfolio decisions into practice, supporting fund trading, model portfolio updates and the ongoing maintenance of AJ Bell’s discretionary managed portfolios.
  • Communicate clearly with different audiences, producing regular investment literature and committee reporting, and helping ensure portfolio developments are understood across the business and communicated effectively to investors.
  • Work collaboratively across AJ Bell, sharing expertise and supporting the continued growth and development of AJ Bell Investments and our wider investment proposition.
  • Help maintain high standards, supporting Consumer Duty and wider regulatory requirements while sharing your knowledge and helping develop colleagues within the team.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in an analytical role within investments, asset management or financial services, with the ability to interpret complex information and turn it into clear, practical insight.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, alongside a thoughtful and curious approach to investment challenges.
  • A relevant Level 4 QCF qualification, or a commitment to achieving one in the short term, with an appetite to continue developing your professional knowledge.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively with investment specialists and colleagues across the wider business.
  • The ability to produce clear, high-quality reports and use data to tell a meaningful story and support investment decisions.
  • Confidence using Excel and PowerPoint to analyse information and communicate findings effectively.
  • A forward-thinking mindset. You’ll be comfortable contributing ideas, looking for better ways of doing things and taking ownership of your work.
  • Most importantly, you’ll bring sound judgement, curiosity and a genuine interest in helping create investment solutions that deliver good outcomes for customers.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 723,000 customers trust us to manage more than £108.7 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer

  • Competitive starting salary
  • 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
  • 6% Pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

At AJ Bell, our people are the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together. That's why we offer a hybrid working model, where you'll spend a minimum of 50% of working time per month in the office. For new team members, an initial period will be spent full-time in the office to help you immerse yourself in our business and build valuable relationships with your colleagues.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

Agency information

This vacancy is being managed exclusively by our in-house Recruitment team. We are not partnering with recruitment agencies on this opportunity and will only accept applications submitted directly by candidates.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Lynx Recruitment are recruiting for a specialist technology consultancy delivering cloud-based AI and analytics solutions to global clients. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-ready Generative AI systems.

Role

You will own the full lifecycle of GenAI applications, working with LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic frameworks to deliver scalable, business-focused solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Build and deploy GenAI and RAG systems
  • Develop agentic AI workflows
  • Design prompts and safety guardrails
  • Implement monitoring and CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with clients and technical teams

Requirements

  • 1-3 years deploying LLM/GenAI systems in production
  • Strong Python skills
  • Experience with cloud platforms
  • Knowledge of RAG, vector databases, and LLM frameworks
  • Git and CI/CD experience
  • Experience with LangChain and LangGraph
  • AWS experience
  • IT/Technology-related university degree (minimum 2.1)

title: Senior Product Manager - Data
description:
Overview We're looking for a talented Senior Product Manager to join our growing Data & Analytics team at Chambers.

In this role, you'll help shape the future of our market-leading intelligence products, transforming unique legal industry data into innovative solutions that deliver meaningful value for our customers. Main Duties and Responsibilities
  • Develop and communicate a clear product vision and strategy for our data products, aligned with our strategic and commercial goals.
  • Identify market opportunities and define product roadmaps that align with business goals.
  • Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape.
  • Gather and analyze user feedback to continuously improve product offerings.

title: Operational Resilience & Third Party Risk Management Analyst
description:
We’re Atom...

The bank that’s on a mission to make finance faster, simpler and way more human.

We’ve ditched the stuffy banking model to build something that actually works for our customers, whenever and wherever they need us.

To make this happen, we’re looking for like-minded people who can help us reach our goals and think differently.

If you’re ready to build the future of banking, we’d love to meet you.

What will your typical day look like?

Sitting within our integrated Procurement & Operational Resilience team within Technology, you’ll work alongside a close-knit, high-performing team. You’ll spend your days combining hands-on governance ownership, like building MI reporting packs and maintaining continuity playbooks, with active collaboration across the Risk, Compliance, Tech, and Legal departments.

Whether you're helping First Line Service Relationship Managers navigate supplier risk, maintaining our crisis 'battle box', or identifying ways to automate and streamline our processes, you’ll be directly helping shift Atom from reactive compliance to a proactive operational resilience posture.

So, what will you be doing?

  • MI & Committee Reporting: Taking full ownership of collating, analysing, and producing combined Management Information (MI), TPRM metrics, and resilience committee packs using tools like Google Workspace, Jira, and Tableau.
  • Action & Risk Tracking: Proactively tracking, chasing, and managing open actions across resilience findings, supplier obligations, and audit remediation.
  • Resilience Administration & QA: Conducting quality assurance on Business Impact Analysis (BIA) submissions, managing customer survey processes, and maintaining up-to-date crisis playbooks.
  • Crisis & Continuity Preparedness: Keeping our crisis management 'battle box' and Crisis Management Team (CMT) contact details strictly up to date, while supporting business continuity and IT Disaster Recovery (ITDR) processes.
  • TPRM & SRM Support: Guiding First Line Service Relationship Managers through third-party due diligence, ongoing risk assessments, supplier performance reviews, and training.
  • Scenario Testing: Facilitating operational resilience scenario testing to spot potential vulnerabilities and track remediation plans.
  • Process Automation & Continuous Improvement: Spotting opportunities to enhance data quality, streamline due diligence, and automate manual processes across our resilience frameworks.

What do we need from you?

  • Background or exposure in Financial Services, retail banking, building societies, or a similarly regulated environment.
  • A foundational understanding of UK regulatory expectations surrounding Operational Resilience and TPRM.
  • Proven capability to map, analyse, and document complex operational, technical, or business workflows.
  • Clear written and numerical capability to turn complex data into clear dashboards, reports, and committee presentations
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build collaborative working relationships across diverse business functions.
  • A highly structured approach with strong attention to detail and data accuracy under time constraints.

What will you get from us?

  • Salary of £30k
  • Flexible hybrid working in Newcastle
  • 4-day work week
  • Incredibly generous company pension scheme (maximum of 13% of Atom input – candidate can put in more)
  • 22.5 days annual leave plus public holiday
  • Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan, Life Insurance & Critical illness cover
  • £200 “All about me” fund
  • EV Scheme

description:

Job Description


Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.


The Role

The Data Platform Engineer will ensure Norton Rose Fulbright’s enterprise data platform is a stable, secure and supportable IT service. The platform is built on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and associated Azure services, supports the firm's strategic data capability across EMEA and EMEAPAC, and is governed through Terraform, Azure DevOps and a standardised deployment framework. 

The role is hands-on and service-focused. It provides the operational foundation needed to keep the platform reliable, observable, governed and ready for controlled production use. Its emphasis is on platform health, support processes, quality assurance, release readiness, incident response and continual service improvement. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Architecture, Information Security, Service Delivery, Infrastructure, suppliers and consuming business teams to ensure  platform changes are deployed safely through established CI/CD processes, supported by appropriate monitoring, operational controls, documentation and governance standards. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 operational support for Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and associated Azure services.
  • Maintain platform health, availability, resilience, and supportability across the data platform estate.
  • Perform routine platform administration, operational checks, and capacity and utilisation monitoring.
  • Monitor platform performance, identify optimisation opportunities, and maintain cost awareness.
  • Troubleshoot issues across platform, identity, networking, storage, security, and integration layers.
  • Manage incidents, problems, and service requests in line with established ITSM processes.
  • Investigate and resolve operational issues, ensuring timely restoration of service.
  • Support major incident response activities where platform services are impacted.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis and implement actions to improve platform stability and reduce issue recurrence.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to deliver effective operational support.
  • Support change, release, and environment management activities across the platform estate.
  • Maintain release readiness checklists and operational acceptance criteria.
  • Validate platform changes prior to production deployment to ensure supportability and risk controls are in place.
  • Support the management of Development, Test, and Production environments.
  • Ensure configuration consistency across environments and platform services.
  • Contribute to CI/CD, version control, and release automation practices for platform assets.
  • Promote operational excellence through continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and robust documentation.

Quality, Monitoring and Governance

A key part of the role is to define and execute operational QA checks for platform changes, integrations and supplier-delivered components. The engineer will verify that monitoring, alerting, logging, access controls, runbooks, escalation routes and support processes are in place before production release. They will support service acceptance and transition activity, assessing readiness against availability, recoverability, supportability, security and control requirements. 

The role will implement and maintain monitoring, alerting and observability across Fabric, Databricks and Azure services. It will develop service health reporting, operational dashboards and exception monitoring, and maintain runbooks, known error records, support documentation and knowledge articles. The engineer will contribute to service reviews, operational assurance and continual improvement. 

The role will support governance, security and compliance by assisting with access control, role management, privileged access processes, audit evidence, metadata, lineage, auditability

title: Chief AI Engineer
description:
Overview AI is already making a real impact at Chambers and Partners, with solutions running in production across our editorial, research, product and commercial teams. We’re now looking for a Chief AI Engineer to lead our AI engineering function, own the technical direction of AI across the business and shape the next stage of our AI transformation.

This is a deeply technical leadership role. You’ll be part of the Senior Leadership Team and be the final technical authority on how we build, evaluate, deploy and run AI: the AI architecture, modelling choices, engineering standards and evaluation discipline the team works to. You’ll have taken AI systems end to end many times over, from ideation and discovery through to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement, and you’ll stay close enough to the code to solve the hardest problems yourself.

Alongside this, you’ll help set our AI strategy and roadmap, advise our Executive Leadership Team on where AI creates the greatest value, and represent Chambers as a credible voice on AI in the legal market. Around 70% of the role is hands-on technical leadership and delivery; around 30% is strategic. Main Duties and Responsibilities

Technical leadership and delivery (c.70%) 

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI solutions, from ideation, discovery and scoping through experimentation, production deployment, monitoring and iteration, measuring their impact against agreed business outcomes. 
  • Act as the technical design authority for AI, setting direction across architecture, model selection, data and retrieval strategies, fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment, and making the hard calls on whether to build, buy or not use AI at all. 
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, review code, pair on the hardest problems and personally lead the design of business-critical AI systems. 
  • Design scalable, secure and maintainable AI solutions in partnership with our Technology and Data Platform teams. 
  • Define and own evaluation frameworks for ML, LLM and GenAI outputs, covering accuracy, consistency, bias mitigation and regression testing, so that everything we release meets Chambers’ standards for rigour and independence. 
  • Establish production discipline across MLOps and LLMOps: experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring, drift management, observability and safe, structured and streamlined deployment. 
  • Lead, mentor and develop our AI engineering team, hiring strong engineers, raising the technical bar and creating an environment where people do their best work. Ensure high quality engineering practices, including code review and safe, structured and streamline deployment. 
  • Run delivery across multiple concurrent AI workstreams, managing cross-team dependencies with Product, Research, Commercial, Data and Technology teams. 


Strategic leadership (c.30%) 

  • Shape and own the AI strategy and roadmap with the Chief Data and AI Officer, aligned with Chambers’ business and data strategies. 
  • Act as a senior adviser to the Executive Leadership Team on AI opportunities, risks and trade-offs, translating complex technical choices into clear, commercially grounded decisions. 
  • Establish prioritisation frameworks that balance innovation, research integrity, risk and commercial impact, and identify where AI can power new products, features and services. 
  • Partner with Research leadership to augment expert judgement with AI, improving the consistency, scalability and depth of our research outcomes. 
  • Keep Chambers ahead of developments in AI, evaluate and manage strategic partnerships with AI vendors and platforms, and represent Chambers externally as a credible voice on AI in legal market intelligence. 
Why you should apply

This is a highly technical role with a seat on our senior leadership team. You won’t be advising on AI from the sidelines. You’ll sit alongside the leaders who set the direction of the business, bring a genuine engineering perspective to decisions about where we invest and how we compete, and see those decisions through to delivery. 

Few organisations can offer data like ours. More than 350,000 research interviews and surveys a year, and a deep, proprietary view of the global legal market, create problems that can’t be solved off the shelf. That’s a real chance to build AI that is genuinely differentiated, not a thin layer over someone else’s model, for a professional audience that relies on it being right. 

You’ll have the autonomy to set the standards, build the team and choose the approach, and the backing to make it happen. If you want senior-level influence without giving up the hard technical work, this is the role. 

Skills, Experience & Personal Attributes

We’re looking for a Chief AI Engineer leader who has come up through data science, machine learning or software engineering and who combines deep modelling expertise with production engineering excellence. You’ll have taken many AI systems from ideation through to production and monitoring, and gone on to lead engineering teams and influence at senior leadership level. You’ll combine deep technical credibility with the gravitas to earn the confidence of engineers and senior leaders alike. 

You’ll bring: 

Essential 

  • Significant experience in senior applied AI, ML or data science leadership roles, with a track record of owning AI end to end (ideation, discovery, experimentation, production deployment, monitoring and iteration) across multiple systems that delivered measurable business outcomes. 

  • A data science foundation, applied for outcomes: framing the business question, setting baselines, choosing the right metric and delivering measurable results rather than just models. This comes with statistical rigour: experimental design, sound validation, and an instinct for leakage, bias and overfitting in messy real-world data. 

  • Strong ML fundamentals across classical ML and deep learning (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, PyTorch), and the judgement to tell when a language model is the wrong tool. 

  • A deep understanding of how modern models are built, not only how they’re used: transformer architectures, pre-training and post-training methods (SFT, RLHF/DPO) and evaluation methodology. You will have fine-tuned models yourself, for example with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT/LoRA, TRL), and can explain from first principles why a system fails. 

NLP depth on long-form professional text: class

167Solutions is a specialist technology recruitment partner, connecting talented professionals with organisations delivering innovative and business-critical technology initiatives.

167Solutions is partnering with a leading global organisation to recruit an experienced AI / LLM Engineer for an exciting new Generative AI Innovation Lab.

This is a unique opportunity to join a small, highly skilled team at the forefront of applied artificial intelligence, exploring how generative AI can transform digital products, content experiences and customer engagement.

You'll play a key role in building, fine-tuning and deploying LLM-powered systems, with a particular focus on tone and style alignment, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multimodal AI, including audio and voice technologies.

This is a genuine zero-to-one engineering opportunity, where you'll have the freedom to experiment, innovate and take ideas from early prototypes through to working products used by a global audience.

As one of the first engineers joining this dedicated innovation team, you'll work closely with technical, design and product leadership to shape the direction of cutting-edge AI initiatives.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, moving quickly and building innovative experiences across text, voice and visual interfaces, this could be an excellent next step.


What you'll be doing:

  • LLM Fine-Tuning: Fine-tune large language models for tone, style and domain-specific applications.
  • Dataset Engineering: Design, curate and manage high-quality datasets for fine-tuning, including annotation, versioning and data preparation workflows.
  • RAG Development: Build, optimise and evaluate retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using structured and unstructured data.
  • Voice & Audio AI: Prototype and test text-to-speech (TTS) and speech-to-text (STT) pipelines using technologies such as ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS and Whisper.
  • AI Prototyping: Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, frontend and design teams to develop innovative AI-powered tools and applications.
  • Model Evaluation: Develop and own evaluation frameworks using BLEU, ROUGE, custom metrics and human-in-the-loop feedback.
  • Product Innovation: Support experimentation with real-time generation, summarisation, personalisation and intelligent content delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product teams, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to define quality standards and deliver meaningful AI solutions.


What we're looking for:

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a genuine passion for exploring what's possible with Generative AI.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years' experience developing solutions using LLMs, NLP or Generative AI technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with leading models and platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Cohere, Mistral or Hugging Face.
  • Experience with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), prompt tuning or instruction tuning using proprietary datasets.
  • Strong understanding of LLM fine-tuning approaches, including SFT and the principles of RLHF/RLAIF.
  • Excellent Python development skills.
  • Experience with frameworks and tools such as LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, Pandas, DVC or Weights & Biases.
  • Knowledge of model evaluation techniques, including BLEU, ROUGE and custom evaluation frameworks.
  • Exposure to speech technologies, including Whisper, ElevenLabs, Bark or similar platforms.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A proactive, experimental mindset and the confidence to operate in an evolving technical environment.


Desirable Experience:

  • Strong candidates may also bring experience in:
  • Fine-tuning LLMs for specific personas, communication styles or domain-specific use cases.
  • LangSmith or similar LLM observability and testing platforms.
  • Voice synthesis, voice cloning or emotion-conditioned audio generation.
  • AI applications within digital media, content platforms or other customer-facing environments.
  • Multimodal AI solutions combining text, image and audio.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
  • Responsible AI, model governance and the ethical considerations surrounding AI-generated content.


What makes this role particularly exciting:

  • Early-stage influence: Join as one of the founding engineers and help shape the technical direction.
  • Genuine innovation: Work on exploratory, high-impact AI projects rather than simply maintaining existing systems.
  • Modern AI stack: Gain hands-on exposure to the latest LLMs, fine-tuning approaches, RAG architectures and multimodal technologies.
  • End-to-end ownership: Take ideas from concept and experimentation through to real-world implementation.
  • Collaborative environment: Work directly with senior technical, product and design specialists.
  • Global impact: Build solutions with the potential to reach and influence a substantial international audience.


Want to find out more:

If you're an experienced AI / LLM Engineer looking to work at the cutting edge of Generative AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply directly through 167Solutions for a confidential discussion about the role, the team and the opportunity.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Our client is looking for an experienced Data Engineer with a strong eye towards solution architecture. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building robust data solutions but is also comfortable looking beyond individual pipelines or features to consider how the overall platform should be designed, governed and evolved.

The role is 3 days (Tues-Thurs) in central Bristol and 2 days remote.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of significant technical problems, translate business requirements into well-designed solutions, and help establish the architectural and engineering standards that allow our data platform to scale. The successful candidate will be an experienced engineer first and foremost, with the capability and ambition to take increasing responsibility for solution and data architecture.

Key responsibilities:

•Design, build and maintain reliable end-to-end data pipelines and data-processing solutions.

•Write high-quality production code, principally using Python and SQL.

•Design solutions using modern data-stack technologies (Snowflake here but any data platform) and appropriate cloud infrastructure.

•Take ownership of the architecture for significant areas of our data platform.

•Translate business and product requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.

•Make pragmatic architectural decisions balancing scalability, performance, security, maintainability and cost.

•Establish and maintain clear architectural documentation, engineering standards and design principles.

•Implement and improve CI/CD processes, automated testing and deployment controls.

•Design appropriate security, permissions and access-control mechanisms across data and cloud environments.

•Apply appropriate data-modelling methodologies across data lakes, warehouses and analytical datasets.

•Establish and enforce standards for data lineage, operational metadata, data quality and observability.

•Ensure automated testing and quality controls are built into pipelines, including appropriate gating of pipeline operations and deployments.

•Implement monitoring and alerting that allows data and platform issues to be identified and resolved quickly.

•Lead and contribute to technical and architectural design discussions.

•Review the work and designs of other engineers and help maintain high engineering standards.

•Mentor less experienced engineers and support their technical development.

•Work closely with Research, Product and other business teams to ensure technical solutions meet real business requirements.

Technical experience

We are looking for strong experience in the following areas:

Programming

Strong Python and SQL skills are essential. Experience with other programming languages is beneficial.

Data engineering

Proven experience designing, building and operating production-grade data pipelines end to end.

Modern data stack

Experience with modern ELT, transformation and orchestration technologies. Our environment includes technologies such as dbt, Dagster/Airflow and Snowflake, although experience with comparable technologies is equally relevant.

Cloud infrastructure

Experience designing and implementing secure, scalable solutions on a major cloud platform. We use AWS, but strong GCP or Azure experience is transferable.

CI/CD and testing

Experience implementing CI/CD practices, automated testing, deployment processes and release controls within data or software engineering environments.

Data architecture and modelling

Strong understanding of data architecture and advanced data-modelling approaches across data lakes, warehouses and analytical platforms.

Security and access control

Experience implementing appropriate security, permissions, role-based access and data-access controls.

Data governance and observability

Experience implementing frameworks for data lineage, metadata management, data-quality monitoring and observability.

Solution architecture

We do not require someone whose current job title is Solution Architect. We are particularly interested in experienced engineers who naturally think architecturally: people who consider how individual engineering decisions fit into the wider platform and who can take increasing ownership of technical design.

You should be comfortable:

•Owning the design of substantial technical solutions.

•Producing clear technical and architectural documentation.

•Defining and enforcing engineering and architectural standards.

•Evaluating alternative technical approaches and explaining the trade-offs.

•Designing for security, resilience, maintainability and future scale.

•Leading technical design discussions with other engineers.

•Communicating technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Personal qualities

We are looking for someone who:

•Remains genuinely hands-on and enjoys engineering.

•Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed technical instructions.

•Can move comfortably between detailed engineering problems and higher-level system design.

•Is pragmatic rather than dogmatic about technologies and architecture.

•Communicates complex technical concepts clearly.

•Is comfortable challenging existing approaches where there is a better solution.

•Enjoys coaching and developing other engineers.

•Values documentation, testing and engineering discipline.

•Can work effectively across technical, product, research and commercial teams.

What we are looking for

The ideal candidate is likely to be an established Senior Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer or similarly experienced engineer who is ready to take greater ownership of solution architecture.

We are not looking for a pure enterprise architect or someone who has moved away from hands-on engineering. Equally, we need more than a strong developer who is focused solely on implementing predefined solutions. The right person will combine strong engineering capability with architectural thinking, technical ownership and the ability to raise engineering standards across the team.

title: SOC Platform Engineer (AI, Wazuh, Graylog and Linux)
description:
This is a security engineering job without an alert queue. First and second line analysis in our Security Operations Centre is carried out by Emily, our AI analyst, who has been in production since 2018. You will run the platform she depends on and take the cases she cannot close herself, which are the awkward and interesting ones.

You will work directly with our Head of Threat Disruption, who built the platform, has thirty years in the field and wants you to be able to do everything he can do. Your first year is a structured training year. We do not expect you to know Wazuh, our estate or Emily on your first day. We expect you to be curious, careful and hard to fool, and by the end of the year we expect you to run the platform and handle Emily's escalations without needing to ask.

What you will do

You will operate a multi-tenant Wazuh estate and the Graylog and OpenSearch logging tier behind it, on hardened Ubuntu hosts in our own data centre and in the cloud. You will write and tune decoders and detection rules, map them to MITRE ATT&CK, and bring new client log sources on board, from endpoint agents and firewalls to cloud tenants and Microsoft Sentinel.

You will investigate what Emily escalates, close what you can and hand over what you cannot with a clear account of your findings. When something breaks you will find out why, properly, and write it up so that it stays fixed. You will speak to clients directly by telephone, on Teams and in chat, walking their IT staff through an installation or explaining in plain language what an alert means.

Over time you will take ownership of parts of the platform, of the monitoring that watches it, and of our Cyber Essentials Plus and Defence Cyber Certification work.

What you need

You need strong, practical Linux administration on Ubuntu or a comparable distribution, including systemd, networking, storage and TLS, and you should be at home in the shell all day. You need enough Bash and Python/PHP/Pearl to automate operational tasks safely, and confidence with regular expressions. You should understand how a log travels from its source to a searchable index.

You should diagnose methodically under pressure, verify rather than assume, and be able to write a clear summary in plain English afterwards. You should be able to take direct technical challenge without taking it personally and give it back with the same honesty. You should build things hardened by default. You must be comfortable with clients, including when the news is unwelcome.

You must have the right to work in the United Kingdom without sponsorship and be willing to undergo background checks to BPSS level.

Useful, and we will teach it if you lack it

Experience of Wazuh, Elastic, OpenSearch, Graylog, Splunk or Security Onion in production is welcome, as is familiarity with HAProxy, Nagios or Zabbix, Microsoft Sentinel, MySQL and PHP, and time spent at a managed service provider. Certifications and involvement in the security community are of interest to us, but neither is required.

Out of hours

Out of hours, Emily keeps watching, and she needs a human about once or twice a month. Cover is shared equally across the team, which today means alternate weeks with the Head of Threat Disruption, and you join the rota only once you have been trained and have shadowed it. You receive an allowance for each week you cover, and any time you work is paid on top. If you are called out at night, you start late the next day.

The arrangement

The role is permanent, full-time at 40 hours a week and fully remote within the United Kingdom, working UK office hours. We provide the equipment you need. Holiday entitlement is 25 days per year plus up to 10 days per year for conference attendance.

This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys getting into the detail of complex datasets, solving data problems and translating analysis into practical business outcomes.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex datasets.
  • Proficiency in Python, particularly for analytical modelling and predictive analytics.

  • A good understanding of data modelling principles, ideally including star schemas and dimensional modelling.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
One definition of every metric. One version of the truth. Join Protein Works as our Analytics Engineer and build the numbers a fast-growing brand runs on.


You will own what happens to data once it lands in our data warehouse, including transformation in Dataform, modelling, the semantic layer, and the reporting the business runs on. This is one of two engineering roles we are hiring into the Business Intelligence team. Our Data Engineer will own the platform and everything that gets data into it, including ingestion, orchestration, infrastructure, security and cost. The two roles share a lot of the same skills and will naturally overlap, but ownership of each part of the platform is clear.


We are rolling out safe, self-serve AI analytics so teams can answer many of their own questions rather than raise a ticket. That only works if the models behind it reflect how the business wants to measure itself, and every metric means one thing.


What you will be doing

  • Own the transformation layer in Dataform end to end: the models, dependency graph, tests and documentation between raw BigQuery data and everything the business sees.
  • Build the semantic layer that gives revenue, margin, customer and order one definition, read by every report and every AI tool.
  • Own our Looker Studio reporting, from executive dashboards to the self-serve datasets our analysts and the wider business build on.
  • Shape safe, self-serve AI analytics by structuring and documenting models so AI tools answer standard questions reliably, and deciding where the boundaries sit.
  • Partner with marketing, trading, operations and finance to work out what they really need to measure, then turn it into models that answer it.
  • Drive data quality with tests and checks that catch problems before they reach a report, and agree contracts and conventions with our Data Engineer.


Ideal Candidate

  • Proven analytics engineering experience, with production models you've built that other people depend on.
  • Excellent SQL and hands-on Dataform or dbt (testing and documentation included), ideally on BigQuery, with an eye for cost as well as correctness.
  • Strong data modelling: you can take a messy source system, shape something the business can use, and explain why you built it that way.
  • Experience with a semantic layer or shared metric definitions, plus reporting in Looker Studio, Looker or a similar BI tool, all in a Git and CI/CD workflow.
  • You turn a vague business question into a working model without waiting for a spec, and you explain your thinking clearly to non-technical teams.
  • You hold a high bar for detail and you're always sharpening how you work, AI tooling included. Python, ecommerce or DTC experience, or Google's marketing stack are a bonus.


Nice to have

  • Python for tooling, testing or automation
  • Familiarity with Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler or infrastructure-as-code
  • Experience implementing or evaluating self-serve AI analytics tooling
  • Comfort with vector databases, embeddings or semantic search
  • Working knowledge of Google's marketing stack, including Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and Google Search Console
  • Experience in ecommerce, DTC or retail


What success looks like

Success will be measured in three ways:
  • Accurate, consistent numbers the business trusts
  • Teams answering their own standard questions without raising a ticket
  • Decisions across marketing, trading, operations and finance made on modelled, consistent data


What you will get

  • Exclusive staff discounts
  • Private healthcare
  • Birthday day off
  • Pension scheme
  • Unique bonus scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Access to retail discounts
  • Staff socials and events
  • State of the art PW Campus
  • WFH on Fridays
  • Refreshments on-site


About Protein Works

We were founded in 2012 on a clear conviction: the sports nutrition industry had become complacent, and there was a better way to do it. Over a decade later, we are a £50m business with five consecutive years of double-digit growth, a brand new £10m campus in Liverpool, and ambitions that go well beyond where we are today.


We are a brand, a retailer, a manufacturer and a fulfilment operation. All in-house, all under one roof. That breadth is deliberate. It gives our people exposure and influence that most businesses simply cannot offer, and it gives us a platform to scale in a way that few companies in this space can match.


We are growing, investing and hiring with purpose. If you want to join a business with the energy of a challenger and the foundations of a market leader, this is the right moment to do it.

title: Enterprise AI Architect

  • Exposure to knowledge management, knowledge graphs or advanced search systems integrated with AI solutions.
  • Experience in designing AI solutions for customer experience, contact centres, or frontline operations.
  • Previous involvement in building AI roadmaps or strategic AI initiatives within large organisations.

Qualifications:

If you are ready to shape an enterprise AI roadmap and deliver high-impact solutions in a fixed-term role, we welcome your application.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
Senior Applied AI EngineerContract
Outside IR35 £700 - £900 per day DOE
6 months + likely extension
Oxfordshire (hybrid - 2 days p/w on site)

Our client is a rapidly scaling UK deep-tech company delivering advanced agentic AI capability. This role sits in their AI team, working with a commercial customer in biotech and pharma. They are hiring a Senior Applied AI Engineer to take ownership of the agentic AI systems underpinning their platform, on a contract basis, with genuine influence over how those systems are architected and delivered.

This role suits an engineer who designs and ships systems rather than assembling pre-built components, someone who cares more about how a system performs once it's live and under pressure than how impressive it looks in a demo.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Architecting and building multi-agent AI systems end-to-end, combining frameworks such as LangGraph or Haystack where they add value with bespoke orchestration, state management and tool-calling logic where a framework won't cut it
  • Writing production-grade code with reliability, latency and graceful failure handling designed in from the start rather than bolted on afterwards
  • Embedding LLMs and vision-language models into live reasoning, search, summarisation and task-execution workflows, backed by solid retrieval, memory and guardrail design
  • Deploying across cloud and on-premises environments, adapting your approach to each environment's security and connectivity constraints
  • Taking end-to-end ownership of production pipelines, from raw data ingestion through to live inference
  • Building the monitoring, evaluation and guardrail tooling that shows how a system is actually performing in the field
  • Setting technical standards for agentic AI within the team, establishing the patterns other engineers follow and leaving clear documentation behind

What We're Looking For

  • Robust software engineering, including developing LLM-powered or agentic systems, and a track record operating at senior/lead level
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: code that's clean, tested and built to last, not just prototypes that work once
  • Commercial track record building and owning multi-agent or agentic AI systems in live production settings, as an engineer rather than an integrator
  • Strong Python skills, comfortable working with LangGraph, LangChain, Haystack or similar, and equally comfortable dropping below the framework when that's the right call
  • Real-world experience deploying AI/ML systems into production, beyond notebooks and proof-of-concepts
  • Confidence across inference performance, data pipeline design, state/memory handling, and tool or function calling
  • Experience building retrieval and search over very large, multi-modal datasets, including indexing and embedding at scale
  • Comfortable with Docker, Git and cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS
  • Understanding of secure deployment approaches, including on-premises and sovereign cloud

Nice to Have

  • Biotech, pharma or life sciences domain experience
  • Multimodal reasoning experience
  • Kubernetes experience (EKS or OpenShift)
  • MLOps background: evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility
  • Observability for agentic systems, covering drift, agent behaviour and performance
  • Familiarity with agent-to-agent orchestration protocols or the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Awareness of secure-by-design frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP)
  • Open-source AI/ML contributions

Why Apply

  • Real technical ownership: shape the architecture, not just work through a backlog
  • Work at the leading edge of agentic and generative AI, on systems people genuinely depend on
  • Join a fast-scaling business with a strong chance of the contract extending or evolving further
  • Strong day rate reflecting seniority and scope

title: Engineering Manager, AI
description:
Job Title: Engineering Manager, AI

Company: 167 Solutions

Location: Hybrid (UK ONLY)

Salary: £150,000 – £170,000 per annum

Contract Type: Permanent

Experience Level: Minimum 5 years' experience

Start Date: ASAP


The Opportunity:

167Solutions is partnering with a globally recognised media and information services organisation to recruit an Engineering Manager – Applied AI & Data Science.

Our client is at the forefront of digital innovation, investing heavily in artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science to transform how millions of people access and interact with trusted information.

The role combines people leadership, technical architecture and hands-on engineering, with a particular focus on generative AI, agentic systems, LLMOps and AI-native software development.

You'll play a key role in shaping the organisation's AI capabilities, delivering production-grade AI systems and driving the adoption of modern AI engineering practices.


The Role:

As Engineering Manager, you will lead the Applied AI and Data Science team, taking ownership of technical delivery, team development and engineering standards while remaining actively involved in designing and building AI solutions.

You will work closely with senior AI leadership, product managers, data engineers and business stakeholders to translate ambitious AI initiatives into scalable, secure and commercially valuable solutions.

The team's work spans large language models, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language processing, predictive modelling and shared AI platform capabilities.


What You'll Do:

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary AI team, providing day-to-day management, mentorship, technical guidance and career development for AI/ML Engineers, NLP Engineers and Data Scientists.
  • Own technical delivery, managing priorities, resources and engineering commitments while balancing rapid experimentation with production requirements.
  • Remain hands-on, contributing Python code, reviewing models and implementations, prototyping solutions and supporting complex technical challenges.
  • Shape AI architecture, guiding the design and development of agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines, NLP solutions and machine learning applications.
  • Build safe and reliable AI agents, implementing appropriate guardrails, tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls and end-to-end evaluation.
  • Drive AI-native software engineering, introducing and scaling the use of tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot across development, testing and code review.
  • Establish engineering best practices, covering LLMOps, MLOps, CI/CD, automated evaluation, observability, security, performance and cost optimisation.
  • Work extensively with AWS AI services, including Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, Lambda and Step Functions.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Technical Lead with direct people-management responsibility for AI Engineers, ML Engineers, NLP Engineers or Data Scientists.
  • Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering background, with advanced Python skills and experience developing production-grade AI systems.
  • Experience designing and building LLM-powered and agentic AI applications, including RAG, NLP and traditional machine learning solutions.
  • Practical experience with modern agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Strands Agents or Claude Agent SDK, alongside interoperability standards including MCP and A2A.
  • Strong AWS cloud engineering experience, particularly Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, Lambda and Step Functions, with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMOps and MLOps, including model and agent evaluation, trajectory testing, tracing, observability, guardrails and cost monitoring.
  • Understanding of AI security challenges, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions and appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants and agents, such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to establish engineering standards for AI-generated code, context engineering, automated testing and AI-assisted development.


Desirable Experience:

  • Experience building and operating production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, agent memory, MCP-based tool integration and agentic RAG.
  • Strong NLP expertise, including semantic search, summarisation, information extraction, classification or LLM fine-tuning.
  • Experience developing shared AI platforms, internal MCP servers or reusable AI capabilities used by multiple engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of vector search technologies such as OpenSearch, Amazon S3 Vectors or pgvector.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, regulatory considerations and responsible AI development practices.


Why Join Us:

This is an opportunity to take a leading role in a major AI transformation programme within a globally established, highly respected organisation.

You'll be working on meaningful AI initiatives with the potential to impact millions of users, while helping shape the technical direction and engineering culture of a growing Applied AI and Data Science function.

The position offers a rare combination of hands-on technical ownership, people leadership and strategic influence, giving you the opportunity to work with cutting-edge agentic AI technologies while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

If you're an experienced AI Engineering Manager who wants to remain close to the technology, lead talented engineers and data scientists, and help deliver the next generation of AI-powered products, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Up to £65,000

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Data Engineer to join an organisation undertaking a significant transformation of its data and analytics landscape.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and building the foundations of a scalable, cloud-based data estate. Working within a growing data function, you will help develop the pipelines, frameworks and governance capabilities needed to deliver data across the business.

This position offers the opportunity to work with modern technologies including Azure Databricks, contributing to both the migration programme and the long-term evolution of the data platform. You will be involved in everything from designing robust data solutions and engineering high-quality datasets through to establishing best practices and improving platform performance.

For engineers who enjoy solving complex data challenges, building modern data platforms and driving meaningful change through technology, this role offers the chance to make a genuine impact while working on a large-scale transformation programme.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the migration from a legacy SQL-based environment to Azure Databricks.
  • Designing and developing scalable data solutions using Databricks, Python and PySpark.
  • Building and maintaining robust data pipelines, transformation frameworks and curated data layers.
  • Implementing governance, security and data management best practices through Unity Catalog.
  • Optimising data models and datasets to support analytics, reporting and self-service BI requirements.
  • Working with stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver trusted, accessible data products.
  • Contributing to data architecture decisions and promoting modern engineering standards and best practices.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks.
  • Experience building data pipelines using Python and/or PySpark.
  • Understanding of Delta Lake, lakehouse architectures and modern data platform design.
  • Experience working with Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
  • Strong SQL development, optimisation and data modelling expertise.
  • Experience working within Azure data environments and modern cloud-based data platforms.

What's On Offer?

  • Up to £65,000 salary.
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Opportunity to play a key role in a large-scale Databricks migration programme.
  • Ongoing professional development and certification support.
  • Chance to influence the future direction of the organisation's data platform.

If you are looking to work with Azure Databricks at scale and be part of a major modernisation programme, this role offers the chance to develop your skills while making a tangible impact across the organisation.

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
The Team & Focus of the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Quality Engineer to establish, maintain, and enhance the organisation's data architecture, governance, and quality frameworks. This role will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring that business-critical data is trusted, well-documented, traceable, and fit for purpose across all systems and platforms.

The successful candidate will act as the primary owner of key data management artefacts including authoritative source registers, data lineage documentation, data dictionaries, reference data standards, integration registers, and data quality controls. They will work closely with business stakeholders, system owners, application teams, and data consumers to drive consistency, transparency, and confidence in enterprise data assets.

They will also need to align commonly accepted industry data quality practices to the diverse property management operations of the organisation, requiring a flexible approach and ability to work with the business.

In return, beyond your base salary you will be included in:

  • A discretionary bonus scheme
  • A generous holiday scheme which commences at 25 days with a sliding scale up to 30 days plus an additional day for your birthday, and additional days to cover the festive period!
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave
  • An online money saving portal
  • Death In Service cover, alongside access to an Employee Assistance Programme which includes health appoints for you and your family
  • Volunteering Leave equating to 2 days per year (pro rata if you’re part-time)

Duties will include:

  • Own and maintain the Authoritative (Golden) Source Register, ensuring trusted sources of business data are clearly identified and governed.
  • Develop and maintain system and application mapping documentation showing how data is created, consumed, and managed across the organisation.
  • Create and maintain end-to-end data lineage documentation to provide transparency of data movement, transformation, and consumption.
  • Create and maintain enterprise Data Dictionaries containing technical and business definitions for key data elements.
  • Define data quality rules and set precise metrics for accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness.
  • Define and implement data quality rules, validation controls, and quality thresholds for critical data assets.
  • Profile and cleanse data analyse data structures to spot anomalies, missing fields, or format errors, and design sanitation processes
  • Develop automated monitoring and reporting processes to measure data quality performance.
  • Partner with business data owners, system owners, and operational teams to improve enterprise data management practices.
  • Support data governance initiatives and compliance requirements through the maintenance of accurate data artefacts and controls.
  • Provide guidance and training to colleagues on data standards, lineage, quality management, and governance processes.

The successful candidate will have...

  • Experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Engineering or related disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, and integration concepts.
  • Experience documenting data lineage, data flows, and system relationships.
  • Knowledge of data quality frameworks, controls, and monitoring techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data dictionaries and metadata repositories.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working with data warehouses, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Desirable

  • Experience with data cataloguing or lineage tools.
  • Knowledge of Snowflake, AWS Glue and Power BI.
  • Knowledge of different database management systems and strategies.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK.
  • Experience supporting regulatory and compliance requirements relating to data management.

We’re working with a growing retail business that’s investing heavily in data and looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join the team.

This isn’t a role where you’ll spend all day building reports and moving on to the next request. They’re looking for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of the data, spotting patterns, understanding what’s driving performance, and helping the business make better decisions as a result.

You’ll work with teams across the business, looking at everything from customer behaviour and sales performance through to operational and commercial trends. The goal is to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations that genuinely influence decision-making.

You’ll still be hands-on with SQL and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, but the real value in this role comes from your ability to interpret the data, tell the story behind it and drive action from your findings.

As the business continues to grow, so will the role. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their analytics career who wants exposure to stakeholders, the chance to influence decisions, and a clear development path.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Analysing customer, sales and commercial data to identify trends and opportunities
  • Producing insights that help teams make better business decisions
  • Turning analysis into clear recommendations and actionable next steps
  • Building and maintaining dashboards and reports in Power BI
  • Writing SQL queries to extract and analyse data
  • Working closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges and answer key questions
  • Presenting findings in a way that is easy for non-technical teams to understand
  • Continuously looking for ways to improve reporting, analysis and decision-making across the business

What they’re looking for:

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience creating dashboards and visualisations in Power BI, Tableau or a similar tool
  • Pyhton would be a bonus
  • Someone who enjoys analysing data and uncovering the “why” behind the numbers
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders
  • A naturally curious mindset and genuine passion for data
  • The ability to translate analysis into meaningful business recommendations
  • Previous experience in a Data Analyst, Insight Analyst or Reporting Analyst role

Why apply?

  • Salary up to £45K DOE
  • Hybrid working in Manchester, 2 days per week
  • Discounted products/services
  • Health and wellness benefits
  • L&D support
  • Pension
  • Company socials
  • Join a business that genuinely values data-driven decision making
  • Lots of exposure to senior stakeholders
  • Opportunity to shape how insights are used across the business
  • Clear progression as the team and function continue to grow

This role would suit someone who has strong SQL experience and ideally experience with visualisation tools, i.e. Power BI, Tableau or similar. Equally, you’ll be excited by speaking to stakeholders, understanding business problems and using data to influence decisions. The technical side matters, but attitude, curiosity and commercial thinking are just as important.

*You must be based in the Northwest and have commercial experience in an Analyst role. No sponsorship is available for this role*

title: Senior Data Product Manager
description:
Senior Data Product Manager, Prototyping & Innovation
We are currently recruiting for a Senior Data Product Manager with Broking experience to join one of our Insurance clients on a 6-month contract.
Inside IR35
Hybrid- 2 days a week onsite in London
Key responsibilities

  • Work with business stakeholders and domain specialists to understand decisions, workflows, pain points, and opportunities that could be addressed through data products.
  • Convert broad or ambiguous challenges into clear problem statements, target users, desired outcomes, hypotheses, and measurable product objectives.
  • Assess product opportunities based on business value, user need, data readiness, technical feasibility, scalability, and alignment with the broader data-product portfolio.
  • Identify when a request should become a reusable product and when a simpler analytical or process solution is more appropriate.
  • Personally build working proofs of concept using tools such as SQL, Python, Databricks, Power BI, AI tooling, and appropriate low-code platforms.
  • Explore and profile data to understand quality, coverage, structure, limitations, and suitability for the intended use case.
  • Use prototypes to test product concepts with users, expose assumptions, and generate evidence before significant engineering investment.
  • Work with data engineers, architects, analysts, and platform specialists to determine how successful prototypes should be industrialised.
  • Ensure prototype work is appropriately transitioned into maintainable, governed, and scalable solutions rather than becoming unsupported production tooling.
  • Own selected data products from discovery through prototype, development, launch, adoption, and improvement.
  • Partner closely with engineering while retaining clear accountability for the problem, user outcome, and product value.

Experience

  • 5-8+ years of relevant experience across data, analytics, technology, or digital products, including substantial ownership of data-enabled products or solutions.
  • Strong evidence of solving ambiguous business problems and converting them into practical, evidence-based solutions.
  • Hands-on ability to interrogate data and build working prototypes using several of SQL, Python, Databricks, Power BI, AI tooling, or low-code tools.
  • Commercial insurance, insurance broking, specialty insurance, claims, placement, portfolio analytics, or underwriting experience.
  • Experience with data mesh, domain-oriented data products, common data models, data contracts, metadata, and data governance.
  • Experience industrialising analytical prototypes with data-engineering and architecture teams.
  • Experience integrating generative AI or machine learning into business products.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments and the responsible use of commercially sensitive data.

title: Trainee AI Programmer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Commercial Finance Analyst
description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.

We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Commercial Finance Analyst to join our wider Finance Business Partnering team. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional who wants to accelerate their career in commercial finance and develop into a Finance Business Partner.

Working closely with sales and marketing leaders across a global business, you will provide high-quality analysis, reporting and forecasting to support decision-making and improve performance. A significant focus will be on sales and marketing performance, revenue drivers, return on investment and the development of Power BI reporting that gives stakeholders clear, actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Commercial Finance and Business Partnering
  • Support sales, marketing and operational leaders with financial analysis and commercial insight that aids decision-making and performance improvement.
  • Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business and become a trusted source of financial information and analysis.
  • Participate in business reviews and performance discussions, helping stakeholders understand results and the underlying drivers.
  • Support commercial initiatives through analysis, constructive challenge and clear recommendations.
  • Financial Analysis and Reporting
  • Analyse revenue, costs, marketing investment, customer acquisition, sales productivity and profitability trends to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Deliver timely and accurate management reporting with clear commentary on business performance.
  • Power BI and Data Analytics
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions for finance and business stakeholders.
  • Improve reporting automation and data visualization to provide timely, accessible and actionable insight.
  • Budgeting and Forecasting
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes across assigned business areas.
  • Prepare forecast updates and provide variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Help stakeholders understand forecast assumptions, trends, and key sensitivities.
  • Performance Management and Commercial Support
  • Monitor performance against key financial and operational metrics and highlight emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Assist with financial models, business cases, and commercial analysis for investment and growth initiatives.
  • Support assessments of sales effectiveness, marketing return on investment, and customer acquisition performance.
  • Stakeholder Communication and Continuous Improvement
  • Prepare and present reports and analysis to finance leadership, sales leaders, marketing leaders, and operational managers.
  • Translate complex financial and operational information into clear, practical insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Essential

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified, part-qualified or actively studying towards a professional qualification.
  • Approximately three to five years of relevant experience in finance, FP&A, commercial finance, management accounting or financial analysis.
  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and performance analysis.
  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with large datasets.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling, reporting and analysis.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.

Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.

If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.

Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!

To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV’s from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
Chalk Hill Group are partnering with a growing SME, based in Petersfield, to recruit a Finance & Data Analyst.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you’ll help turn financial and operational data into meaningful information that supports better decision-making.

Part-time hours, minimum of 30 hours a week, would be considered.

  • Prepare management reports, analysing actual performance against budgets and forecasts.
  • Investigate financial and operational trends, providing clear commentary on results, risks and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain reporting tools and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
  • Analyse sales, margins, stock, customer and operational data to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, cash flow reporting and period-end activities.
