title: Senior Reporter (AI editorial)
description:
Senior Reporter (AI editorial)

£40,000 - £45,000

Hybrid

London

Our client is an award-winning team delivering a portfolio of market-leading events, research reports, newsletters and digital content across the investor relations community.

Their subscription platforms combines independent editorial with proprietary data and intelligence, helping professionals stay informed, benchmark performance and connect with peers.

As the B2B media landscape evolves our client is modernizing how their editorial works to meet the new needs of their communities whilst maintaining the trust, authority and integrity of their brands.

The senior reporter (AI editorial) is central to that shift. You'll report on the latest developments affecting their audiences, moderate events and webinars and produce editorial content on the discussions.

You'll be responsible for improving the frequency and quality of their output and for building the systems that allow a small team to produce timely, error-free editorial content to a high standard.

We're looking for someone with knowledge of AI and automation who can improve processes and increase the time their journalists spend on high-value activities: building relationships, sourcing insights from leading people and understanding what matters to their readers.

You'll provide oversight of AI systems and be the human-in-the-loop, with an eye for detail and strong editorial judgment to ensure that everything they produce is publishable, credible and compatible with house style. Your work will contribute toward increasing web traffic, exposure and subscription revenues.

Responsibilities

  • Report on the latest developments affecting their audiences.
  • Moderate events and webinars.
  • Produce editorial content on the discussions.
  • Improve the frequency and quality of their output.
  • Build the systems that allow a small team to produce timely, error-free editorial content to a high standard.
  • Provide oversight of AI systems and be the human-in-the-loop.
  • Ensure that everything they produce is publishable, credible and compatible with house style.
  • Contribute toward increasing web traffic, exposure and subscription revenues.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years' experience in journalism, including B2B or trade media.

Required Skills

  • Superior writing and editing skills, with strong storytelling, a keen eye for detail and a record of producing clean, error-free copy to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with experience moderating events and interviewing senior leaders.
  • The ability to analyze and validate data then turn it into clear stories that serve their audiences.
  • Practical media law knowledge and experience in overseeing published materials.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in editorial work, with growing proficiency over the past year and the aptitude and appetite to build, pilot and own editorial AI tools as the role develops.
  • A genuine interest in artificial intelligence and its role in publishing.
  • A proven ability to prioritize and manage several concurrent projects and to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • The ability to work well independently and as part of a small team.
  • Sound editorial judgment that can be explained and defended.

description:
AI Engineer - LLM & Agentic Systems


  • London - Hybrid.
  • Circa £500 – £675 per day (and negotiable DOE)
  • Contract (Outside IR35)
  • Mid-level, Senior & Lead.
  • Agentic AI / Machine Learning.


Company:


Our client is a globally established data and information services business, operating across multiple high-value industry sectors. They have established data science and machine learning engineering teams already delivering in production, and are now expanding their AI capability significantly across the global organisation.


This is a role for people who ship. If you've built LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows that are live in production - not demos, not prototypes - and you want to do that at genuine scale, this is worth applying for.


What you'll be working on as an AI Engineer - LLM & Agentic Systems:


  • Designing and building AI agents and agentic workflows - combining LLMs, RAG, reasoning, memory and tool orchestration to solve real, complex business problems.
  • Owning delivery end-to-end - from initial exploration through to production deployment, integration and ongoing iteration.
  • Working with MCP-style architectures (FastMCP/FastAPI) and LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent frameworks to build reliable, scalable systems.
  • Integrating AI into products, APIs and core business workflows - with a sharp eye on latency, cost and real-world usability.
  • Collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure systems are observable, maintainable and built to last.


You're experience as an AI Engineer - LLM & Agentic Systems:


  • Proven, production-grade experience shipping LLM-powered systems - with clear, real-world examples you can speak to confidently.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents including tool use, orchestration and multi-step reasoning - RAG systems that actually deliver, not just proofs of concept.
  • Strong Python skills and solid machine learning foundations - able to write clean, production-grade code with a firm grasp of system design principles.
  • Cloud deployment experience across AWS, GCP or Azure, using modern engineering practices.
  • A product mindset - you care about impact and adoption, not just model performance.
  • You understand LLM and machine learning trade-offs and design systems accordingly.


About you:


You'll likely have a Masters or higher in a mathematical, scientific or computer science discipline. More importantly, you've built things that are used - and you can explain clearly why you made the decisions you did.


At senior and lead level, we're looking for people who take strong ownership, mentor others naturally and can drive complete workflows and projects from brief through to delivery. A background in SaaS, B2B AI products or large-scale AI transformation is a strong signal.


Ambitious, but a genuine team player - you raise the bar without making it about yourself.


If you're building serious AI systems and want to do it at scale within a well-established global business, we'd welcome a conversation.

You will inherit live automation assets, stabilise and document them, then build secure workflows, integrations and AI agents that reduce manual effort, improve consistency and create repeatable value.

This is an engineering and ownership role, not a service desk position with occasional automation duties. You will work from business problem through design, build, testing and safe deployment, and remain accountable for performance in production.

Why Netteam tX?

We recognise and develop talent, creating opportunities for people to grow in different directions. Continuous learning, creativity and practical innovation are part of how we work, and we believe our people are what make NetTeam a great business to join.

You will work across Service, Professional Services, Cyber, Commercial and Operations, with the opportunity to shape standards, reusable solutions and customer-facing services rather than simply maintain a fixed backlog.

Your first priorities:

  • Take structured ownership of the Rewst estate, including workflows, forms, integrations, schedules, credentials, dependencies and known issues.
  • Make critical automations observable, documented, recoverable and supportable.
  • Establish practical source-control, review, testing, release, rollback, alerting and support arrangements.
  • Identify high-value opportunities across service delivery, Microsoft 365, security, onboarding, ticket handling and reporting.

What you will own and deliver:

Rewst and automation-platform ownership:

  • Own the day-to-day health, administration, support and development of Rewst and the wider automation toolset, including Datto RMM and GetThread.
  • Troubleshoot failed workflows, restore service safely, remove recurring causes and maintain an accurate automation and dependency register.

Workflow and integration engineering:

  • Design, build, test and maintain event-driven and scheduled workflows using the platform best suited to the requirement.
  • Develop resilient PowerShell and API integrations with secure authentication, pagination, rate-limit awareness, structured logging, exception handling and rollback.

AI agents and intelligent workflows:

  • Deliver practical agents and AI-enabled workflows that use approved knowledge, request approval where needed, record evidence and escalate safely when confidence is insufficient.
  • Design prompts, instructions, tools, actions, grounding sources and evaluation scenarios that produce repeatable, measurable outputs.

Security, governance and production reliability:

  • Apply least privilege, environment separation, approved identities, secure secrets, audit logging, change control, monitoring and safe fallbacks.
  • Treat prompt injection, excessive permissions, unsafe actions, sensitive-data exposure, ungrounded output, model drift and uncontrolled consumption as engineering risks.

Business discovery, customer solutions and team enablement:

  • Run discovery sessions, translate requirements into designs and acceptance criteria, and support estimates, demonstrations, proposals and Statements of Work.
  • Create runbooks, architecture notes, data-flow diagrams, test evidence and user guidance, and train teams to use solutions and recognise failure conditions.

Technology environment :

The role spans Rewst, PowerShell, REST APIs, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure, Intune, Datto RMM, GetThread, Windows and Active Directory, n8n, Power Automate, Make, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT and Codex.   • Microsoft 365
  • Azure

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Trainee AI Engineer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.

· 100% online, self-paced training

If you're an AI/ML Engineer looking to work on advanced AI products and tackle complex technical challenges, apply today to find out more about this opportunity.

title: Finance Analyst - AI
description:
Your new company
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Finance Transformation Specialist to join a large, established organisation undergoing continued investment in its finance processes and digital capabilities. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of two days per week in the office and the remainder working from home.
Your new role
As a Finance Transformation Specialist, you'll use your Finance and accounting experience to identify where digital tools, automation and AI can improve financial processes, controls, data quality and decision-making. You'll work closely with Finance and technology colleagues to understand business requirements, evaluate opportunities and support the implementation of automation, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. You'll help shape and support a prioritised portfolio of finance digitisation opportunities, ensuring each initiative has a clear Finance need, measurable value and appropriate governance. You'll use your understanding of accounting principles, Finance processes and controls to identify opportunities for digitisation, automation and AI, translating Finance requirements into clear use cases for digital tools and AI-enabled solutions. You'll also assess the quality and suitability of Finance data, support the design and testing of new solutions and help improve the accuracy, timeliness, efficiency and control of Finance activities.

What you'll need to succeed
You'll have strong experience within Finance or accounting, with a sound understanding of financial processes, reporting, controls and data. This Finance foundation will allow you to identify relevant digitisation opportunities, challenge requirements and ensure solutions deliver accurate and controlled financial outcomes. You'll also bring practical experience of digital tools, automation, data analytics or AI, together with the ability to connect technology possibilities to real Finance requirements. Experience supporting the design, testing or implementation of technology-enabled solutions within a Finance or accounting environment would be particularly relevant.

What you'll get in return
This is an excellent opportunity to take on a role at the heart of Finance transformation, combining your Finance and accounting knowledge with digital technology, automation and AI. You'll have the opportunity to influence how Finance operates, work closely with both Finance and technology teams and support the delivery of meaningful improvements across the organisation. You'll also benefit from a hybrid working pattern, with a minimum of two days per week in the office and the remainder working from home.

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (DevOps)
description:
£65,000–£80,000 per year | Hybrid, Warrington | Full-time, permanent | 37.5 hours per week


About Synextra

Synextra is an independent Azure specialist supporting regulated UK businesses, including law firms, mortgage lenders and financial services organisations. We’re small by design, with a focus on technical depth, customer service and taking responsibility for the environments we run.


Alongside our managed cloud services, our AI engineering team builds agent products for those same customers. We’re looking for an experienced Azure engineer who enjoys solving difficult operational problems and delivering engineering work alongside developers.


The role

You’ll work across our cloud engineering team, client projects and AI engineering team, combining deep Azure troubleshooting with planned development and automation work.


Our customers run a wide variety of environments in Azure, from virtual machines, networking and identity through to managed application services and modern cloud platforms. You’ll be someone our wider cloud engineering team can turn to for the most complex or significant Azure issues—helping investigate faults, restore service and understand what needs to change to prevent a repeat.


Alongside that operational responsibility, you’ll contribute to development sprints: building environments in Terraform, improving deployment pipelines, implementing monitoring and developing the platforms that support our AI products.


We’re looking for someone who enjoys that breadth. You’re comfortable getting into the detail of a difficult customer incident, sharing your expertise with other engineers and taking planned work through implementation, review, testing and release.


What you’ll be doing

Supporting customers and our cloud engineering team

  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex and high-impact Azure incidents across customer environments.

  • Troubleshoot across infrastructure and application services, including compute, networking, DNS, identity, storage and service dependencies.

  • Work alongside other engineers to investigate faults, restore service and communicate clear findings and next steps.

  • Follow significant incidents through to root cause, turning findings into improvements in configuration, monitoring, automation and operational guidance.

  • Share your expertise through practical troubleshooting, technical reviews and mentoring.

  • Participate in an on-call rota as part of delivering production systems.


Delivering projects and sprint work

  • Build and maintain Azure environments using Terraform, including reusable modules, state management and drift remediation.

  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

  • Work with developers to refine requirements, break work into manageable tasks and deliver changes through pull requests, testing and release.

  • Automate recurring tasks and replace manual processes with dependable, repeatable solutions.

  • Contribute to technical designs and help make practical decisions about reliability, security, performance and cost.

  • Produce clear documentation and handovers so the wider team can confidently support what you build.


Working with our AI engineering team

  • Build and operate the Azure environments supporting our AI products and customer deployments.

  • Develop deployment pipelines across development, testing and production, including isolated client environments.

  • Implement networking, identity, secrets management and access controls.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting and visibility into service performance and cost, including AI consumption.

  • Help developers investigate production issues and turn operational experience into better engineering practices.


What you’ll bring

  • Strong hands-on Azure experience across both IaaS and PaaS, with a track record of diagnosing complex production faults.

  • A solid understanding of how compute, networking, DNS, identity and storage interact, and confidence investigating problems that cross those boundaries.

  • Practical experience with Azure application services such as App Service, Container Apps, Functions or API Management.

  • Experience writing and maintaining Terraform, including modules, state management and safely changing existing environments.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and working through Git branches, pull requests and code review.

  • The ability to write useful automation in PowerShell, Python or another scripting language.

  • Clear communication with customers and colleagues, sound judgement during incidents and the ability to deliver agreed engineering work independently.


You don’t need to have used every Azure service. We’re interested in the depth of your understanding, how you investigate unfamiliar problems and the work you’ve delivered.


Useful additional experience

  • Working in an MSP, consultancy, SaaS business or development team.

  • Supporting regulated customers or operating across multiple customer environments.

  • Azure Monitor, Application Insights, KQL or OpenTelemetry.

  • Multi-tenant architecture and tenant isolation.

  • Deploying or operating AI and LLM-based services.

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications, such as AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-400. We’ll fund relevant certifications you want to work towards.


How we work

Customer support and planned engineering delivery are both substantial parts of this role. You’ll work with colleagues across the teams to agree priorities, communicate when urgent work affects delivery and follow tasks through to a proper conclusion.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Software Engineer

Location: Christchurch, BH23 6NW

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

About us

Averna powered by Spherea designs, manufactures and supports complex test systems for aerospace, defence and other regulated industries.

The role

This is an engineering software role, not general business application development. You will develop software for test, measurement, simulation and control systems, interacting with instrumentation, data acquisition hardware, communications interfaces and units under test. The software supports test sequences, data processing, operator guidance, diagnostics and traceable evidence. You will work across the lifecycle with systems, hardware, electrical, mechanical and project engineers, from requirements through implementation, integration, verification, acceptance, commissioning and support. Regular work alongside physical equipment is required, with occasional UK and international travel.

Key responsibilities

  • Analyse system and software requirements and contribute to architecture, detailed design and technology selection. Develop software for automated and manual test, measurement, simulation and control applications.
  • Produce maintainable, documented code and develop test sequences, operator interfaces, instrument drivers, data-processing functions, diagnostic tools and reports.
  • Integrate software with instrumentation, data-acquisition hardware, switching systems, communications interfaces and units under test. Implement suitable error handling, logging, user access controls and recovery mechanisms.
  • Reuse proven frameworks and components where appropriate, and modify, extend or migrate software for existing and legacy test systems.

You'll be an experienced Geospatial Data Engineer, GIS Engineer or similar, with a strong technical background in processing location-based data and turning complex information into reliable, usable datasets.

You'll also be an analytical problem-solver who enjoys investigating complex data issues, improving data quality and working collaboratively with developers to deliver practical solutions.

Experience in transport, mapping, surveying, logistics or mobility technology would be useful, as would knowledge of parking regulations, road-user charging, GNSS positioning, map matching or spatial machine learning.

This is an excellent opportunity to create and take sole ownership of a technically challenging geospatial data function within an innovative technology business.

You'll be able to make a tangible contribution to the development of its data capabilities, working on real-world challenges at the intersection of geospatial engineering, data quality, automation and AI.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

title: Trainee AI Engineer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Trainee Field Service Engineer
description:
Trainee Field Service Engineer - Hotpoint

No Experience Needed | Fully Paid Training | Company Van Provided

Ready to start a hands-on career with one of the UK's most trusted appliance brands?

Hotpoint is looking for motivated individuals to join our 12-month Trainee Field Service Engineer Programme. Whether you're currently working in retail, customer service, warehousing, delivery driving, manufacturing, the armed forces, or another practical role, we'll provide all the training and support you need to build a successful engineering career.

If you enjoy problem-solving, fixing things, working independently, helping customers and learning new skills all within your local area, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

What's in it for You?

  • 12-month paid training programme
  • Equivalent of £27,377 per year for the first 6 months, increasing to £28,352 per year thereafter - Paid weekly via umbrella company
  • Uncapped commission opportunities
  • Overtime available
  • Company van and fuel card provided
  • Tools, equipment and uniform supplied
  • Industry-leading training and ongoing support
  • 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • 25 days holiday upon securing a permanent role
  • Opportunity to gain a permanent position within 12 months
  • Long-term career progression with a recognised household brand

The Role

As a Trainee Field Service Engineer no two days are the same, you'll visit customers in their homes to diagnose and repair domestic appliances while delivering outstanding customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Travel to customer appointments in a company van
  • Diagnose faults and complete repairs
  • Deliver excellent customer service
  • Manage tools, parts and van stock
  • Represent the Hotpoint brand professionally
  • Promote approved products and services, with opportunities to earn commission

You'll work on appliances such as:

  • Washing machines
  • Tumble dryers
  • Electric cookers
  • Other domestic appliances as your training develops

Your Training Journey

Weeks 1-3: Residential Training (Peterborough)

Attend our specialist training centre Monday to Friday, returning home at weekends. Travel and accommodation are arranged and paid for by Hotpoint.

Week 1: Induction

  • Meet your support network
  • Receive your tools, uniform and company van
  • Complete health & safety training
  • Undertake a driving assessment

Weeks 2-3: Technical Training

  • Appliance repairs
  • Fault diagnosis
  • Electrical and mechanical troubleshooting
  • Customer service skills
  • Practical hands-on learning

Weeks 4-6: Field Mentoring

Work alongside an experienced engineer, receiving one-to-one coaching and support while developing your skills.

Months 2-12: On-the-Job Development

Continue building your technical knowledge and confidence with ongoing support and real customer experience.

Additional Upskill Training

Further specialist training will be provided to expand your product knowledge and technical capability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Reliable, professional and customer-focused
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Willing to learn and develop new skills
  • Looking for a long-term career
  • Confident communicating with customers
  • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services
  • Motivated by earning additional commission opportunities

Essential Requirements

  • Full UK Manual Driving Licence held for at least 1 year
  • Physically able to move household appliances safely
  • Right to work in the UK

Desirable Experience

  • Engineering, mechanical, electrical or technical experience
  • Repair, maintenance or fault-finding experience
  • Trades, field-based or customer-facing roles
  • Delivery driving or logistics experience
  • Experience using tools or practical hands-on skills

Career Changers Welcome

Many of our successful engineers have come from backgrounds including retail, customer service, logistics, manufacturing, automotive, trades and maintenance.

No previous engineering experience is required. We're looking for people with the right attitude, willingness to learn and commitment to building a long-term career.

Why Choose Hotpoint?

  • Learn a skilled trade with a trusted household brand
  • Gain valuable technical experience
  • Enjoy independence and variety every day
  • Join a supportive team invested in your success
  • Access long-term career progression opportunities

Apply today and start your journey towards becoming a qualified Field Service Engineer with Hotpoint.

title: Metering Data Analyst
description:
Metering Data Analyst
Bury, Greater Manchester
£27,000 + annual bonus
We are currently recruiting for a Metering Data Analyst to join a well-established energy supplier based in Bury. This is a great opportunity to join a supportive team in a role where data accuracy, investigation and problem-solving are key.
You'll be joining an established metering team, taking over a position previously held by a long-standing member of the business. The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate metering data, investigating discrepancies and ensuring issues are resolved efficiently.

The Role
Working within the metering team, you'll be responsible for managing metering data, maintaining accurate records and supporting key industry processes.
You'll investigate data discrepancies, resolve issues with meter readings and liaise with internal teams, suppliers and third parties to ensure information is accurate and up to date.
This is a detail-focused role suited to someone who enjoys working with data, getting to the bottom of problems and finding practical solutions. Previous energy industry experience would be beneficial, but candidates with a strong data background and a proactive, analytical mindset will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage meter and AMR installations, exchanges, removals and associated data flows
  • Ensure metering data is accurate and aligned across internal and industry systems
  • Source and manage Meter Asset Manager (MAM) appointments and updates
  • Investigate and resolve metering data discrepancies and issues
  • Manage meter reading rejections and ensure timely resolution
  • Liaise with customers, suppliers and third parties to resolve queries
  • Support AMR and smart meter rollout initiatives
  • Ensure meter readings are obtained and submitted within required timeframes
  • Process industry file flows to maintain accurate supply point data
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports
  • Identify potential improvements and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

About You
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an investigative mindset
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Confident working with data and identifying discrepancies or inconsistencies
  • Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues and suggest improvements
  • Comfortable working independently while contributing to a wider team

Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience within the energy industry, ideally with an energy supplier
  • Experience in a data-focused, analytical or operational role
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
  • Experience working with third-party metering agents, such as MAM or MOP
  • Advanced Excel skills would be advantageous

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Data Analyst

Manchester (Hybrid) | £50,000 - £70,000 + Benefits

If you're passionate about using data to shape digital products and improve customer experiences, this is an opportunity to make a genuine impact. You'll join a highly collaborative environment where analytics sits at the heart of product decision-making, working alongside product, engineering, and design teams to influence strategy and drive measurable outcomes.

The Company

They are a well-established digital business with a large-scale consumer platform used by millions of customers. Data plays a central role in how they develop products, enhance user experiences, and identify new opportunities for growth. Their culture is collaborative, evidence-led, and focused on continuous improvement. They invest heavily in analytics capabilities and provide an environment where data professionals can influence both product direction and commercial outcomes.

The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will take a leading role within a product-focused analytics team, helping to shape the development and optimisation of customer-facing digital products.

Responsibilities include:

* Defining and maintaining key metrics and measurement frameworks for product performance

* Designing and developing analytics solutions to support product decision-making

* Driving tracking and measurement improvements to ensure accurate user behaviour analysis

* Leading experimentation programmes and evaluating the impact of product changes through robust testing methodologies

* Partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, and Researchers to support product development

* Delivering actionable insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders across the business

* Influencing strategic decisions through data-driven storytelling and analytical expertise

* Mentoring analysts and championing best practice within the wider analytics community

* Supporting the development of scalable analytics frameworks and governance standards

* Planning and prioritising analytical work across multiple initiatives and stakeholders

Your Skills & Experience

* Strong commercial experience working within consumer-facing digital product environments

* Proven ability to use analytics to improve customer journeys, product performance, or user engagement

* Experience leading or supporting experimentation programmes and A/B testing initiatives

* Knowledge of statistical inference methodologies and experimental design principles

* Advanced SQL skills and strong Python capability

* Understanding of product analytics and digital tracking platforms such as Google Analytics or similar tools

* Experience working within cross-functional product teams

* Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Experience influencing decision-makers through evidence-based recommendations

* Passion for mentoring colleagues and driving analytics best practice

What They Offer

* Ongoing learning, development, and career progression opportunities

* Exposure to large-scale product analytics challenges and high-impact projects

How to Apply

If you're a Senior Data Analyst looking to influence product strategy, lead experimentation, and work with large-scale consumer data, apply today to learn more about this opportunity.

title: Data Administrator
description:
Data Administator
Bury, Greater Manchester
£27,000 + annual bonus

We are currently recruiting for a Metering Data Analyst to join a well-established energy supplier based in Bury. This is a great opportunity to join a supportive team in a role where data accuracy, investigation and problem-solving are key.

You'll be joining an established metering team, taking over a position previously held by a long-standing member of the business. The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate metering data, investigating discrepancies and ensuring issues are resolved efficiently.

The Role
Working within the metering team, you'll be responsible for managing metering data, maintaining accurate records and supporting key industry processes.
You'll investigate data discrepancies, resolve issues with meter readings and liaise with internal teams, suppliers and third parties to ensure information is accurate and up to date.
This is a detail-focused role suited to someone who enjoys working with data, getting to the bottom of problems and finding practical solutions. Previous energy industry experience would be beneficial, but candidates with a strong data background and a proactive, analytical mindset will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage meter and AMR installations, exchanges, removals and associated data flows
  • Ensure metering data is accurate and aligned across internal and industry systems
  • Source and manage Meter Asset Manager (MAM) appointments and updates
  • Investigate and resolve metering data discrepancies and issues
  • Manage meter reading rejections and ensure timely resolution
  • Liaise with customers, suppliers and third parties to resolve queries
  • Support AMR and smart meter rollout initiatives
  • Ensure meter readings are obtained and submitted within required timeframes
  • Process industry file flows to maintain accurate supply point data
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports
  • Identify potential improvements and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

About You
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an investigative mindset
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Confident working with data and identifying discrepancies or inconsistencies
  • Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues and suggest improvements
  • Comfortable working independently while contributing to a wider team

Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience within the energy industry, ideally with an energy supplier
  • Experience in a data-focused, analytical or operational role
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
  • Experience working with third-party metering agents, such as MAM or MOP
  • Advanced Excel skills would be advantageous

What's on Offer
  • £27,000 salary plus an annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
  • Free on-site parking
  • Wellbeing support
  • On-site gym
  • Regular social and team events

Please note that this is a full-time, fully office-based position in Bury, with no home or hybrid working available.
If you're interested in hearing more, please apply or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Senior HR Systems Analyst
description:
Senior HR Systems Analyst - SuccessFactors

£60,000 - £65,000 + benefits
Remote working | Ad hoc travel to Northamptonshire and occasional EMEA travel

Loom Talent are working exclusively with a large, global 3PL and logistics business looking to appoint a Senior HR Systems Analyst with strong SAP SuccessFactors experience.

The business is going through an exciting period of HR systems transformation, with a focus on developing and rolling out technology solutions across its UK, European and global operations. This is a key role within the team, combining hands-on technical expertise with project delivery and stakeholder management.

The Role

Taking ownership of SuccessFactors development and implementation across the business, you'll play a key part in ensuring HR systems are fit for purpose, well integrated and supporting the needs of a complex global organisation.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Leading end-to-end SuccessFactors implementation projects, from initial design and exploration through to deployment.
  • Getting hands-on with system configuration, including workflows, business rules and integrations.
  • Supporting the development of global position management, ensuring roles and structures are accurately mapped across the business.
  • Overseeing system integrations, data migration and associated risks, ensuring data is accurate and secure.
  • Supporting the rollout and development of SuccessFactors modules, including Employee Central and Recruiting & Onboarding.
  • Working closely with stakeholders across the UK, Europe and US to ensure successful delivery and alignment of global HR systems.
  • Acting as a subject matter expert, providing technical advice and support across wider HR digital transformation projects.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience working with SAP SuccessFactors, ideally across Employee Central and/or Recruiting & Onboarding.
  • Experience delivering or supporting HR systems implementations, ideally within a multi-country environment.
  • A good understanding of global HR processes, data management and system integrations.
  • Experience working within a large or complex business, with multiple countries and organisational structures.
  • An understanding of GDPR and wider data governance requirements.
  • Someone who is comfortable balancing hands-on system work with project delivery and stakeholder engagement.

This is a great opportunity to join a global business at an important point in its HR technology journey. You'll have the chance to take ownership of key SuccessFactors projects and make a real contribution to how HR systems are developed and delivered across the organisation.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst - 12 month fixed term contract

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join our Wealth team at Isio. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a strong background in financial services and/or technology who enjoys working at the intersection of business, investment and technology.

The successful candidate will have at least 5-10 years' experience working within financial services, FinTech, technology or a related environment, with a strong track record of analysing complex business processes and translating business needs into effective technology solutions.

An understanding of Model Portfolio Services (MPS), investment management or portfolio management would be highly advantageous. We are looking for someone with the right analytical mindset, financial services experience and ability to learn quickly. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop their knowledge of MPS and the investment management lifecycle on the job.

This is an exciting time to join as we continue to invest in and develop our technology offering following the acquisition of AI-driven investment manager Collidr.

This is a fixed term contract for 12 months, ideally based in our London office with a hybrid workstyle.

What does the role entail?

  • Lead business analysis activities across complex financial services and technology projects.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives, processes, pain points and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured and actionable requirements.
  • Produce high-quality business requirements documents, user stories, process maps, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions to establish and prioritise requirements.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions and potential impacts across business and technology functions.
  • Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities for automation, simplification and operational efficiency.

What we’re looking for?

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within financial services, FinTech, investment management, wealth management or a related technology environment.
  • Experience working with technology and software development teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical technology solutions.
  • Understanding of investment concepts including: Asset allocation; Funds and securities; Portfolio construction; Rebalancing; Portfolio performance; Trading and transactions; Investment data
  • Proven experience gathering, analysing and documenting complex business requirements.
  • Understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple priorities.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working for a FinTech, wealth management, investment manager, asset manager or financial technology provider.
  • Experience with MPS platforms, portfolio management systems or order/trading systems.
  • Understanding of adviser, wealth manager or discretionary investment management workflows.
  • Experience working with financial/investment data.

Why Join Isio

Isio is a fast-growing professional services business, that offers career development through an evolving client base, diverse and meaningful work, nationwide opportunities, and a culture that rewards high performance and accountability.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards and our values guide how we advise our clients, how we operate as a business and how we work together as a team. We call it the Isio Attitude. We encourage our people to be bold, to communicate with conviction, and to deliver advice that matters.

Here, growth brings opportunity - more responsibility, more clients, and work that stretches and develops you. We invest in training and development so you can expand your skills and explore different career paths across diverse markets to make your mark. Isio is a place to realise your potential and build a career with impact. You can find out more about Isio and the benefits we offer on our career's website Isio - Careers & Benefits.

About Isio

A progressive advisory firm, partnering with clients of all sizes to deliver expertise in pensions, employee benefits and wealth advisory services.

Working with pension trustees, employers, individuals, families and their offices, we are supported by talented colleagues across 10 UK offices. With a Big 4 heritage we combine a strong focus on quality with a fresh perspective challenging traditional thinking.

Our culture shapes our work; we foster a supportive environment where we develop our people to grow and fulfil their potential. We invest in our services, products and technology, and provide clear, expert solutions for our clients. This brings clarity, confidence, and better outcomes for everyone.

At Isio, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse workplace, in which our colleagues feel they belong, regardless of background or difference. We uphold the values of respect, fairness, and inclusion in our actions and decisions. We believe that by adhering to these principles, we will create a stronger, more innovative, and supportive environment for all, as well as ensuring that the advice and support we provide to our clients is more creative, more insightful and leaves a lasting impact.

We can offer a hybrid, flexible approach to work, supporting a work-life balance that works for you. Isio Group is an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

If you think you may require a reasonable adjustment to be made for any reason at any stage of your recruitment process, please ask us.

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer | Venture-Backed HealthTech Startup
Cambridge, MA
$200,000 - $220,000 + bonus + equity
4 days per week on-site

Join a well-funded, mission-driven start-up using AI to transform the way serious diseases are detected and monitored.

Having secured over $30M in early-stage funding and backed by leading investors, the company is entering an exciting growth phase as it prepares for its next major funding milestone. Their platform generates personalised health insights over time, with a live product already being used through a dedicated mobile application.

The Role

You'll be responsible for taking machine learning solutions from concept through to production, working across:

  • ML model design, training and deployment
  • Infrastructure, scalability and MLOps
  • Productionising AI systems
  • Monitoring, optimisation and performance improvement
  • Collaborating closely with engineering, product and domain experts

This is an engineering-focused role suited to someone who enjoys shipping robust ML systems rather than pure research.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong AI & machine learning and software engineering experience
  • Track record of deploying ML models into production
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and MLOps
  • Startup mindset and high ownership mentality
  • Healthcare, biotech or life sciences experience is beneficial but not essential

Why Join?

  • Opportunity to work on technology with meaningful real-world impact
  • Backed by an experienced founding team with deep expertise in AI and life sciences
  • Over $30M raised to date, providing the resources of a well-funded scale-up with the agility of a startup
  • Join at an exciting stage of growth ahead of a major funding event
  • High autonomy and influence within a small, highly technical team

Interview Process

  1. Introductory conversation with the hiring manager
  2. Three technical interview stages
  3. Final onsite cultural and team-fit assessment

Ideal for AI engineers who enjoy building and scaling production-grade machine learning systems in a fast-paced, well-funded startup environment.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Your new company
You'll be joining a leading international bank in the City of London. You'll sit in its Payments team, which supports the bank's day-to-day operations and works closely with teams across the business.

As a Data Analyst in the Payments & Data Solutions team, you'll use data, reporting and automation to make the department more efficient.

  • Building reports and dashboards from scratch, working from requirements gathered across different stakeholders

    Highly desirable:
  • Payments experience, ideally including SWIFT / ISO 20022

title: CDI Data Engineer
description:
3 CDI Data Engineering vacancies, differing mainly in where they sit within the customer data lifecycle.

The first is the most data-centric, the second is the most DevOps/MLOps-oriented, and the third is the most transformation-focused.


Remote working.

Client Details

Our client operates within the Oil and Gas sector. British Petroleum.

Description

Role 1: CDI Data Engineer


  • Implement and maintain SCI base, fact and curated pipelines.
  • Deliver Elavon/PAR/WRE/payment and loyalty matching.
  • Support ICE-to-EV data engineering and dashboard datasets.
  • Implement DO-site and market-specific logic.
  • Investigate volume drops, match-rate changes and data completeness defects.
  • Execute controlled reloads, production validation, DQ/freshness controls and BAU support.
  • Prepare PRs, tests, technical designs, CAB/release evidence and stakeholder



Role 2: BNA Production-Readiness, MLOps & Integration Engineer:

  • Automate end-to-end BNA orchestration
  • Reliable retry/recovery and idempotent processing
  • Production monitoring and alerting automated activation and acknowledgement handling
  • Reducing manual intervention Stable QA production deployment process
  • Runbooks and operational handover
  • Reducing runtime and production failures



Role 3: CIS/SCI Integration & Post-Migration Stabilisation Engineer:

  • Repointing remaining CIS/SCI dependencies
  • Stabilising migrated pipelines
  • Reusable error-handling patterns
  • Reducing legacy technical debt
  • Removing dual-platform monitoring
  • Resolving SFMC/Comarch integration issues
  • Reducing production support burden
  • Clear handover into BAU

Profile

Role 1: CDI Data Engineer

Must Have worked with:

  • Strong SQL, Python/Spark and Databricks pipeline engineering background.
  • Large-scale transaction, payment, loyalty, EPOS/WRE and identity-matching work history
  • Historical/full/incremental loads, high-water marks and reconciliation.
  • Azure DevOps PRs, unit testing, CI/CD and production release support.

Nice to have: Reporting/Power BI dataset exposure desirable. SFMC/CIS integration and multi-market SCI knowledge desirable.


Role 2: BNA Production-Readiness, MLOps & Integration Engineer

Must Have:

  • Strong hands-on background in Databricks, PySpark, Python and SQL Production pipeline engineering and troubleshooting
  • Workflow orchestration and dependency management Idempotency, retry/restart and failure-recovery patterns CI/CD, version control and automated deployment
  • Worked across monitoring, logging and operational alerting
  • Completed data-quality and reconciliation controls API/file/SFTP integration patterns


Nice to have: Delta Lake / Delta MERGE Databricks Asset Bundles Azure DevOps MLOps/model deployment work history SFMC or Comarch integration Customer decisioning / personalisation platforms



Role 3: CIS/SCI Integration & Post-Migration Stabilisation Engineer

Must Have worked with:

  • Strong hands-on background with Databricks, SQL, Python/PySpark ETL/ELT Data-pipeline migration
  • Legacy-to-cloud modernisation
  • Production troubleshooting
  • Dependency analysis
  • Pipeline repointing
  • Error handling and recovery
  • Data validation/reconciliation

title: Data Analyst - Customer Success
description:
Our Global SaaS client is now seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join their Global Customer Success Data Science Team for a 10-month contract.

You’ll play a pivotal role in improving how they measure and deliver customer success, driving impact across Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams, and ensure that data informs strategy, enhances customer journeys, and scales operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Building robust data foundations: Collaborate with engineering to develop pipelines, improve data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.
  • Developing actionable dashboards & reporting: Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide visibility into key performance metrics and think broadly across the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Delivering deep-dive analytics: Conduct root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys.
  • Advancing AI-native analytics: Leverage Gen AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation — helping the team move faster and deliver more scalable, proactive insights.
  • Enabling experimentation & continuous improvement: Support A/B testing and digital experience evaluations by analysing performance outcomes and quantifying customer and business impact.
  • ##

Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, ideally with exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development
  • Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (Tableau, Qlik, or similar)
  • Familiarity with big data tools (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes
  • Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support preferred
  • Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (A/B testing) preferred
  • Machine learning and Generative AI experience is a plus

Benefits

  • Award winning work environment
  • Hybrid working
  • Long contract with potential to extend
