title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

title: Trainee AI Engineer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Business Systems and Reporting Analyst
description:
Business Systems and Reporting Analyst

Location: Hybrid

Salary: £35,000 - £38,000 dependent on experience

Hours: 35 hours per week

Closing Date: 25 of November

At Shaftesbury, we’re looking for a Business Systems and Reporting Analyst to join our passionate and purpose-driven team. If you’re organised, detail-focused, and want to be part of something meaningful, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We’re not just hiring skills—we’re looking for people who genuinely care. People who want to make a difference. People who believe, as we do, that everyone deserves the opportunity to live a full, independent, and flourishing life.

Guided by our core values—Open, Enabling, Inclusive and Courageous—we are proud to deliver outstanding support across our adult care, children’s services, and education settings. Every member of our team plays a vital role in helping the people we support thrive.

This is a hybrid role that requires the ability to either travel to our Head office in Gateshead or to a national office within London.

About the Role

The Business Systems and Reporting Analyst is responsible for delivering accurate, insightful and meaningful report that supports strategic and operational decision making across the organisation.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • To work closely with stakeholders across all departments to understand business processes, analyse data relationships, automate reporting and develop innovative solutions.
  • The role requires a curious and solution-focused individual with a passion for data, systems and continuous improvement.
  • To work to design, develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power Bi.
  • To deliver timely, accurate and insightful management information.
  • To be an active part of Shaftesbury’s Care Operations Business Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a team that directly impacts the quality and safety of the services we provide.

Benefits of working at Shaftesbury

At Shaftesbury, we know that our workers are our greatest asset. We’re proud to have some of the best and most committed staff in the sector – and we want to attract more people like you to work with Shaftesbury. We’re now offering even more great benefits to reward the work of our wonderful staff, which is listed below:

  • Access to our employee assistance program.

Shaftesbury is the disability charity that’s committed to enabling children, young people and adults to live a life that adds up for them.

What makes life liveable is never down to just one thing - it’s the sum of many things. From friendship to fun; from companionship to community; from a great chat to a challenge overcome, it all adds up – to Shaftesbury.

Through a wide range of disability care, special education, and rehabilitation services we promote inclusion and wellbeing for all. Together, we work to see people take part, contribute and be valued. We put the elements in place that all add up to connected lives.

Shaftesbury is committed to the Disability Confident Scheme and to equal opportunities therefore we welcome and encourage applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender, ethnicity, religion and sexual orientation.

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Shaftesbury Group, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

title: Work From Home AI Rater - English
description:
Outlier is an AI training platform owned and operated by Scale AI. Outlier Experts work on a variety of projects, from generating training data to evaluating the performance of models.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking detail-oriented English speakers to review AI-generated media. Roleplay live conversations with an AI voice model and score each exchange, compare generated images and videos to judge which follows the prompt better, and explain in writing what looked or sounded wrong, all remotely and on your own schedule.

At Outlier, your expertise helps shape how advanced AI systems reason, learn, and improve. Through Outlier’s evaluation and feedback loop, your work helps turn frontier research into AI that performs better in the real world.


Responsibilities:

  • Holding a live, scenario-based conversation in English with AI voice models, then ranking how natural, useful, and clear each one sounded
  • Comparing pairs of AI-generated images and videos and judging which one better follows the prompt
  • Inspecting outputs closely, including zooming in and replaying, to spot problems like distorted anatomy, flickering or unnatural motion, text errors, and audio that doesn't match the video
  • Rating each output across dimensions like adherence, quality, and realism, then writing a specific explanation in English that points to what you saw or heard


Common tasks:

  • Image evaluations: Compare two AI-generated images for the same text prompt and pick the better one, judging how well each follows the instructions, visual quality, and visible AI artifacts. Some tasks rank edited images against the original.
  • Video evaluations: Rank AI-generated videos against a text prompt, or edited videos against their source clip.
  • Video caption labeling: Label first-person videos of people or robots doing hands-on tasks. Contributors split each clip into individual actions and write precise captions, starting from an AI draft and correcting it.
  • Audio and voice evaluations: Rate AI-generated speech on naturalness, pronunciation, and how closely it matches a target voice. Some tasks require recording a short voice explanation of the choice.


Ideal qualifications:

  • Fluent English speaker with strong, clear written communication and comfortable with natural, everyday conversational speech
  • Strong attention to detail, with the patience to look and listen closely, and to replay or zoom in when something seems off
  • Comfortable thinking on your feet and talking through realistic situations in a natural, conversational way
  • Experience writing short, evidence-based explanations or reviews
  • Comfortable making a clear decision when both options have flaws
  • Nice to have: Pursuing or holding a Bachelor's degree or above


What you'll need to sign up:

  • A valid ID and mobile phone from your country of residence
  • An up-to-date resume that highlights your expertise
  • A LinkedIn profile showing your educational background and work experience


Payment:

  • Project work: Earn up to USD $15 per hour
  • Additional incentives: On average, contributors earn an additional 7.5% through Missions — Outlier’s version of surge pricing. The top quartile boosts their earnings by an average of 11%.
  • Payment schedule: Payments are processed weekly on Tuesdays, covering tasks completed during the previous pay period (Tuesday to Monday at midnight UTC), via PayPal, AirTM, or ACH transfer.
  • Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project need, and other factors. For example, higher rates may be offered to PhDs. For non-core work, such as during initial project onboarding or project overtime phases, lower rates apply. Additional incentives data is based on payments made in the past six months and is updated quarterly. Certain projects offer incentive payments. Please review the payment terms for each project.


Why join Outlier:

  • Work flexibly from anywhere, anytime, with no minimum hours. Set your own schedule, whether that's five or 40+ hours per week.
  • Free access to leading LLMs, worth $200+/month
  • Join 900K+ Outlier Experts across 52 countries, with $600M+ paid to experts
  • Collaborate with experts in your field to push the boundaries of pre-release models

  2. Upload your resume
  3. Upload your valid ID
  4. Start earning by completing tasks


Currently accepting applicants from: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, United Kingdom, and United States.

title: Senior Software Engineer - RPG
description:
Senior Software Engineer – RPG

Markerstudy Group have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Software Engineer to join.

This is a hybrid role with the requirement to work two days a week from either our Manchester or Peterborough office.

Role Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer is an experienced hands-on engineer who analyses, designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports software within a squad. The role takes ownership of larger and more complex work, contributes to technical design and helps the squad deliver secure, reliable and maintainable software.

Senior Software Engineers raise the capability of colleagues through pairing, peer review, coaching and knowledge-sharing, but have no formal people-management accountability. They are accountable for their own delivery and for positively influencing the engineering outcomes of the squad.

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, deploy and support high-quality software features, components, integrations and systems, with particular focus on larger or more complex items.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned engineering work, from clarification and design through implementation, testing, release and operational support.
  • Break down complex work and provide reasoned estimates, identifying dependencies, assumptions, risks and areas requiring further investigation.
  • Produce proportionate technical designs, decision records and documentation in collaboration with the squad and relevant technical stakeholders.
  • Apply software development lifecycle processes, engineering standards, security controls and agreed ways of working consistently.
  • Write maintainable production code and automated tests, with a focus on quality, performance, resilience, security and operability.
  • Constructively review the work of other engineers through pairing, code collaboration and peer review.
  • Support the planning and successful delivery of squad commitments, communicating progress, issues and technical risks openly.
  • Coach and support Software Engineers and Junior Software Engineers through practical technical guidance, without undertaking formal line-management duties.
  • Identify technical debt, defects and improvement opportunities, agreeing practical actions with the squad and technical leadership.
  • Collaborate with product, delivery, testing, architecture, security and operational colleagues to achieve agreed business and customer outcomes.
  • Support production incidents and problem investigation, helping the team resolve root causes and embed learning.

Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience as a professional IBM RPG Developer
  • Proficiency in RPG coding, using modern IDE (VS Code)
  • Experience integrating RPG applications with web services (REST/SOAP)
  • Familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML parsing, and data transformation
  • Strong experience with RPGLE (free and fixed format), including modern free-format syntax.
  • Proficiency in IBM i (AS/400, iSeries) environment and tools (e.g., SEU, RDi, ACS, PDM, CL, VS Code).
  • Experience with service programs, modules, procedures, and sub-procedures.
  • Knowledge of data structures, arrays, and error handling in RPGLE.
  • Ability to read, maintain, and refactor legacy RPG (III/IV) code.
  • Familiarity with job control, batch processing, and interactive programs.
  • Version control usage (e.g., Git, Aldon).
  • Experience designing and delivering complex software features, components, integrations or systems in a production environment.
  • Good understanding of software architecture and design principles, APIs, data, security, performance, resilience and maintainability.
  • Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience working in an agile delivery environment.
  • Practical experience of unit testing, automated testing, source control, CI/CD and code-review practices.
  • Work independently to manage tasks, timelines, and deliverables with minimal supervision.

What we offer in return?

  • A collaborative and fast paced work environment
  • Health care cash plan
  • Yearly bonus scheme
  • 24 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays and the ability to buy additional leave (annual leave also increases with service)
  • Life Assurance 4x annual salary
  • Vibrant, modern offices

title: Trainee Data Analyst
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Data Analyst

Liquidline is the fastest-growing commercial coffee solutions provider in the UK and Ireland—not that we’re bragging! Our customers are companies that take pride in offering quality refreshments to their employees and clients. Our success is built on outstanding customer service, hard work, and a strong team culture. We believe in delivering WOW experiences to both our customers and our valued employees.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified, a testament to our dedication to fostering a culture of support, growth and development, as well as promoting well-being, and winning together. With our core company values—passion, thoughtfulness, responsiveness, innovation, and smart working—at the very heart of our business, we are committed to cultivating an environment that inspires excellence.

We're looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior Data Analyst to join our growing team at Liquidline. In this role, you'll play a key part in transforming data into actionable insights, helping to drive strategic decision-making across the business as we continue to evolve our systems, reporting capabilities and data infrastructure.

What You Will Need In The Role Of Senior Data Analyst

  • Advanced SQL skills with hands-on experience in SQL Server environments.
  • Strong Power BI knowledge, including dashboard development and data modelling.
  • Experience working with complex datasets and translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience applying statistical techniques, exploratory data analysis and predictive modelling.
  • A proactive, solution-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience with ERP systems, data migrations, e-commerce or service-based businesses would be advantageous.


The Responsibilities of the Senior Data Analyst

  • Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Developing and enhancing dashboards, reports and data models using SQL Server and Power BI.
  • Performing statistical analysis and identifying trends, opportunities and actionable insights.
  • Supporting the ongoing development of our data strategy and reporting framework.
  • Contributing to system upgrades, migrations and data improvement initiatives.
  • Helping to standardise reporting logic, documentation and key business metrics across the organisation.


What You Will Learn & What Liquidline Can Offer You

Being a part of Liquidline is more than just a job – it’s a chance to grow, develop and thrive! We are deeply invested in the success of our team and our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support, and reward our employees. The package includes, but is not limited too:

  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays: Extra time off to rest and recharge.
  • Long Service Annual Leave Entitlement & Buy/Sell Scheme: More flexibility for your time off needs.
  • Candidate Referral Program: Help grow our team and earn rewards
  • Company Bonus Scheme: Celebrate success with us.
  • Enhanced Sick Pay: Supporting you when you need it most
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Comprehensive support for your family journey
  • Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme: Save for your future with ease.
  • Life Assurance & Income Protection (UK Only): Peace of mind for you.
  • HSF Health Plan: Access affordable healthcare.
  • YuLife Wellbeing Platform: One stop shop for wellbeing, rewards and support.
  • Employee Assistance Programme: Mental health support, virtual GP services and more.
  • Lunch on Liquidline & Bi-Annual Conferences: Enjoy lunch on Liquidline, and Bi Annual company conferences.

Liquidline is a fast-growing, family owned business that has expanded from 92 to over 300 employees since 2020. With ambitious plans for the next five years, there’s never been a better time to join us! Our dynamic and innovative environment offers endless opportunities for personal and professional growth.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer, treating everyone with fairness, respect and appreciation. At Liquidline, we embrace diversity and value the unique experiences and perspectives of every individual. Together, we are always Winning Together!

Salary

60000 - 60000 GBP (yearly)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

Up to £100,000
London

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly regarded investment management business and take ownership of a firmwide data platform being built from the ground up. You'll play a pivotal role in a greenfield transformation, helping create the data foundation that will support investment reporting, analytics, and future AI initiatives.

THE COMPANY:

This organisation is a well-established investment management firm overseeing a multi-asset portfolio spanning public equities, private markets, credit, alternatives, and other investment strategies.

With a lean and highly specialist team, technology plays a critical role in supporting investment decision-making, reporting, governance, and data-driven innovation. The business is now investing heavily in a modern data platform that will become the central foundation for reporting, analytics, and future AI use cases.

THE ROLE:

You will take ownership of the design, build, and ongoing development of a next-generation Azure data platform.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and implementing a greenfield data platform on Azure, with Databricks
  • Building and maintaining ingestion pipelines across investment, finance, market, custody, and private markets data sources.
  • Developing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD processes, governance frameworks, and data quality controls.
  • Supporting the firm's AI roadmap
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

You will bring strong capability in:

  • Data engineering within financial services environments.
  • Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • End-to-end platform builds, migrations, or greenfield data engineering projects.
  • Data modelling, governance, CI/CD, testing, lineage, and data quality best practices.
THE BENEFITS:

You will receive a salary of up to £100,000 depending on experience.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Molly Bird via the apply link on this page.

title: Senior Data Insight & Governance Manager
description:
Senior Data Insight & Governance Manager

£65,000-£70,000Liverpool - Hybrid

I'm working in partnership with a leading UK organisation delivering large-scale public sector and employment services programmes to hire a Senior Data Insight & Governance Manager.

This is a highly visible leadership role, sitting as the number two within the wider Business Intelligence function and acting as a trusted advisor to Directors, Executive stakeholders, and Board-level audiences. You'll lead teams spanning Insight, Data Science, Machine Learning, Governance, and Labour Market Intelligence while helping shape the future analytics strategy of the organisation.

The role

This position goes far beyond traditional BI or reporting management.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Leading multidisciplinary data and analytics teams
  • Driving insight strategy across the organisation
  • Developing data governance and quality frameworks
  • Overseeing AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives
  • Influencing business strategy through insight and evidence-led recommendations
  • Building stronger relationships between technical teams and operational leadership

This is a leadership and influence role rather than a hands-on technical position.

What you'll be doingData & Insight Leadership
  • Lead the organisation's Data, Insight, Governance, and Labour Market Intelligence capability.
  • Develop and deliver the insight and analytics roadmap.
  • Identify and prioritise high-value analytics initiatives across the organisation.
  • Increase the visibility and impact of data and analytics across operational functions.
Governance & Data Quality
  • Lead implementation and continuous improvement of data governance frameworks.
  • Drive improvements in data ownership, stewardship, quality, and standards.
  • Ensure data assets are trusted, accessible, and fit for purpose.
AI & Advanced Analytics
  • Influence the direction of AI, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Sponsor the development of predictive models, AI-powered products, automation solutions, and advanced insight programmes.
  • Establish governance and best practice around AI implementation and usage.
Stakeholder Management
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.
  • Present complex findings and recommendations to Executive and Board audiences.
  • Represent the Data & Analytics function at leadership forums and governance boards.
Team Leadership
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team including:
    • Data Scientists
    • Machine Learning Engineers
    • Insight Analysts
    • Labour Market Analysts
    • Governance Specialists
  • Build future capability across Analytics, Governance, AI, and Insight.
What they're looking forEssential
  • Significant leadership experience within Analytics, Data, BI, Insights, or Performance functions.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including analysts, data scientists, and machine learning professionals.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Experience developing analytics or insight strategies linked to business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Data Governance
    • Data Quality
    • Performance Reporting
    • KPI Frameworks
    • Advanced Analytics
    • Machine Learning concepts
  • Experience working with environments such:
    • Power BI
    • Snowflake
    • SQL-based platforms
Desirable
  • Public sector, education, employability, recruitment, or welfare-to-work experience.
  • Labour Market Intelligence exposure.
  • AI and Generative AI initiatives.
  • Enterprise data strategy development.
  • Governance framework implementation.
Why join?
  • Lead an established and growing Analytics function.
  • Significant influence across multiple business divisions.
  • Opportunity to shape future AI, Governance, and Advanced Analytics capability.
  • Direct interaction with Executive and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Autonomous role with genuine strategic impact.
  • Hybrid working and strong work-life balance.
Package
  • £65,000-£70,000 salary
  • Hybrid working
  • Strong pension and benefits package
  • Clear progression opportunities
  • High-profile leadership position
Interview process
  1. SHL Numerical & Verbal Assessment
  2. First Interview with BI Leadership
  3. Final Interview with Senior Leadership (ideally in person)

This role would suit a current:

  • Data & Analytics Manager
  • Head of Analytics
  • Senior Insight Manager
  • BI Manager
  • Data Governance Lead
  • Analytics Transformation Manager
  • Head of Insight

looking to step into a broader strategic leadership role covering Analytics, Data Science, Governance, AI, and organisational data strategy.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Up to £100,000 - Remote

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Lead Data Engineer to join a high-growth, venture-backed AI technology company developing innovative solutions for major enterprise clients.

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation's data architecture and engineering capabilities. Working closely with product, engineering, data science and leadership teams, you will take ownership of designing and building scalable data platforms that underpin advanced analytics, machine learning and AI-powered solutions.

This position offers the opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, influencing architecture and engineering standards while helping establish the foundations for a growing data function. You will be involved in everything from developing robust data pipelines and secure data services through to enabling machine learning capabilities and delivering trusted business intelligence.

For engineers who enjoy solving complex data challenges, building sophisticated data platforms and working at the forefront of AI innovation, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact within an ambitious and rapidly scaling technology business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Designing, building and maintaining scalable data platforms, pipelines and engineering solutions.
  • Building and optimising data infrastructure to support advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical models and AI applications.
  • Creating trusted analytics, reporting and business intelligence solutions.
  • Designing and managing secure, reliable data services and APIs.
  • Establishing best practices across data quality, governance, lineage, metadata and observability.
  • Embedding security, privacy and compliance into data architecture and engineering processes.
  • Working closely with technical and commercial stakeholders to influence data strategy, architecture and engineering direction.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience designing and building production-grade data platforms and pipelines.
  • Strong experience across the AWS data ecosystem, ideally including S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions and Amazon QuickSight.
  • Experience designing secure data services, APIs and cloud-native data architectures.
  • Understanding of machine learning, AI infrastructure and production data requirements.
  • Understanding of agentic AI, including data access, tool integration, evaluation and observability.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy and engineering best practices.

What's On Offer?

  • £100,000 salary.
  • Share options.
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Fully remote working across the UK.
  • Significant technical ownership and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to shape the future direction of data and AI within a high-growth technology business.
  • Clear progression into broader technical and leadership responsibilities as the organisation continues to scale.

If you are looking for an opportunity to take ownership of data engineering within an ambitious AI technology business, this role offers the chance to influence technical strategy, build cutting-edge data platforms and play a key role in the company's continued growth.

title: Business Analyst / Systems Analyst
description:
Business Analyst / Systems Analyst

Join Sagoss, an award-winning technology business where great analysis directly shapes the software clients use. This hands-on opportunity suits an experienced analyst who enjoys solving problems, working closely with developers and turning complex requirements into clear solutions.

If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Technical Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Requirements Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Business Process Analyst

Benefits include onsite parking, onsite restaurant and onsite gym


SALARY: £38,000 to £45,000 per annum + Benefits

LOCATION: Henley-on-Thames, Oxfordshire (Office Based)

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent


JOB OVERVIEW

This is a chance to step into a visible, influential position where good analysis has an immediate impact on clients, developers and delivery.

The Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will take real ownership of customer requirements, shaping ideas into practical, buildable solutions and helping projects move forward with clarity and pace.

Working at the heart of a collaborative technology team, the Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will combine client engagement with hands-on technical analysis, JIRA, SQL and process improvement.

The Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will have the freedom to improve how requirements are managed and help shape stronger ways of working across the business.


ABOUT US

Established in 2006, Sagoss Group is a growing, entrepreneurial group made up of three distinctive businesses: Sagoss, Accellerate and Healthium Clinics. Each business operates in a specialist market, creating a varied and commercially interesting environment where finance plays an important role in supporting growth, control and future scalability.

Sagoss is a UK technology business delivering intelligent parking and transport solutions through an integrated platform that combines software, ANPR, payment systems, customer portals and connected hardware.

Accellerate is a medical market-access consultancy that helps healthcare technologies and products move successfully through market-access strategy, regulatory compliance, health economics and related commercial support.

Healthium Clinics is a private, CQC-registered medical and aesthetic clinic in Henley-on-Thames, offering private healthcare, wellness, skin and non-surgical services in a discreet, patient-focused setting.


DUTIES

Your duties as the Business Analyst / Systems Analyst include:

  • Requirements Gathering and Client Engagement: Lead client meetings and workshops, uncover business needs and explain supported, cost-effective solutions clearly
  • Analysis and Solution Design: Analyse requests against existing functionality, map processes and data flows, assess impact, risk and effort, and work with developers on practical solutions
  • Specifications and Change Requests: Write functional and technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage change requests from initial request through approval, build, testing and release
  • Technical Analysis: Read and understand code, database structures and logs sufficiently to discuss solutions and investigate issues, using SQL or similar tools to query and validate data
  • JIRA and Prioritisation: Maintain a complete, prioritised backlog, manage timelines across clients and projects, and report progress, risks and blockers
  • Testing, Release and Handover: Write test scenarios, support system and user acceptance testing, confirm delivered changes meet specification, and prepare release notes and handover information
  • Continuous Improvement: Improve templates, standards and processes, identify recurring client needs and share knowledge across the team
  • Client and Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers and internal teams, manage expectations professionally and support occasional travel to client sites


CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL

  • Previous Business Analyst experience in a software or IT-based business
  • Proven experience writing functional and technical specifications, user stories and change requests
  • Strong understanding of software development, code, databases and the software development lifecycle
  • Confident daily use of JIRA and experience of Agile ways of working
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
  • Strong client-facing communication, active listening, presentation and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients
  • Strong organisation with the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities and deadlines
  • High level of IT literacy, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio or similar

DESIRABLE

  • Hands-on programming experience or a background in development, testing or technical support
  • Understanding of APIs, integrations and data formats such as REST, JSON and XML
  • Experience with SaaS or configurable platforms used by multiple clients
  • Experience in parking, transport, local authority or NHS environments
  • Business analysis certification such as BCS or IIBA, or a degree in computing or a related field


BENEFITS

Benefits include private medical insurance, birthday leave, onsite parking, onsite restaurant and onsite gym. Competitive salary, reviewed in line with performance and business needs


NO AGENCIES PLEASE

To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: UK (Hybrid)

Type: Permanent - £60k - £80k base + benefits

Sector: Consultancy / Financial Services

Are you a Data Engineer looking to work on cutting-edge cloud data platforms that drive analytics, AI and business-critical decision-making?

We're working with a growing consultancy that specialises in delivering modern data solutions for leading financial services organisations. This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing team where you'll be involved in designing, building and deploying scalable, cloud-first data platforms while developing your skills in a collaborative and innovative environment.

  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and modern data platforms.

title: AI Transformation Lead / AI Enablement
description:
Join a global business on its AI transformation journey, leading the identification and delivery of high-impact AI use cases that improve productivity, efficiency and decision-making. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders and Technical AI specialists to turn AI opportunities into real business outcomes while driving adoption and organisational change.

Client Details

Our client, a global industrial organisation, is seeking a Global Product Owner for AI to act as the key link between business functions and emerging AI capabilities.

This role will be responsible for identifying, shaping, prioritising and driving the adoption of AI-powered transformation.

Working closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership and technical AI specialists, you will ensure that initiatives deliver measurable operational value, improve productivity, reduce errors and accelerate business outcomes.

You will develop and implement the AI agenda, developing use cases & product roadmaps, conduct requirements gathering and ensure successful adoption. While technical teams build and maintain the underlying AI platforms and infrastructure, you will determine where AI can create the greatest business impact and ensure delivered solutions achieve sustainable usage and value.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong IT transformation/change management capability and a passion for AI technology.

Description

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end AI use-case pipeline, from discovery and qualification through to prioritisation and delivery.
  • Partner with business leaders and key stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can deliver measurable business benefits.
  • Facilitate workshops to understand business challenges, redesign processes and define AI-enabled solutions.
  • Evaluate AI opportunities based on value, feasibility, business impact and strategic alignment.
  • Drive adoption and user engagement across deployed AI solutions.
  • Lead AI enablement, awareness and literacy initiatives across the organisation.
  • Establish and maintain governance processes to ensure responsible and compliant AI deployment.
  • Develop business cases, benefit hypotheses and value tracking measures for AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to prioritise AI development activity against delivery capacity.
  • Provide recommendations on project approvals and investment decisions.
  • Continuously evaluate deployed solutions, retiring initiatives that fail to demonstrate adoption or business value.
Key Activities
  • Conduct regular discovery workshops across business functions and operational teams.
  • Manage and maintain the AI use-case backlog and delivery roadmap.
  • Track initiative ownership, progress, adoption levels and realised benefits.
  • Produce regular value and performance reports for senior leadership.
  • Lead AI user communities, champion networks and training programmes.
  • Identify and develop citizen developers and AI champions within the business.
  • Monitor solution adoption and intervene where engagement falls below expectations.
  • Prepare governance and approval documentation for AI initiatives.
  • Communicate evolving AI capabilities and opportunities across the organisation.
Success Measures
  • Number of qualified AI use cases progressing into delivery.
  • Conversion rate from idea through to production deployment.
  • User adoption and engagement across implemented AI solutions.
  • Measurable business value delivered against agreed objectives.
  • Growth in AI usage and capability across the organisation.
  • Expansion of business-led AI development and innovation communities.

title: Process Intelligence Scientist - Python, Machine Learning, Statistics, Data Science
description:
Machine Learning | Python | Data Science | Industrial Analytics | Predictive Modelling | Process Optimisation

Imagine using advanced analytics to predict problems before they happen, improve manufacturing performance and help industrial plants operate more efficiently.

Not through hypothetical datasets, but by working with real industrial processes, real customers and data that makes a measurable difference.

Welcome to Keit.

We're an innovative UK technology company developing advanced analytical solutions that help manufacturers understand and optimise their processes in real time.

Our technology combines spectroscopy, industrial process data and intelligent software to unlock insights that traditional monitoring methods can't provide.

Now we're looking for a talented Process Intelligence Scientist to help take that capability to the next level.

The Role at a Glance

Process Intelligence Scientist

Harwell Campus, Didcot, Oxfordshire | Office-Based

£45,000–£65,000 DOE

Full Time | Permanent

Monday–Friday, 9am–5:30pm (Some Flexibility Available)

Occasional International Travel, Primarily North America

Candidates must already have the unrestricted right to work in the UK.

The Keit Story

At Keit, we're passionate about making complex industrial processes easier to understand, monitor and improve.

Our IRmadillo spectrometer platform provides advanced, real-time chemical analysis, while our IRis software platform combines spectroscopy, laboratory measurements and operational data to deliver meaningful process insights.

Today, our technology helps customers in the fuel ethanol industry monitor and optimise fermentation.

But we're only scratching the surface.

Your Role in the Story

As our Process Intelligence Scientist, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, chemistry, industrial processes and software development.

You'll develop predictive models, improve existing chemometric capabilities and explore new ways to turn complex process data into practical recommendations for customers.

Working closely with chemometricians, software developers and customer engineering teams, you'll understand real operational challenges and develop solutions that create measurable value.

This is a hands-on opportunity to combine technical problem-solving, experimentation and customer collaboration while helping shape the future of our IRis platform.

About You

You're a curious data scientist or analytical specialist who enjoys solving difficult problems and finding meaningful insights in complex information.

You're comfortable working with incomplete, noisy and imperfect datasets, and enjoy translating technical ideas into practical solutions.

You'll also bring:

• Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics or data science.

• Excellent Python programming skills and hands-on predictive modelling experience.

• Proven ability to extract valuable insights from messy, real-world datasets.

• Experience developing and applying statistical or machine learning models to practical problems.

• Strong analytical reasoning and an evidence-led approach to problem-solving.

• The confidence to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-specialists.

• A collaborative, customer-focused mindset and the initiative to turn ideas into working solutions.

Highly Desirable

• Experience within industrial biotechnology, fermentation, manufacturing or process industries.

• Knowledge of chemometrics, including PLS, PCA, spectral preprocessing or calibration development.

• Experience with spectroscopy or analytical instrumentation.

• Time-series analytics, anomaly detection or industrial process optimisation.

• Familiarity with Azure-based data and analytics environments.

The Person We're Looking For

We value potential and attitude just as highly as existing industry knowledge.

You don't need to know everything about spectroscopy or fermentation, but you do need the curiosity and technical foundations to learn quickly.

You'll thrive in a team that debates ideas constructively, challenges assumptions and makes evidence-based decisions.

At Keit, we believe the best solutions come from collaboration, continuous improvement and being willing to experiment, even when that means occasionally getting things wrong.

What's on Offer

• £45,000–£65,000 Salary Depending on Experience

• Some Flexibility in Working Hours

• The Opportunity to Work with Advanced Spectroscopy and Machine Learning Technology

• Direct Exposure to Industrial Challenges and International Customers

• The Chance to Influence Future Product Capabilities and Technical Direction

• Collaboration with Experienced Scientists, Engineers and Software Developers

• A Supportive, Collaborative and Evidence-Led Working Environment

• A Key Role in Building Keit's Future Process Intelligence Capability

Why Join Keit?

This is more than another data science role.

It's an opportunity to apply your technical expertise to real industrial challenges, where better predictions and smarter decisions can directly improve manufacturing performance.

You'll work with a unique combination of spectroscopy, laboratory and operational data, developing solutions that have genuine practical value.

description:
ML Ops Engineer

Build the systems that make machine learning reliable in production.


CMC Markets is looking for an ML Ops Engineer to help turn machine learning models into reliable, scalable production services.


This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the systems around machine learning: deployment, automation, monitoring and operational controls. You’ll work with research engineers, software engineers, platform teams and product teams to make models reproducible, secure and dependable throughout their lifecycle.


This isn’t a research role. You’ll help move models from experimentation to production, with clear service objectives, observable behaviour and the resilience needed to operate at scale.


What you’ll do

  • Build repeatable workflows for model training, validation, release, deployment and retraining.
  • Package and version models, integrate model registries, automate deployments and support safe rollbacks.
  • Create CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, validation and release controls.
  • Build reusable tools and platform capabilities for multiple models and engineering teams.
  • Deploy and operate batch and online inference services in containerised cloud environments.
  • Monitor service health, data quality, drift and model performance through dashboards, alerts and runbooks.
  • Investigate production issues across models, applications, infrastructure and data dependencies.
  • Write production-grade Python for services, deployment tools and ML workflows.
  • Work with platform, security, data engineering and product teams on model inputs, access controls, resilience and compliance.


What you’ll bring

  • 3–7 years’ experience in ML Ops, ML platform or infrastructure engineering, or backend engineering.
  • Strong production Python skills, including API design, testing and maintainable services.
  • Experience deploying and operating ML models in production.
  • Familiarity with the ML lifecycle, from training and validation through inference, monitoring and retraining.
  • Experience with CI/CD and workflow orchestration.
  • Comfort working with cloud infrastructure, containers and infrastructure as code.
  • A sound understanding of observability, system design and common failure modes in ML systems.
  • The ability to weigh reliability and operational trade-offs, and communicate clearly across teams.


Nice to have

  • Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, automated retraining, model registries or feature stores.
  • Experience supporting multiple models or teams on a shared ML platform.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch or similar frameworks and model-serving technologies.
  • Experience in regulated or high-reliability production environments.


Our technology environment

We use Python, ML frameworks such as PyTorch, experiment tracking and model registry tools, workflow orchestration, containers, model-serving technologies, infrastructure as code and cloud services. Our stack will evolve, so we value engineers who understand the principles behind these systems and can adapt as tools and requirements change.


Why this role matters

Models create value when people and products can rely on them. You’ll help close the gap between promising experiments and production systems that are observable, dependable and ready to scale, improving the reliability and speed of ML delivery across the organisation.

If you care about robust engineering and building ML systems that fail visibly and recover safely, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
Newsquest Media Group is one of the largest regional news publishers in the UK and has a portfolio of more than 250 local news brands and magazines, online and in print. With an online audience of 41 million users a month and 7 million readers a week in print, our content reaches a substantial proportion of the UK population.

Audience and subscriber growth are core elements of our strategy as we continue to provide trusted, local journalism. To support this, we are looking for a talented and driven Insights Analyst to help guide digital subscription growth.


You will play a crucial role in monitoring and tracking key performance metrics, generating reports, and providing insights to help improve business performance. You will collaborate with various departments, including Product, Marketing, UX, and Newsroom Capabilities, to track key performance indicators and provide insights to aid business decisions. Your responsibilities will include analysing data, identifying trends, and making recommendations to enhance customer engagement, acquisition and retention.


What you'll get from us

  • The opportunity to work in a friendly but highly motivated and collaborative in-house team, which is independent and highly agile.
  • Your opinion will always be sought and listened to.
  • An opportunity to grow and learn from working with us and the wider business.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working with the opportunity to primarily work remotely; office days will be in the London office.

Key Responsibilities
  • You will collaborate with the reader revenue team to track key performance indicators, including building required reports and visualisations.
  • You will proactively identify trends in metrics and deep-dive into areas of concern/opportunity.
  • You will conduct analyses of subscriber churn trends across various cohorts, focusing on opportunities to increase lifetime value.
  • You will work closely with our marketing team to champion campaign effectiveness, including valuable A/B tests to enhance performance.
  • You will work with the wider analytics team to help develop our customer journey mapping and conversion attribution. Analyse and connect various customer touchpoints to guide effective strategies for conversion and retention.
  • You will assist the head of newsletters with monitoring and tracking key performance metrics, generating reports to provide insights for product and editorial changes, and identifying opportunities for new newsletter products.
  • You will help analyse app user data, lifetime value of in-app subscribers, churn levels and conversion rates to identify trends and make recommendations for improvement.
  • You will communicate the results of analysis to stakeholders, highlighting issues and making recommendations.
  • You will work with internal teams to maintain the accuracy and integrity of data sources. Monitor, identify, and correct issues in regular reporting.
  • You will respond to any ad-hoc data requests, add value where possible and ensure that items are completed in line with business priorities.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  • The ideal candidate will have some proven experience as a marketing data analyst in an eComm or online subscription-based business, ideally within media or publishing.
  • Expert knowledge and skills in using Power BI, Microsoft Excel, and other relevant business intelligence tools.
  • Strong knowledge of key analytical tools & languages (SQL, Adobe, Google, Data Studio, Python)
  • Proven analysis and insight experience using relevant tools and methods to source and analyse data from multiple sources.
  • Highly proficient in interpreting data, extrapolating trends, and translating metrics into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to design and build performance reports to meet business needs.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills to manage multiple tasks and deliver reliable analysis and reports to deadline.
  • The skills to communicate effectively to all key stakeholders clearly, confidently and concisely.
  • A proactive approach and a curious mindset.
  • Drive to grow, develop and succeed professionally.
  • Excellent attention to detail.



Job Benefits
  • Competitive salary
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays + your birthday off
  • Holiday buy scheme for extra flexibility
  • Structured career progression & ongoing training
  • Pension plan
  • Employee Helpline counselling and advice
  • Perks & discounts, including:
    • Gym membership
    • Cycle to Work scheme
    • Eye care

title: Senior Data Engineer | Computer Vision
description:
Senior Data Engineer

£782/day (Inside IR35) | 12-Month Contract | London (2 Days Onsite)

Overview

Clinical Platforms team is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to help build and maintain the data and cloud infrastructure that powers large-scale medical imaging and AI/ML initiatives across the business.

This is a highly technical engineering role sitting at the intersection of Data Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Machine Learning Infrastructure and Computer Vision. You'll be responsible for designing, building and supporting production-grade data platforms that enable researchers and scientists to work with complex imaging datasets and AI-driven workflows.

The team is looking for a hands-on engineer with strong Python, SQL and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience who can take ownership of technical solutions from design through to production.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Designing and building scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms
  • Developing and maintaining data infrastructure supporting medical imaging and AI/ML workloads
  • Building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration frameworks
  • Managing large-scale datasets across cloud environments
  • Supporting infrastructure used to deploy and run machine learning and computer vision solutions
  • Designing data models and database schemas for complex datasets
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and optimising production systems
  • Collaborating with engineers, researchers and data scientists across multiple projects
Key Skills & ExperienceEssential

  • Advanced SQL and data modelling expertise
  • Strong Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience
  • Experience designing and delivering production-grade data platforms
  • Strong understanding of systems architecture and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience building end-to-end data engineering solutions

Highly Desirable

  • Exposure to Machine Learning platforms and infrastructure
  • Experience working with image datasets at scale
  • PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy or related technologies
  • BigQuery and wider GCP ecosystem experience
