Nice to Have
  • Medical imaging experience
  • DICOM or PACS exposure
  • Healthcare, biotech or pharmaceutical industry experience
Ideal Background

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Senior Data Engineers
  • Data Platform Engineers
  • Machine Learning Engineers
  • ML Platform Engineers
  • Computer Vision Engineers
  • AI Engineers
  • Software Engineers with strong cloud and data engineering experience

The key requirement is strong, hands-on commercial engineering experience and the ability to design, build and support complex production systems.

Why Join?
  • Work on cutting-edge AI and medical imaging initiatives
  • Join a highly technical engineering team within the Clinical Platforms function
  • Contribute to platforms supporting drug discovery and clinical research
  • Opportunity to work across Data Engineering, ML Infrastructure and Computer Vision projects
  • Long-term 12-month contract with strong extension potential
Contract Details
  • Role: Senior Data Engineer
  • Contract Length: 12 Months
  • Rate: Up to £782/day
  • IR35 Status: Inside IR35
  • Location: London
  • Working Pattern: 2 Days Onsite Per Week

If your background sits across Data Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Machine Learning infrastructure, I'd be happy to share further details.

title: AI Builder
description:
AI Builder


  • Salary from £40k to £75k + benefits
  • Role based onsite 4-5 days per week at either central Manchester, central Cheltenham or London Westminster offices (your choice).


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).


This company is a Workflow & AI Orchestration Specialist. They deliver workflow and orchestration solutions that modernise casework, data, and citizen services. They connect fragmented systems to create coherent experiences with AI agents deployed safely at scale. They operate across two pillars: 1) advise and implement to provide end-to-end technology solutions that integrate cutting edge orchestration and 2) agentic AI capabilities. They’re growing fast and looking for bright, dynamic people to help build their business.


Role Overview


They're looking for an AI Builder to join their growing team: someone who builds AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems. They’re looking for someone who can help solve both these questions. First and foremost, they’re looking for someone who can help build these systems. Historically this would have required candidates with a deep understanding of machine learning and AI engineering, but in the new world of agentic coding and high-performance generalised reasoning models, things are clearly a little different.


They build solutions using a combination of APIs, self-hosted models, agentic frameworks and agentic builders integrated into other technology solutions. They use third party products and integrations where useful, but they also design and build their own bespoke systems either when the problem requires or when it makes sense commercially. They generally build their backend systems in Python, although increasingly leverage agentic coding tools so that they are less in the weeds of coding itself, and more building at the system level.


Core to all of this is being able to navigate complex but often poorly defined and open-ended questions effectively. They are looking for candidates who can build solutions quickly and efficiently whilst ensuring these systems are well designed and extensible, who can balance speed with engineering quality and ensure they avoid overengineering solutions too early whilst then productionising and scaling solutions effectively when proven, who can work closely with clients and end users to understand problems whilst iterating towards desired outcomes, and who remain curious and motivated across a rapidly evolving technology and business landscape.


They expect candidates to be comparatively stronger across different areas depending on background and experience, and they are happy to consider candidates from a diverse range of backgrounds from both academia and industry. This includes machine learning and AI engineers, software developers who are looking to focus more on AI, product designers and architects who are looking to move into more technical delivery, and technical researchers (physics, mathematics, computer science etc.) who want to move into more applied development and delivery.


They are also open to different levels of experience and seniority, which is reflected in the relatively wide salary bracket. Most important is experience and interest in building these systems in some form, some level of technical understanding and experience, and curiosity and motivation to continue to learn how to build effective AI and agentic systems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Working directly with the Head of AI & Data to design, develop, deploy and scale AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems, both for clients and internally.
  • Collaborate with service designers, engineers and business analysts to identify and frame AI use cases.
  • Build rapid proof-of-concepts (PoC) and prototype AI systems to demonstrate possible solutions, test technical feasibility, gain feedback on design and gauge overall usefulness.
  • Work with engineering teams to productionise and scale AI and agentic systems within wider products and platforms.
  • Iterate and improve AI and agentic systems already deployed within client organisations and internally to improve performance, quality, robustness, resilience, cost etc. and to further extend features.
  • Build solutions using agentic coding tools, with a strong eye on system design and quality.
  • Advise on AI strategy, adoption and scaling for clients.
  • Contribute to internal R&D, tooling, thought leadership and the company’s AI proposition.
  • Support bids and client engagements where AI capability is a key differentiator.
  • Help maintain awareness of and critically analyse the evolving AI landscape, both at a model / product level and more at a business / strategic level.


Essential Skills and Experience


  • Demonstrable experience building systems that incorporate AI and/or agentic AI, whether that’s in industry, academic or personal projects.
  • Some technical knowledge and experience, either more foundational (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science etc.) or applied (programming, software development etc.).
  • Experience and proficiency developing in Python, including wider system design principles.
  • Some experience developing with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex etc.).
  • Strong system-design judgement: structuring systems so you retain a clear understanding of how they work, even when you didn't hand-write every line, and a sense of how to test and prove them.


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).

title: Marketing Analyst (EMEA)
description:
About us

Crown Worldwide Group is a privately owned, global logistics company founded in 1965 and headquartered in Hong Kong. We are an extraordinary and purposeful business committed to making it simpler to live, work and do business anywhere in the world, delivered through our broad portfolio of complementary brands. Together these enable us to; relocate people’s lives and possessions, help companies move teams to new locations near and far and help them manage their workspaces. We also transport, store and install precious art collections and keep company data and records safe, yet accessible.


We oversee a wide-ranging CSR program which supports local and global charities, actively champions employee wellbeing and continually seeks to reduce our environmental footprint. We are also proud of our diverse and inclusive culture. This provides all our employees with a sense of belonging which allows them to reach their full potential.

About the Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and detail-oriented Marketing Analyst to join our EMEA Marketing team. This role is pivotal in helping us understand and improve the performance of our lead generation efforts across multiple brands and business units.

You’ll be responsible for compiling and delivering monthly performance reports to key stakeholders, analysing marketing channel effectiveness, and making actionable recommendations to optimise our digital campaigns.

What You’ll Do

  • Compile and produce monthly performance reports for each business unit, providing insights that can be shared with the stakeholders.
  • Analyse the performance of lead generation channels including:
  • PPC (e.g., Google Ads)
  • SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
  • Social Media (paid and organic)
  • Outbound (Apollo. io, LinkedIn)
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities across campaigns and channels.
  • Recommend and support testing strategies to improve channel performance and ROI.
  • Collaborate with the Performance Marketing Manager to align reporting with business goals and campaign KPIs.
  • Maintain and improve dashboards and reporting tools using platforms such as Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or similar.
  • Support ad hoc analysis requests from marketing and commercial teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in a marketing analytics or digital performance role.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, especially PPC, SEO, and social media.
  • Proficient in analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager).
  • Comfortable working with data in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with BI tools is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills – able to translate data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset.

Why Join Crown?

  • Join a company celebrated for its care, expertise, and commitment to quality service.
  • Grow with ongoing training designed to develop your skills and support your career ambitions.
  • Develop your skills and collaborate on innovative solutions in an international, supportive environment.
  • Join collaborative team that values your ideas and encourages diversity and creativity.
  • Enjoy a culture built on integrity, respect, and excellence.
  • Contribute to sustainability and responsible business practices worldwide

Shape Your Future with a Global Leade Where Every Talent Finds Its Crown

Apply now or share this opportunity with someone who’d be a perfect fit.

Crown is an equal opportunities employer

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military/veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Crown welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates eligible to live and work in the designated geographical region. We are committed to diversity, and to employee well-being, engagement and development.

title: Test and Data Analyst
description:
Test & Data Analyst

Location: Braintree - Office-based with free on-site parking
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:30pm (flexibility available around start and finish times, provided core hours are worked)
Contract: Temporary until 31 March 2027

Pay: £15.00- £15.38 per hour

We are looking for a Test & Data Analyst to join a collaborative team and play a key role in the successful rollout, testing, and ongoing improvement of a business-critical CRM platform.

This is a varied role that combines system testing, data quality, user support, and engaging with the user.

You'll work mainly independently to test new functionality and manage data integrity, while also working closely with colleagues across the business to help them understand, navigate, and adopt new system changes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test new CRM developments,
  • Test workflows,
  • Generate reports and integrate system enhancements before they are released.
  • Assist with the implementation of new system changes and improvements.
  • Support end users through system updates
  • Gather feedback from users and communicate issues, concerns, and enhancement requests back to developers.
  • Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
  • Identify, log, and track system defects through to resolution.
  • Clean, validate, and maintain CRM data
  • Investigate data issues
  • Build strong relationships across the business and provide ongoing support to users.
  • Work independently on testing and data-related tasks while collaborating closely with the wider team on projects and improvements.

About You

  • Previous experience testing CRM systems or business applications.
  • HubSpot experience would be highly desirable, however we would also love to hear from candidates with experience testing other CRM platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
  • Experience working with data and maintaining high levels of accuracy.
  • Confident communicator who enjoys engaging with people and building relationships.
  • Comfortable providing training, guidance, and support to end users.
  • Able to work independently, manage your own workload, and meet deadlines.
  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with reports and datasets.


What's on Offer?

  • Long-term temporary assignment until 31 March 2027.
  • Flexible working arrangements around core business hours.
  • Free on-site parking.
  • Opportunity to gain valuable experience in CRM systems, testing, data management, and business improvement.
  • A role where you can make a real impact by improving systems, supporting users, and driving positive change across the business.

If you enjoy solving problems, improving processes, working with data, and helping people get the best from technology, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer


Location: Coventry

Salary: Competitive, DOE

Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

We're working with an established organisation looking to appoint an experienced Data Engineer to join its growing technology team.

This is an opportunity to work on modern data platforms, develop scalable data solutions and play a key role in improving how data is collected, processed and utilised across the business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Develop and optimise data integration and transformation solutions.
  • Work with large datasets to ensure data quality, reliability and accessibility.
  • Support the development of data warehouses and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts and wider technical teams.
Skills & Experience
  • Strong experience with SQL and Python.
  • Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines.
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and data modelling.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

title: Senior / Principal AI Engineer
description:
Senior / Principal AI Engineer (x2) - London (Hybrid) - Python, LangGraph, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, GCP


£90,000 - £150,000

I'm partnering with a well-funded AI scale-up that has just secured a major investment round and has the ambition to become a category-defining company. They're building an enterprise AI platform that helps large organisations get real, measurable value from AI, using intelligent agents to automate work at scale.

This is a rare chance to join at an early stage, with serious backing and a clear vision. You'll work directly with an experienced CTO from a blue-chip technology background, who is building the team in person in London. The business is scaling quickly across Tech, Product and Marketing, so you'll help shape a team of the best people in the market. The office is state of the art, in the heart of the City, and somewhere people want to come in to work.

You will work with

  • Designing and building complex agent harnesses: runtime, orchestration, tool use, gates, stop conditions and recovery paths
  • Building production LLM, RAG and agentic systems in Python and LangGraph
  • Owning evaluation end to end: error analysis, trajectory-level testing, judge calibration, live quality monitoring and release gates
  • Building secure integrations with business-critical systems, with human approval before consequential actions
  • Developing sandboxed code execution and long-running, resumable background agent tasks
  • Connecting cost, outputs and user feedback so customers can see the real value of their AI usage
  • Partnering with the CTO on architecture, reviews, mentoring and engineering standards

Benefits

  • Salary of £90,000 - £150,000 depending on experience, plus equity
  • Join an early-stage company with major investor backing and the ambition to lead its market
  • Direct access to an experienced CTO and real influence on technical direction
  • Hybrid working: 3-4 days a week in a beautiful central London office
  • Work on hard, meaningful problems rather than thin model integrations

Key experience

  • Strong, hands-on experience building complex agent harnesses and evaluations (essential)
  • Production experience with LLMs, RAG systems and AI agents
  • Proficiency in Python and LangGraph, with solid engineering fundamentals (TypeScript, PostgreSQL, APIs, queues, cloud; GCP a plus)
  • Experience evaluating agent trajectories, including tool selection, recovery, cost and reliability, and calibrating LLM judges
  • Practical judgement on model quality, token budgets, latency and cost per successful task
  • Familiarity with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight) and their trade-offs
  • Experience with permissions, sandboxing and approvals in enterprise settings
  • Nice to have: simulated-user evals, synthetic test generation, inference routing/caching, streaming or ML/RL/multi-agent research exposure

Apply now or send your CV directly!
They're moving fast, with only two places available. If you're a top-tier engineer who wants real ownership at the start of something big, get in touch today to start the conversation.

title: Senior Data / AI Engineer
description:
Senior Data / AI Engineer

Location: London (Hybrid, 2 days per week onsite)
Salary: Up to £85,000

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Data / AI Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling innovative data products. This is more than a traditional data engineering position. You will work closely with product, commercial and technology teams to transform raw and third-party data into valuable, customer-facing solutions.

The role combines modern data engineering, AI capabilities and product thinking, offering the opportunity to shape how data is monetised, enriched and delivered to end users.

Key ResponsibilitiesData Product Development
  • Design and build scalable data products that support commercial and customer-facing solutions.
  • Transform raw and third-party data into structured, enriched and product-ready datasets.
  • Collaborate with product and commercial stakeholders to define how data is packaged, accessed and delivered.
  • Develop data delivery solutions through APIs, internal tools and customer-facing platforms.
AI & Data Enrichment
  • Apply AI and LLM technologies to enrich datasets through classification, tagging, summarisation and insight generation.
  • Design and develop LLM-powered product features.
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to enhance data quality and unlock new product capabilities.
  • Support the development of AI-driven solutions including intelligent search, recommendation engines and insights platforms.
  • Ensure AI systems are scalable, resilient and governed appropriately.
Platform Engineering
  • Support the deployment, operation and lifecycle management of data and AI platforms.
  • Own and evolve the Azure Databricks-based data platform architecture to support business growth.
  • Drive performance and cost optimisation across Azure services through monitoring, tuning and automation.
  • Build and maintain reliable batch and streaming data pipelines.
  • Implement robust testing, observability and data quality controls.
  • Promote engineering best practices through CI/CD, automation and platform standardisation.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Partner with business and product stakeholders to identify high-value data opportunities.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Act as a bridge between commercial, product and engineering teams.
  • Support prioritisation decisions based on business value and impact.
Leadership
  • Contribute to the wider data and AI strategy.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering excellence.
  • Help build a high-performing team with a strong product and commercial mindset.
Required Skills & ExperienceData Engineering & Cloud
  • Extensive experience designing, building and operating production data platforms using Azure Databricks and Azure.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL and Delta Lake.
  • Experience implementing and managing Unity Catalog, including governance, lineage and access controls.
  • Proven delivery of lakehouse and Medallion architectures.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills for scalable, production-grade solutions.
  • Experience building modern batch and real-time data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of API design and data product delivery mechanisms.
  • Experience deploying Databricks solutions using CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience integrating Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Identity, Key Vault and external data sources.
Data Product Experience
  • Experience building customer-facing data products or commercial data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of how data can be structured, exposed and scaled for end users.
  • Ability to focus on measurable business outcomes rather than solely technical delivery.
  • Experience working closely with product, commercial or customer-facing teams.
AI & Machine Learning
  • Practical experience with Generative AI and LLM technologies such as Azure OpenAI and LangChain.
  • Experience applying AI solutions to real-world business challenges.
  • Knowledge of embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.
  • Experience working with unstructured data including text and document-based datasets.
  • Understanding of AI governance, monitoring and ethical considerations.
Desirable Experience
  • Airbyte or similar modern data ingestion platforms.
  • Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
  • Experimentation, testing or A/B testing frameworks.
  • Experience building AI-enabled or data-driven products.
  • Background within Life Sciences, Healthcare or highly regulated industries.
About You
  • Product-focused and driven by business impact.
  • Equally comfortable discussing technical solutions and commercial objectives.
  • Passionate about delivering production-ready solutions rather than proofs of concept.
  • Pragmatic, collaborative and delivery-oriented.
  • Naturally curious about emerging AI technologies and how they can create commercial value.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Why Southwark?

This is an exciting time to join Southwark Council as we embark on a significant period of growth, transformation, and innovation. As one of London's most ambitious local authorities, we are delivering a major programme of change designed to improve outcomes for residents while ensuring our services remain financially sustainable for the future.

At the heart of this transformation is our Change Team within Strategy & Communities. The team leads a diverse portfolio of high-profile projects across the council, driving service improvement, redesigning processes, embedding innovative ways of working, and delivering meaningful change that makes a real difference to our communities. With several exciting projects on the horizon and continued investment in our transformation agenda, there has never been a better time to join us.

We're growing our team and are looking for talented, curious, and motivated individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems and delivering impactful change.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering complex transformation programmes, leading analytical work across a variety of change initiatives. Working alongside programme managers, service designers, delivery managers, and PMO specialists, you'll help services across the council redesign how they work, improve resident experiences, and achieve lasting outcomes.

If you're looking for a role where you can influence meaningful change, develop your career in a supportive and collaborative environment, and be part of an ambitious team with a growing portfolio of exciting projects, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Reward Analyst
description:
The Role

As the European Reward Analyst, you will play a critical role in supporting the design, implementation, and administration of competitive compensation and benefits programs across 21 European countries. Reporting directly to the Reward and Benefits Manager, you will act as the analytical engine of the team, using internal and market data to ensure our reward structures attract, retain, and motivate top talent. This role requires navigating multiple currencies, distinct local employment laws, and varied cultural expectations regarding total rewards.

The Key areas of responsibilities are:

  • Be the reward focal point for EU, solving queries and proactively suggesting recommendations to improve processes whilst understanding individual countries compliance.
  • Provide comprehensive support to Reward & Benefits Manager in all reward initiatives for the EU including budget setting, salary review processes, bonus incentives, market benchmarking, recruitment & retention, pay incentive schemes, reward and benefits policies and processes.
  • Develop, improve and deliver HR data analysis from SuccessFactors & Payroll sources to enhance information reporting to stakeholders, following up on any deviations.
  • Assist with system configuration, testing, and rollout of compensation cycles within the HRIS (SuccessFactors).
  • Market research - developments in the external compensation market amongst our competitors through reading and attendance at data analysis / compensation forums.
  • Maintain the regional job architecture matrix and how this aligns with our salaries and pay ranges across the region.
  • Responsible for solving ADP related invoices and queries, service now tickets, across EU.
  • Conduct regular salary benchmarking, gap-to-market analysis, and compa-ratio reviews to ensure local competitiveness, internal equity and support EU HR with EU Pay Transparency regulations.
  • Complete annual and ad hoc salary surveys for the region to support compensation reviews.
  • Work closely with the Planning team to understand budget and cash flow reporting requirements and information needed from HR.
  • Assist with periodic audits of employee data held in SuccessFactors to maintain data integrity for creation and maintenance of dashboard reporting, to give HR and business leadership clear visibility on reward health.
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all statutory and supplemental benefits in each operating country.
  • Proactively keep updated on business issues and initiatives that may impact on the reward and HR strategy.
  • Support Global Mobility team with ad hoc tasks as required during times of absence including compensation package reviews.
  • Support with the regional recognition schemes and analyse the engagement with local HR teams.
  • Ensure all compensation and benefits documentation, audit trails, and approvals meet internal governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Providing support on other ad-hoc HR projects as required by the wider Reward and HR teams.

The Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Reward Analyst, Compensation & Benefits Analyst, or in a heavily analytical HR role.
  • Proven experience managing data and reward structures across multiple European countries.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in cross functional teams to drive solutions whilst managing multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously without impact to accuracy.
  • Advanced Excel/ Google sheets proficiency (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, complex formulas, data modelling) and strong familiarity with HRIS platforms (SuccessFactors desirable).
  • Experience working with business intelligence tools such a Power BI, Google Looker (strongly desired).
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) is essential; proficiency in additional European languages is an advantage.

Personal Competencies

  • High level of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and financial data.
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with competing deadlines.

The Benefits

  • Paid annual leave of 25 days per annum plus UK bank and public holidays.
  • Hybrid working arrangement.
  • Membership of the Company’s Group Personal Pension Plan.
  • Performance Related Pay a pay award and discretionary annual bonus linked directly to their performance in addition to annual review.
  • Permanent Health Insurance.
  • Death in Service.
  • Private Medical Cover (BUPA) after two years’ service.
  • Employee Assistance Programme, with free independent confidential support and virtual GP services.
  • An interest free annual travel season ticket loan.
  • Family leave policies enhanced above statutory.
  • Enhanced company sick pay policy.
  • Medical health check after two years’ service.
  • Annual eye test and contribution towards glasses for VDU prescriptions.
  • Online employee discount platform.

Application

The closing date for this vacancy is 27th November 2026 but if a significant number of applications are received, it will close earlier.

Applicants must have an existing right to live and work in the UK.

title: Data Analytics Coach & Applied AI Specialist
description:
Data Analytics Coach & Applied AI Specialist | Hybrid – Swansea or Cardiff | £35,000 – £45,000

This is a split role for a hands-on data analyst who wants to move into coaching without leaving technical work behind. Half your week is spent coaching Level 4 Data Analytics apprentices. The other half is spent as the in-house data and applied AI specialist for a growing digital and tech training provider in Wales. You don’t need any teaching or assessing background, because your assessor qualification is fully funded.

The role – Coaching (around 50%):

  • Manage a caseload of 16–24 apprentices on the Agored Cymru Level 4 Data Analytics apprenticeship
  • Run online group sessions and one-to-one coaching, with some visits to apprentices’ workplaces across Wales
  • Hold regular progress reviews with apprentices and their employers
  • Assess learners’ work against awarding body requirements and give clear, timely feedback
  • Keep accurate learner records in line with funding, safeguarding and quality requirements

The role – Data & Applied AI (around 50%):

  • Clean, prepare and analyse data from internal systems
  • Build Power BI dashboards and automated reports on learner progress, achievement and business performance
  • Design and build automations across the e-portfolio and CRM systems
  • Work with the AI team to design practical AI courses for clients and apprentices, covering tools like Claude and Copilot, simple automations and AI governance
  • Help the Managing Director shape the organisation’s data and AI strategy

This is applied AI, not data science. You won’t be building machine learning models.

We’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on data analytics experience, ideally including building internal reporting or data systems
  • Confidence with Excel, SQL, Power BI and Power Automate (or similar)
  • Practical experience using Claude and Copilot
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI, AI governance and data protection, and the confidence to advise others on them
  • The ability to explain data and AI clearly to non-technical people
  • A full UK driving licence and willingness to complete an enhanced DBS check, which will be arranged for you

Desirable:

  • A degree in Data, Maths, Computer Science or a related subject, or equivalent experience
  • Experience leading data projects
  • Welsh language skills

If you don’t tick every box but have strong data skills and a real interest in coaching, it’s still worth getting in touch.

What’s on offer:

  • £36,000 – £40,000 depending on experience
  • Hybrid working from the Swansea or Cardiff office, Monday to Friday, 8:30am – 4:30pm
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, and a workplace pension
  • A fully funded assessor qualification, coaching development support, and a training budget for professional qualifications


As an industry leading, nationwide Marketing, Digital, Analytics, IT and Design recruitment agency, we are continually receiving new assignments to work on, so keep a close eye on our website, Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter pages for a full list of current permanent and interim opportunities as well as marketplace news and fun stuff.
Forward Role is operating as an employment agency.

title: Trainee AI Engineer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Senior Technical Learning Specialist - Data & AI
description:
Senior Technical Learning Specialist – Data & AI | Remote | £60,000 - £90,000 | Permanent, Full-Time

This is a senior trainer role for a data scientist or AI specialist who wants to spend their time teaching. You’ll deliver Data Science, GenAI and Python training to technical and non-technical professionals at a wide range of organisations, and help design the next generation of AI courses. The team sits within one of the UK’s major tech training providers. Most delivery is virtual, with some sessions at training centres and client sites.

The role:

  • Deliver instructor-led training in Data Science, GenAI, machine learning and Python, mostly virtually with some in-person sessions
  • Tailor complex technical content to mixed audiences, from engineers and data scientists to business stakeholders
  • Act as a subject matter expert on client programmes and internal projects in your specialism
  • Bring your own expertise to the design and development of new AI and data courses
  • Keep learner satisfaction scores consistently high, use feedback to improve your delivery, and observe peers to support their development
  • Keep your certifications current and stay on top of emerging tools, especially in GenAI and agentic AI

We’re looking for:

  • Advanced Python, including NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-learn, with hands-on experience building, training and deploying ML models
  • Strong practical knowledge of GenAI, including prompt engineering, LLM optimisation, multimodal AI and agentic AI systems
  • Experience using machine learning, statistical modelling and GenAI to solve real business problems
  • Proven ability to teach complex technical content in an engaging way, whether that comes from formal training, workshops, mentoring or team enablement
  • Awareness of data governance, ethics and responsible AI
  • Eligibility for Enhanced DBS and BPSS clearance

Desirable:

  • Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangGraph, R or Java
  • Experience with Spark, Databricks or similar distributed data platforms, and exposure to MLOps
  • Experience of AWS, Azure or GCP AI/ML services, ideally with vendor certifications
  • An MSc or PhD in Data Science, AI, Computer Science, Maths or a related field, or NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute certifications

title: Data Analyst - Customer Success
description:
Our Global SaaS client is now seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join their Global Customer Success Data Science Team for a 9-month contract.

You’ll play a pivotal role in improving how they measure and deliver customer success, driving impact across Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams, and ensure that data informs strategy, enhances customer journeys, and scales operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Building robust data foundations: Collaborate with engineering to develop pipelines, improve data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.
  • Developing actionable dashboards & reporting: Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide visibility into key performance metrics and think broadly across the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Delivering deep-dive analytics: Conduct root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys.
  • Advancing AI-native analytics: Leverage Gen AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation — helping the team move faster and deliver more scalable, proactive insights.
  • Enabling experimentation & continuous improvement: Support A/B testing and digital experience evaluations by analysing performance outcomes and quantifying customer and business impact.
  • Influencing strategy through storytelling: Communicate insights and trends clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on decisions that improve customer experience, digital adoption, operational performance, and supportability.

Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, ideally with exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development
  • Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (Tableau, Qlik, or similar)
  • Familiarity with big data tools (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes
  • Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support preferred
  • Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (A/B testing) preferred
  • Machine learning and Generative AI experience is a plus

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

title: Trainee AI Programmer
description:
Trainee AI Engineer – No Experience Needed

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Pricing Data Scientist
description:
PRICING DATA SCIENTIST

£80,000 - £100,000
REMOTE (LONDON OFFICE AVAILABLE)

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing business With significant investment being made across data, technology and pricing, you'll have the chance to help build a modern pricing function from the ground up while taking ownership of high-impact modelling work. If you're looking for autonomy, technical challenge and the opportunity to shape the future direction of a business, this role offers all three.

THE COMPANY

This insurance business is investing heavily in its data and pricing capabilities as part of a wider transformation programme. The pricing function is at an early stage of development, creating a rare opportunity to join as one of the key hires and directly influence how pricing is approached across the organisation. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders and have the opportunity to make a visible impact from day one.

THE ROLE

  • Develop and enhance risk pricing models
  • Support a major transformation programme, including the build of a new Python-based rating engine
  • Deliver end-to-end pricing analysis, modelling and performance monitoring
  • Utilise new and existing data sources to improve risk selection and pricing outcomes
  • Conduct customer segmentation and wider analytical projects to support business growth
  • Work closely with pricing, underwriting and data stakeholders across the organisation
  • Take ownership of projects and contribute to the development of a growing pricing function
  • Influence technical direction and help establish best practices within the team

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Strong commercial experience developing GLM and/or GBM pricing models
  • Proven background in risk pricing, rather than commercial or optimisation pricing
  • Experience within personal lines insurance, such as motor, home, pet, travel or van insurance
  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • Experience working across the full pricing model lifecycle
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to a range of stakeholders
  • Strong academic background
  • Experience with pricing transformation projects would be advantageous

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • Base salary of £80,000 - £100,000
  • Remote-first working model
  • London office available for those who wish to attend
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Opportunity to help build and shape a growing pricing function
  • Exposure to large-scale transformation and modern pricing technology
  • Clear progression opportunities as the team expands

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Rachael through the 'Apply' link.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

£782/day (Inside IR35) | 12-Month Contract | London (2 Days Onsite)

Overview

The Clinical Platforms team is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help build and scale AI-powered solutions that support large-scale medical imaging initiatives across the business.

This is a highly technical engineering role sitting at the intersection of Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Cloud Engineering and Data Platforms. You'll be responsible for developing, deploying and maintaining production-grade machine learning systems that enable researchers and scientists to work with complex imaging datasets and AI-driven workflows.

The team is looking for a hands-on engineer with strong Python, Machine Learning and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience who can take ownership of technical solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Designing, building and deploying scalable machine learning and computer vision solutions
  • Developing and maintaining ML infrastructure supporting medical imaging and AI workloads
  • Building end-to-end ML pipelines, including data processing, training, validation and deployment workflows
  • Working with large-scale imaging datasets within cloud-based environments
  • Deploying, monitoring and optimising production machine learning models
  • Developing model architectures and supporting systems for complex imaging use cases
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and improving model performance and production systems
  • Collaborating with engineers, researchers and data scientists across multiple projects
Key Skills & ExperienceEssential
  • Strong commercial experience with Python development
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning solutions into production
  • Strong Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience
  • Experience designing and delivering production-grade ML platforms and workflows
  • Strong understanding of systems architecture and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience building end-to-end machine learning solutions
  • Proven track record delivering machine learning and engineering projects into production
Highly Desirable
  • Computer Vision or Image Processing experience
  • Experience developing and deploying Machine Learning models at scale
  • Experience working with image datasets in production environments
  • PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy or related technologies
  • BigQuery and wider GCP ecosystem experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot
Nice to Have
  • Medical imaging experience
  • DICOM or PACS exposure
  • Healthcare, biotech or pharmaceutical industry experience
Ideal Background

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Senior Machine Learning Engineers
  • Machine Learning Platform Engineers
  • Computer Vision Engineers
  • AI Engineers
  • Applied Scientists
  • Research Engineers
  • Software Engineers with strong Machine Learning and Cloud Engineering experience

The key requirement is strong, hands-on commercial machine learning engineering experience and the ability to design, build and support complex production systems.

Why Join?
  • Work on cutting-edge AI and medical imaging initiatives
  • Join a highly technical engineering team Clinical Platforms function
  • Contribute to AI platforms supporting drug discovery and clinical research
  • Opportunity to work across Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Cloud Engineering projects
  • Long-term 12-month contract with strong extension potential
Contract Details
  • Role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
  • Contract Length: 12 Months
  • Rate: Up to £782/day
  • IR35 Status: Inside IR35
  • Location: London
  • Working Pattern: 2 Days Onsite Per Week

If your background sits across Machine Learning, Computer Vision, AI Engineering and Cloud Platforms, I'd be happy to share further details.

title: Senior Cyber Security Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our Digital Technology team on a permanent basis, with hybrid working from Nottingham, Solihull or Kingswinford.

Senior Cyber Security AnalystHere's what you'll be doing

Salary- £60,875 - £81,543

Location- Nottingham, Solihull or Kingswinford with hybrid working

As a Senior Cyber Security Analyst, you'll independently manage operational cybersecurity activities to help protect E.ON's technology, data and digital services. You'll take ownership of incident response, risk assessments, vulnerability management and the implementation of security controls, ensuring security risks are effectively managed and systems remain secure and resilient.

You'll also play a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance and strengthening security governance across the organisation. This is an opportunity to apply your expertise, drive effective security practices and help safeguard critical services while fostering a strong security culture across the business.

The role holder will form part of our out of hours cyber security incident response.

  • Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents, helping to minimise risks and protect the organisation’s systems and data.
  • Conduct security risk assessments and vulnerability assessments, identifying potential threats and recommending appropriate mitigation measures.
  • Implement, monitor and maintain technical security controls to strengthen the organisation’s security posture.
  • Support the security of cloud environments, networks and endpoint devices, ensuring systems remain protected against emerging threats.
  • Lead cybersecurity compliance activities and support internal and external audits, ensuring adherence to relevant regulatory and security requirements.
  • Develop, maintain and improve security policies, standards and procedures to support effective security governance.
  • Provide security awareness guidance to colleagues, promoting best practices and fostering a strong security culture across the organisation.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance security capabilities, recommending and implementing improvements to strengthen resilience and reduce risk.
What we need from you
  • Proven industry experience in cyber security, ideally 3–5 years, with a recognised professional qualification such as CISSP or working towards it, supported by ongoing CPD.
  • Strong understanding of security operations, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience using SIEM, endpoint protection and vulnerability management tools.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, industry standards and recognised security frameworks.
  • Industry experience with SEC, REC, CAF and UKCSRB.
  • Ability to investigate and respond effectively to security incidents, applying sound judgement and a structured approach to incident management.
  • Strong risk assessment skills, with the ability to identify, evaluate and manage cybersecurity risks.
  • Experience identifying, prioritising and supporting the remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • Ability to support regulatory compliance and ensure adherence to relevant requirements and security standards.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve security-related issues.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and communicate security matters clearly.
  • A collaborative approach to teamwork, working effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared security objectives.

Please note the closing date may end early if we recieve a high volume of applications, please apply at your earliest opportunity.

Here’s what you need to know
  • Award-Winning Workplace - We’re proud to be named a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025 and the Best Place to Work for 16–34-year-olds.
  • Outstanding Benefits - Enjoy 26 days of annual leave plus bank holidays, a generous pension, life cover, bonus opportunities, and access to 20 flexible benefits with tax/NI savings.
  • Flexible & Family-Friendly - Our industry-leading hybrid and family-friendly policies earned us double recognition at the Personnel Today Awards 2024. We’re open to discussing how flexibility can work for you.
  • Inclusive & Diverse - We’re the only energy company in the Inclusive Top 50 UK Employers. We’re also proud winners of Best Employer for Women and Human Company of the Year—recognising our inclusive, people-first culture.
  • Support at Every Stage of Life - We’re Fertility Friendly and Menopause Friendly accredited, with inclusive support for everyone.
  • Accessible & Supportive - Do you consider yourself as having a disability? As a Disability Confident Employer, we ensure that disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria move forward to the next stage of our recruitment process, and will make any adjustments needed during the process.
  • Invested in Your Growth - From inclusive talent networks to top-tier development programmes, we’ll support your growth every step of the way.

title: Trainee Field Service Engineer
description:
Trainee Field Service Engineer - Hotpoint

No Experience Needed | Fully Paid Training | Company Van Provided

Ready to start a hands-on career with one of the UK's most trusted appliance brands?

Hotpoint is looking for motivated individuals to join our 12-month Trainee Field Service Engineer Programme. Whether you're currently working in retail, customer service, warehousing, delivery driving, manufacturing, the armed forces, or another practical role, we'll provide all the training and support you need to build a successful engineering career.

If you enjoy problem-solving, fixing things, working independently, helping customers and learning new skills all within your local area, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

What's in it for You?

  • 12-month paid training programme
  • Equivalent of £27,377 per year for the first 6 months, increasing to £28,352 per year thereafter - Paid weekly via umbrella company
  • Uncapped commission opportunities
  • Overtime available
  • Company van and fuel card provided
  • Tools, equipment and uniform supplied
  • Industry-leading training and ongoing support
  • 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • 25 days holiday upon securing a permanent role
  • Opportunity to gain a permanent position within 12 months
  • Long-term career progression with a recognised household brand

The Role

As a Trainee Field Service Engineer no two days are the same, you'll visit customers in their homes to diagnose and repair domestic appliances while delivering outstanding customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Travel to customer appointments in a company van
  • Diagnose faults and complete repairs
  • Deliver excellent customer service
  • Manage tools, parts and van stock
  • Represent the Hotpoint brand professionally
  • Promote approved products and services, with opportunities to earn commission

You'll work on appliances such as:

  • Washing machines
  • Tumble dryers
  • Electric cookers
  • Other domestic appliances as your training develops

Your Training Journey

Weeks 1-3: Residential Training (Peterborough)

Attend our specialist training centre Monday to Friday, returning home at weekends. Travel and accommodation are arranged and paid for by Hotpoint.

Week 1: Induction

  • Meet your support network
  • Receive your tools, uniform and company van
  • Complete health & safety training
  • Undertake a driving assessment

Weeks 2-3: Technical Training

  • Appliance repairs
  • Fault diagnosis
  • Electrical and mechanical troubleshooting
  • Customer service skills
  • Practical hands-on learning

Weeks 4-6: Field Mentoring

Work alongside an experienced engineer, receiving one-to-one coaching and support while developing your skills.

Months 2-12: On-the-Job Development

Continue building your technical knowledge and confidence with ongoing support and real customer experience.

Additional Upskill Training

Further specialist training will be provided to expand your product knowledge and technical capability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Reliable, professional and customer-focused
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Willing to learn and develop new skills
  • Looking for a long-term career
  • Confident communicating with customers
  • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services
  • Motivated by earning additional commission opportunities

Essential Requirements

  • Full UK Manual Driving Licence held for at least 1 year
  • Physically able to move household appliances safely
  • Right to work in the UK

Desirable Experience

  • Engineering, mechanical, electrical or technical experience
  • Repair, maintenance or fault-finding experience
  • Trades, field-based or customer-facing roles
  • Delivery driving or logistics experience
  • Experience using tools or practical hands-on skills
