title: AI & Automation
description:
AI & IT Automation Specialist


Location: Milton Keynes (predominantly office-based, with some flexibility)

Salary: £30,000–£60,000 (*depending on experience)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about technology, artificial intelligence and finding smarter ways of working?

We are working with an ambitious and growing group of privately owned businesses based in Olney, Buckinghamshire, who are looking to appoint an AI & IT Automation Specialist to help shape how technology is used across their organisation.

The group operates across several complementary sectors, including residential housebuilding, roofing and construction, refurbishment, specialist facades and emerging electric vehicle transmission technology.

Its businesses include an established housebuilder, specialist construction and roofing contractors, a facades business and an innovative EV technology company. With a shared working environment and a forward-thinking leadership team, the group is keen to embrace new technology and use AI to improve efficiency, reduce manual workloads and create better ways of working.

This is an opportunity to play a visible role in that journey, working directly with senior leadership and having genuine influence over how AI and automation are introduced across multiple businesses.

The Role

AI implementation and business process automation will be your primary focus.

You'll be responsible for exploring emerging AI tools, identifying practical opportunities and turning ideas into solutions that make a measurable difference to everyday business operations.

The initial priority will be the finance and accounts function, looking at how AI and automation can improve processes involving invoices, bookkeeping, VAT and administrative workflows. From there, you'll work across the wider group to identify further opportunities in operations, construction, customer administration and other business functions.

You'll also provide practical IT support when required, helping colleagues with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, user accounts, hardware and general technical issues.

The role will suit someone who enjoys combining technical problem-solving with business improvement, whether you're developing your career in AI and automation or already have experience delivering technology-led efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate and implement AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude and other emerging platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes and reduce manual administration.
  • Work initially with finance and accounts teams to improve invoice processing, bookkeeping, VAT-related workflows and reporting.
  • Explore automation opportunities across the group's wider business operations.
  • Configure and integrate AI tools with existing systems, applications and business data.
  • Investigate the potential for developing bespoke AI-powered solutions tailored to the group's processes and requirements.
  • Support the administration of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, user accounts and permissions.
  • Troubleshoot day-to-day hardware, software and connectivity issues when required.
  • Help colleagues understand and adopt new tools, workflows and ways of working.
  • Provide occasional support for wider digital activities and technology-related projects.

About You

We're interested in people with the right combination of technical ability, curiosity and commercial awareness. You don't necessarily need to have years of experience, but you should be enthusiastic about technology and keen to make things work better.

You might be an IT professional looking to move into AI and automation, a junior developer with a strong interest in practical AI applications, or an experienced automation specialist looking for a role with greater ownership and influence.

Ideally, you'll bring some of the following:

  • A genuine interest in artificial intelligence and its practical application within businesses.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms.
  • An understanding of workflow automation, scripting, integrations or low-code/no-code technologies.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint and general IT administration.
  • The ability to investigate problems, test solutions and implement improvements.
  • An interest in business processes and how technology can make organisations more efficient.
  • Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different business functions.
  • A proactive, adaptable approach and the ability to work independently.

Experience with Power Automate, Python, APIs, data integration or developing AI-powered applications would be particularly beneficial, although we're open to candidates with different technical backgrounds.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

  • Real ownership: Work directly with the senior leadership team and help shape the group's AI and technology strategy.
  • Visible impact: Your work will influence how multiple businesses operate, with the opportunity to deliver tangible efficiencies.
  • Variety: Exposure to several industries and business functions rather than working within a single department.
  • Room to develop: An opportunity to grow your technical skills and take on increasing responsibility as the group's AI capabilities evolve.
  • Future potential: If the group's AI initiatives prove successful, there is an ambition to explore establishing a separate business offering AI implementation services to external clients. The successful individual could have the opportunity to play an important role in developing that venture.

If you're excited by the potential of AI, enjoy solving practical problems and want to help businesses embrace new technology, we'd be very interested in hearing from you.

title: Lead Data & AI Architect
description:
Lead Data & AI Architect - AWS - Agentic AI - Decision Intelligence - Fully Remote (UK) - Up to £110,000 + Bonus

We're partnering with an innovative AI software business that is helping enterprise organisations transform complex data into trusted, decision-grade intelligence.

As organisations accelerate their adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI, the challenge is no longer simply accessing data. The challenge is ensuring that AI systems can consume trusted, governed and observable data that delivers reliable outcomes.

We're looking for a Lead Data & AI Architect to help solve that challenge.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys operating beyond traditional data engineering. You'll combine architecture, technical leadership, customer engagement and AI strategy to help shape both customer outcomes and platform direction.

The Opportunity

You'll play a critical role in helping enterprise customers build the foundations required for modern analytics, AI and decision intelligence.

Working closely with customers, product teams and technical stakeholders, you'll help define how trusted data is structured, governed and exposed to support AI-powered applications and business decision-making.

This role combines:

  • Data Platform Architecture
  • AWS Cloud Engineering
  • AI & Agentic AI Enablement
  • Data Governance & Observability
  • Customer-Facing Technical Leadership
  • Solution Design & Technical Strategy

You'll be expected to engage stakeholders, shape technical direction and act as a trusted advisor on complex data and AI challenges.

What You'll Be Doing

Design AI-Ready Data Foundations

Design and evolve modern AWS-based data architectures that support analytics, machine learning and AI-powered applications.

Help Customers Operationalise AI

Work directly with enterprise customers to solve the governance, quality, observability and trust challenges that emerge when AI systems move from experimentation into production.

Shape Data & AI Strategy

Influence architecture decisions, technical standards and best practices across data engineering, analytics and AI initiatives.

Champion Trusted Data

Establish approaches for data quality, lineage, governance and observability that enable organisations to trust the outputs generated by AI and decision intelligence platforms.

Act as a Trusted Technical Advisor

Partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand challenges, define solutions and guide successful delivery.

Drive Technical Excellence

Promote modern engineering practices across architecture, security, governance, platform reliability and cloud-native development.

What We're Looking For


Essential Experience

  • Experience designing and delivering production-grade cloud data platforms.
  • Strong AWS architecture and engineering expertise.
  • Deep understanding of data modelling, SQL and modern data architectures.
  • Experience defining technical strategy and influencing architectural decisions.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Experience working with data governance, lineage, observability and data quality frameworks.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into meaningful business outcomes.
  • Experience working with large-scale or business-critical data environments.

Technology Environment

  • AWS
  • Python
  • SQL
  • Cloud-Native Data Platforms
  • APIs & Data Services
  • Analytics Engineering
  • Data Governance & Observability
  • Machine Learning Infrastructure
  • Generative AI & Agentic Systems
  • Modern Data Architecture Patterns

Why Join?

  • Fully Remote UK-based role
  • Competitive salary up to £110,000
  • Performance-related bonus
  • High levels of ownership and autonomy
  • Significant influence over platform and product direction
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of AI and decision intelligence
  • Work directly with senior technical and business stakeholders
  • Clear progression into broader technical leadership responsibilities

Who Will Thrive Here?

You'll likely enjoy this role if you:

  • Like solving complex technical problems rather than maintaining legacy systems.
  • Enjoy working directly with customers and stakeholders.
  • Want to influence technical strategy rather than simply execute against it.
  • Have strong opinions on data quality, governance and trust.
  • Are excited by the challenge of helping organisations operationalise AI responsibly.
  • Want to play a meaningful role in both platform evolution and customer success.

If you're looking for an opportunity that combines the technical depth of architecture, the variety of consulting, and the opportunity to influence how organisations adopt AI, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Solutions Engineer – Retail Technology
description:
AI Solutions Engineer – Retail Technology

Adria Solutions is recruiting an AI Solutions Engineer for a software business serving the retail sector.

Combining business analysis, customer engagement and hands-on AI coding, this role will suit someone who can understand a customer’s challenge, turn it into clear product requirements and build a working prototype to demonstrate the solution.



The Role

You will work directly with retail customers to understand their operations, explore opportunities for improvement and scope software requirements. Strong experience using AI coding tools is essential, ideally Claude and Claude Code, alongside excellent client-facing and business analysis skills.

From leading discovery workshops to presenting working demos, you will help customers see how their requirements could translate into practical software. You will work closely with product and engineering colleagues to shape agreed improvements.



Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer discovery sessions and workshops with operational, technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Understand retail processes, identify challenges and translate customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Use AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, to build working prototypes and demos that help customers explore and refine their requirements.
  • Design screens and user journeys that make complex processes straightforward to use.
  • Present proposed solutions confidently, explaining functionality and technical considerations in plain English.
  • Work with Product Owners and engineering teams to assess product gaps and agree how requirements should progress.
  • Build and evaluate AI features that support retail operations.
  • Investigate issues across software, data and integrations, documenting findings clearly.


About You

You could come from a technical business analysis, solutions engineering, technical consultancy or software development background. You will need to combine strong customer discovery skills with the technical ability to build and demonstrate solutions.



We are looking for:

  • Strong practical AI coding experience, ideally using Claude or Claude Code to build working software.
  • Excellent client-facing skills, with confidence leading workshops, asking effective questions and presenting to different audiences.
  • Experience gathering, challenging and documenting customer requirements.
  • A clear understanding of how to turn business needs into product specifications and usable software.
  • Experience in retail or grocery technology, such as e-commerce, stock management, order management, warehousing, fulfilment, EPOS or loyalty.

  • Experience creating prototypes, demos and user interfaces.
  • Practical knowledge of LLMs, prompting, retrieval, tool use and evaluation.

Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure as code or retail systems integrations would also be useful.



Interested?

title: AI Builder
description:
AI Builder


  • Salary from £40k to £75k + benefits
  • Role based onsite 4-5 days per week at either central Manchester, central Cheltenham or London Westminster offices (your choice).


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).


This company is a Workflow & AI Orchestration Specialist. They deliver workflow and orchestration solutions that modernise casework, data, and citizen services. They connect fragmented systems to create coherent experiences with AI agents deployed safely at scale. They operate across two pillars: 1) advise and implement to provide end-to-end technology solutions that integrate cutting edge orchestration and 2) agentic AI capabilities. They’re growing fast and looking for bright, dynamic people to help build their business.


Role Overview


They're looking for an AI Builder to join their growing team: someone who builds AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems. They’re looking for someone who can help solve both these questions. First and foremost, they’re looking for someone who can help build these systems. Historically this would have required candidates with a deep understanding of machine learning and AI engineering, but in the new world of agentic coding and high-performance generalised reasoning models, things are clearly a little different.


They build solutions using a combination of APIs, self-hosted models, agentic frameworks and agentic builders integrated into other technology solutions. They use third party products and integrations where useful, but they also design and build their own bespoke systems either when the problem requires or when it makes sense commercially. They generally build their backend systems in Python, although increasingly leverage agentic coding tools so that they are less in the weeds of coding itself, and more building at the system level.


Core to all of this is being able to navigate complex but often poorly defined and open-ended questions effectively. They are looking for candidates who can build solutions quickly and efficiently whilst ensuring these systems are well designed and extensible, who can balance speed with engineering quality and ensure they avoid overengineering solutions too early whilst then productionising and scaling solutions effectively when proven, who can work closely with clients and end users to understand problems whilst iterating towards desired outcomes, and who remain curious and motivated across a rapidly evolving technology and business landscape.


They expect candidates to be comparatively stronger across different areas depending on background and experience, and they are happy to consider candidates from a diverse range of backgrounds from both academia and industry. This includes machine learning and AI engineers, software developers who are looking to focus more on AI, product designers and architects who are looking to move into more technical delivery, and technical researchers (physics, mathematics, computer science etc.) who want to move into more applied development and delivery.


They are also open to different levels of experience and seniority, which is reflected in the relatively wide salary bracket. Most important is experience and interest in building these systems in some form, some level of technical understanding and experience, and curiosity and motivation to continue to learn how to build effective AI and agentic systems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Working directly with the Head of AI & Data to design, develop, deploy and scale AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems, both for clients and internally.
  • Collaborate with service designers, engineers and business analysts to identify and frame AI use cases.
  • Build rapid proof-of-concepts (PoC) and prototype AI systems to demonstrate possible solutions, test technical feasibility, gain feedback on design and gauge overall usefulness.
  • Work with engineering teams to productionise and scale AI and agentic systems within wider products and platforms.
  • Iterate and improve AI and agentic systems already deployed within client organisations and internally to improve performance, quality, robustness, resilience, cost etc. and to further extend features.
  • Build solutions using agentic coding tools, with a strong eye on system design and quality.
  • Advise on AI strategy, adoption and scaling for clients.
  • Contribute to internal R&D, tooling, thought leadership and the company’s AI proposition.
  • Support bids and client engagements where AI capability is a key differentiator.
  • Help maintain awareness of and critically analyse the evolving AI landscape, both at a model / product level and more at a business / strategic level.


Essential Skills and Experience


  • Demonstrable experience building systems that incorporate AI and/or agentic AI, whether that’s in industry, academic or personal projects.
  • Some technical knowledge and experience, either more foundational (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science etc.) or applied (programming, software development etc.).
  • Experience and proficiency developing in Python, including wider system design principles.
  • Some experience developing with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex etc.).
  • Strong system-design judgement: structuring systems so you retain a clear understanding of how they work, even when you didn't hand-write every line, and a sense of how to test and prove them.


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Built a RAG chatbot? Great. Taken an AI solution into production, evaluated its weaknesses and made it genuinely better? Now we're talking.

We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join a growing AI function where the focus is on building intelligent, reliable and scalable solutions that solve real business problems.

This role is for someone who enjoys the difficult engineering challenges behind generative AI: improving retrieval, reducing hallucinations, fine-tuning models and proving that changes genuinely improve performance.

You won't just be experimenting with the latest frameworks. You'll be designing, building, evaluating and improving AI systems that are intended to deliver measurable results.

What will you be working on?

  • Building and optimising production-grade RAG pipelines, including retrieval, chunking, reranking and grounding.
  • Developing advanced GenAI applications and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph and LlamaIndex.
  • Working on model training, fine-tuning, instruction tuning and optimisation.
  • Designing robust model evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, reliability, consistency and overall response quality.
  • Measuring retrieval performance, hallucination rates, groundedness, robustness and safety.
  • Exploring evaluation approaches including BERTScore, human-in-the-loop testing and automated evaluation.
  • Experimenting with models and architectures to improve performance, latency and cost efficiency.
  • Taking ownership of technical solutions from initial design through to production deployment and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to solve complex AI challenges.


What will make you stand out?

  • Strong hands-on Python engineering experience.
  • Proven commercial experience delivering GenAI, LLM or RAG solutions into production.
  • Practical experience using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or comparable orchestration frameworks.
  • Genuine experience in model evaluation, testing and performance improvement.

title: AI Product Analyst
description:
An AI product can look impressive in a demo. But how do you prove it's actually intelligent, accurate and delivering value? That's where you come in.

We're working with an established business making significant investments in AI and generative technology, and we're looking for a commercially minded, technically strong AI Product Analyst to help answer the questions that really matter.

Is the model producing accurate answers? Are users getting what they need? Is retrieval working properly? Are hallucinations decreasing? Are product changes actually improving the experience?

This isn't simply about building dashboards or reporting on usage. You'll be evaluating the performance and quality of AI models and the products they power, helping shape what gets improved, developed and launched next.


What will you actually be doing?

  • Evaluating LLM and RAG product outputs, focusing on accuracy, groundedness, hallucinations, relevance and answer quality.
  • Developing evaluation datasets, scoring frameworks and KPIs to measure model and product performance.
  • Investigating why AI responses fail, why certain queries underperform and where improvements are needed.
  • Using SQL and Python to analyse product behaviour, identify patterns and uncover actionable insights.
  • Measuring the impact of model changes, retrieval improvements and new product features.
  • Designing experiments, analysing user behaviour and identifying opportunities to improve the experience.
  • Working alongside AI Engineers, Product Managers and technical teams to turn evaluation findings into meaningful improvements.
  • Presenting evidence-backed recommendations to senior stakeholders and influencing product decisions.


Who would be a great fit?

You might currently be a Product Analyst, Senior Data Analyst, AI Analyst, Data Scientist or working in a role involving LLM evaluation.


We're particularly interested in people with:

  • Strong SQL and Python skills and the ability to independently investigate complex datasets.
  • Experience in product analytics, experimentation, KPIs, user behaviour or A/B testing.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, LLMs or generative AI products.
  • An understanding of model evaluation, including output quality, accuracy, retrieval performance or evaluation frameworks.
  • The ability to connect technical findings to product improvements and commercial outcomes.
  • Confidence to challenge assumptions, question results and influence technical decisions.

Important: We're looking for someone interested in evaluating how well AI models and products actually perform, rather than simply evaluating AI tools or tracking their adoption.


Why should you consider this?

Because your analysis won't sit in a report that nobody reads.

You'll be helping define what good AI performance looks like, working closely with the people building the technology and influencing decisions that directly shape the product.

You'll have visibility, ownership and the opportunity to make a measurable difference as the business expands its AI capabilities.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We have a hugely exciting opportunity for a Senior AI Engineer who will take HealthHero's AI initiatives from prototype to production.


Your first project will be our flagship, the Clinical Brain: a system that includes a Class II medical device, with an AI layer interacting with deterministic components. You will work on it directly with the Director of Clinical Products and the Head of Quality & Compliance, so you will need to be comfortable building to the rigour, safety, traceability and documentation that a regulated medical device environment requires.


This is a cross-functional role, working across Data, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations and Customer Service teams. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Data Platform team to build scalable AI capabilities, and with Data Scientists and clinical experts to design robust evaluations and ensure the quality, reliability and safety of AI solutions. Your key stakeholders will be the Head of AI Products, and, on the Clinical Brain, the Director of Clinical Products and the Head of Quality & Compliance.


You will own the technical delivery of AI initiatives end to end, from designing solutions and making architectural choices to building, evaluating and deploying them into production. You will also contribute to shaping our AI engineering practices and technical roadmap.


Your work will give clinicians time back, help patients access the right care faster, and make our teams more efficient, while maintaining the highest standards of clinical quality, patient safety and data protection.


About the role


Drive AI strategy and technical leadership

  • Partner with Product, Data, Engineering, Clinical and Operations teams to identify, scope and evaluate AI opportunities.
  • Challenge requirements and technical approaches, assess feasibility, business value and costs, and help prioritise high-impact initiatives.
  • Contribute to the AI roadmap, architectural decisions and technology choices, while helping define AI engineering best practices and sharing expertise across teams.


Your first project: the Clinical Brain

The Clinical Brain is our flagship project and will be your first priority. It is a system that includes a Class II medical device, with an AI layer interacting with deterministic components, and you will build it hand in hand with the Director of Clinical Products, the Head of Quality & Compliance and the Head of AI Products. You will:


  • Abstract patient intent: turn free-text and conversational patient input into structured, clinically meaningful intents.
  • Condense and cluster questionnaires: reduce and group clinical questionnaires while preserving clinical meaning and safety.
  • Combine NLP, LLMs and machine learning: design the AI layer and its interfaces with the deterministic components so that every output is traceable and explainable, with patient safety built in.
  • Optimise the clinical graph: improve the structure and performance of the knowledge graph that underpins the Clinical Brain.
  • Work with the Director of Clinical Products to translate clinical needs into AI behaviour, and to design and run clinical validation.
  • Work with the Head of Quality & Compliance to meet Class II medical device requirements: design documentation, risk management, change control and traceability from requirement to test.


Evaluation

Evaluation is the backbone of the Clinical Brain and of every AI feature we ship. Building on the existing practices of our Data Scientists and clinical experts, you will:


  • Golden datasets: curate and maintain reference datasets with clinicians, covering common cases, edge cases and safety-critical scenarios.
  • Mixtures of evaluators: go beyond a single LLM-as-judge by combining multiple judges, calibrating them against clinician review and measuring inter-rater agreement.
  • Human-in-the-loop review: design efficient clinician review workflows that feed back into datasets, prompts and models.
  • Regression testing: automate evaluation so that every prompt, model or data change is gated before release.
  • Evidence for regulation: produce evaluation evidence that supports the Class II medical device documentation within the Clinical Brain, and monitor performance and safety once in production.


Essential (must haves)

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years shipping LLM or ML-based features to production.
  • Strong TypeScript (our codebase is mostly TypeScript and .NET), plus solid Python for AI and data work.
  • Comfortable with APIs, cloud services (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral or similar) and frameworks for RAG, agents and tool use.
  • Proven track record building evaluation pipelines (test sets, metrics, LLM-as-judge) and using the results to drive decisions, with experience of or strong interest in methods beyond a single judge, such as mixtures of evaluators, calibration against clinician labels and inter-rater agreement.
  • Solid prompt engineering skills and a disciplined, experimental mindset.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security when working with sensitive personal data.
  • Experience of, or a clear commitment to, working in a regulated medical device environment (Class II): documentation, change control, traceability and risk management.
  • Clear communicator who can work with clinicians, product managers and non-technical stakeholders.

Future-proof your career in Artificial Intelligence – starting today.

Looking for a career change? Currently employed but want something better? Or maybe you're between jobs and ready for a fresh start? ITOL Recruit's AI Traineeship is designed to get you into one of the fastest-growing industries with zero experience required.

Train online at your own pace and land your first AI Engineer role in 1-3 months.

Please note this is a training course and fees apply

Job guaranteed - complete the programme and get a job or get your money back.

Our candidates earn £28,000-£45,000.


Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.


What You Get

· 100% online, self-paced training

· Microsoft AI-900 certification included

· 1-to-1 tutor and recruitment support

· Real-world project experience

· Job guarantee – get a job or your money back

· Starting salary of £28,000–£45,000


We Get You Hired

We're not new to this. ITOL Recruit has 15+ years of experience and has placed over 5,000 people into new roles.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

"Five months from complete beginner to AI engineer. Best decision I ever made." – Jamie W., now working as a Junior AI Engineer in London


Ready to Start?

If you’re motivated, curious, and excited about technology, we’ll help you turn that into a career you can be proud of.

Apply now, and one of our expert Career Advisors will be in touch within 4 working hours to guide you through your next steps.

title: Senior Data & AI Engineer
description:
Senior Data & AI Engineer - London (Hybrid) - Up to £90,000

We are working with an innovative consultancy who are looking for a Senior Data and AI Engineer to help build and scale customer-facing data products powered by modern AI technologies.


This is a product-driven role, where you would work between data engineering, product development and artificial intelligence, you'll transform complex data sets into valuable solutions that enable customers to make better decisions faster.


Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience building and operating data platforms within the Azure ecosystem.
  • Azure Databricks experience.
  • Expertise designing scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures and governed data products.
  • Experience deploying production workloads through CI/CD and engineering best practices.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data modelling, data quality, governance and platform optimisation.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, semantic search, embedding and AI-powered applications.
  • Ability to work closely with product, commercial and technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions.

Why Apply?

  • Build impactful data and AI products rather than purely internal infrastructure.
  • Work with a modern Azure and Databricks technology stack.
  • Influence AI strategy and product innovation.
  • Join a business where data is central to commercial growth and decision-making.
  • Enjoy significant ownership, autonomy and opportunities for progression.
  • Hybrid working environment with flexibility and strong stakeholder engagement.

This is an opportunity to build innovative data and AI products that directly influence business growth, working with a modern stack including Azure, Databricks and Generative AI. You'll have significant ownership, shape their AI product strategy and see your work delivered to end users rather than remaining behind the scenes.


Interested? Get in touch with Joshua at for more information.

All applicants MUST be UK-based with full right to work in the UK and be eligible for SC Clearance.

Tenth Revolution Group are the go-to recruiter for Data & AI roles in the UK offering more opportunities across the country than any other recruitment agency. We're the proud sponsor and supporter of SQLBits, Power Platform World Tour, and the London Fabric User Group. We are the global leaders in Data & AI recruitment.

title: Reconciliations Analyst
description:
Scale-up Payments Business | Central London
£30,000–£35,000 + Study Support

Absolute Recruit is partnering with an ambitious payments scale-up in Central London to recruit an exceptional graduate into its finance team.
This is an opportunity to work closely with experienced finance professionals, take responsibility for business-critical work and build your career through a two-year growth and development plan, with professional accountancy study support.

The opportunity
You’ll join a lean, ambitious finance team where your work will have a visible impact. From the outset, you’ll help ensure financial data is accurate, transactions reconcile and the business can rely on its daily financial controls.

You’ll receive practical training and guidance from two Financial Analysts, giving you the support to learn quickly and develop a strong understanding of how a payments business operates.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Performing daily data and safeguarding reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and following them through to resolution.
  • Completing corporate bank reconciliations.
  • Monitoring the accounts payable inbox and ensuring invoices are captured in the accounting system.
  • Using existing reconciliation tools and checking the accuracy of their outputs.
  • Helping identify ways to make processes more accurate and efficient.
Your two-year growth plan
The business wants someone who is keen to develop beyond their starting responsibilities.
Over two years, the aim is to combine hands-on finance experience with supported progress towards a professional accountancy qualification such as ACCA or ACA. You’ll build your technical knowledge, develop greater independence and take on more responsibility as your capability grows.

You’ll benefit from study support, exam leave and planned preparation time, alongside day-to-day guidance from the finance team. As you develop, there will be scope to explore broader responsibilities within finance and the growing business, based on your strengths, performance and available opportunities.

About you
We’re looking for a high-achieving graduate with the curiosity, discipline and ambition to build a career in finance.
  • An excellent academic record, including strong A-level results or equivalent.
  • Ideally, a first-class degree in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or another analytical or scientific subject.
  • Strong numerical reasoning and the ability to spot inconsistencies in detailed information.
  • A careful, organised approach and a willingness to investigate when something doesn’t look right.
  • Confidence learning new systems, utilising AI and working with data.
  • A clear interest in professional accountancy study and long-term development.
  • High standards for your own work, with the confidence to ask questions and take ownership.
A placement or sandwich year would be valuable, but previous finance experience is not essential. Academic ability, attitude and potential matter most.

What’s on offer?
  • £30,000–£35,000, depending on experience and academic profile.
  • A two-year development plan within an ambitious payments scale-up.
  • Professional accountancy study support, including exam leave and preparation time.
  • Close support from an experienced finance team.
  • Meaningful responsibility early in your career.
  • A Central London office.
  • Hybrid working: three days in the office and two from home, following an initial three-month office-based training and probation period.
  • Working hours of 9:00am–5:30pm.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist - SC Cleared
Location: London - 1 - 2 days per week onsite
Rate: £650 - £750 per day (Inside IR35)
Contract: 6 months initially, long term programme
Start: ASAP
Clearance: Active SC Clearance required

The Opportunity
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist with strong engineering skills to join a major government programme. You'll work on a large-scale data matching platform that supports national security outcomes, improving its accuracy, performance and reliability in production.

This role suits someone who is as comfortable working in AWS, Kubernetes and the command line as they are analysing data. Direct matching experience isn't essential. If you've worked on classification, deduplication, fraud detection, search or similar problems where precision and recall matter, we'd like to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse and improve the performance of a production data matching platform
  • Build, test and deploy data-driven improvements to matching logic
  • Work across AWS and Kubernetes environments, automating with Bash and Python
  • Improve accuracy and reduce false positives to increase operational efficiency
  • Partner with engineering teams to take improvements into production
  • Support performance testing and ongoing optimisation

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
  • Hands-on AWS experience
  • Kubernetes and Docker in a production setting
  • Confident with Bash scripting and Linux
  • Solid SQL and experience with large datasets
  • Good grasp of model evaluation: precision, recall and false-positive tuning

Nice to Have

  • Entity resolution, record linkage or fuzzy matching
  • Elasticsearch or OpenSearch
  • Kafka, PostgreSQL, Jenkins or Ansible
  • Government, defence, security, fraud or identity environments

Security Clearance: Active SC clearance is required.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer - Remote UK - £110,000 + Share Options + Private Medical Insurance

A high-growth, venture-backed AI technology company is looking for a Lead Data Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of its data, analytics and AI capabilities. This is an opportunity to join an innovative organisation delivering cutting-edge AI-powered solutions to major enterprise clients, helping transform complex data into meaningful business intelligence.

The Opportunity

This is a senior, hands-on position offering significant technical ownership and influence. Working closely with product, engineering, data science and leadership teams, you'll design and build scalable data platforms that power advanced analytics, machine learning, decision intelligence and emerging AI technologies. As the business continues to grow, there will be the opportunity to help build and lead a wider data function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain scalable data platforms and pipelines.
  • Develop Data-as-a-Service capabilities across products and customer solutions.
  • Create trusted analytics, reporting and business intelligence solutions.
  • Design and manage secure, reliable data services and APIs.
  • Build data infrastructure supporting machine learning, statistical models and AI systems.
  • Establish best practices for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata and observability.
  • Embed security, privacy and compliance into data architecture and engineering processes.
  • Collaborate across technical and commercial teams to influence data strategy and architecture.

Required Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience building and operating production-grade data platforms.
  • Expertise in data architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modelling and orchestration.
  • Experience working with large-scale or complex datasets.
  • Background delivering analytics and business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience designing secure data services and APIs.
  • Knowledge of machine learning data foundations and modern AI-enablement practices.
  • Strong understanding of statistics, experimentation and data-driven decision making.
  • Experience working within enterprise or highly regulated environments.
  • Passion for engineering excellence, security, quality and continuous improvement.
  • AWS data and analytics ecosystem

What's on Offer?

  • Salary of £110,000.
  • Share options.
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Fully remote UK-based working.
  • High levels of autonomy and technical ownership.
  • Opportunity to shape the future direction of data and AI within a rapidly scaling technology business.
  • Clear progression into leadership as the organisation grows.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer - Azure Databricks

Salary: Up to £90,000 per annum

Location: London

Job type: Permanent

About the role

A well-established international B2B events and media business is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to build, run and improve its Azure Databricks platform, which supports analytics, customer insight and AI. You will own the infrastructure, tooling and integrations behind the platform, keeping it secure, reliable and easy for engineering teams to use.

Working with the Data Platform Lead and delivery partners, you will help take the platform into ongoing operation and improve its security, reliability and cost efficiency. You will support Data Engineers and provide the environments and tools that data scientists and AI engineers need to build and run models and applications.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage Azure infrastructure through Terraform, including storage, Key Vault and Databricks workspaces across development, staging and production
  • Configure and support Databricks workspaces, compute policies, SQL warehouses and Unity Catalog
  • Operate networking and connectivity, including virtual networks, private endpoints, DNS and VPN
  • Design, build and support integrations between the platform and business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot and registration providers
  • Maintain CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Databricks bundle deployments
  • Implement least-privilege access, managed identities and secrets handling, working with IT on Entra ID
  • Own monitoring, alerting and incident response, plus backup and recovery
  • Improve performance and cost visibility, and document and automate platform operations

Essential skills

  • Experience operating production Azure infrastructure (networking, storage, identity, monitoring)
  • Hands-on Terraform, including remote state and drift detection
  • Practical Azure Databricks administration
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Delta Lake and lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture
  • CI/CD using Git and GitHub Actions or similar
  • Production integration experience using REST APIs and managed connectors
  • Cloud security fundamentals: private networking, service principals, managed identities and secrets management
  • Python, PowerShell or similar for automation and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting production services and managing incidents

Desirable

  • Unity Catalog permissions, masking and audit logging
  • Databricks Asset Bundles and Lakeflow
  • Salesforce, HubSpot or event registration integrations
  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Defender for Cloud
  • Disaster recovery testing and cloud cost optimisation

What you'll bring

A methodical, ownership-driven approach, clear communication, and the confidence to work with data engineers, IT, security colleagues and delivery partners.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Job title: AI Automation Engineer

Salary: Up to £70,000 per annum

Location: London

Job type: Permanent

About the role

A well-established, international business is looking for an AI Automation Engineer to design, build and support intelligent workflows that cut repetitive work and improve how the business operates. You will work with teams across Finance, HR, Operations and Customer Success to understand their processes and deliver practical solutions using workflow platforms, API integrations and AI agents. The aim is to save time, improve accuracy and free colleagues to focus on higher-value work.

Key responsibilities

  • Work with business teams to document manual processes and identify the best automation opportunities, choosing between straightforward workflow automation and AI
  • Assess opportunities on benefit, complexity and risk, and track time saved, accuracy, cost and user adoption
  • Build, test and deploy end-to-end workflows using automation platforms, API integrations and generative AI or LLM agents
  • Implement intelligent document processing to extract, categorise and validate information from emails, PDFs, invoices and contracts
  • Connect cloud business systems through secure integrations and reliable data flows
  • Build in approvals, permissions, exception handling and escalation routes, with human oversight
  • Test workflow behaviour and AI output quality, and add logging, alerts, retries and recovery procedures
  • Support live automations, investigate failures and manage API and system changes
  • Document workflows and make sure they follow security, privacy and access-control requirements

Essential skills

  • Demonstrable experience independently delivering and supporting production automations with measurable business benefits
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n, Make.com, Zapier, UiPath or Automation Anywhere
  • Experience integrating AI APIs (for example OpenAI or Anthropic) for summarisation, classification or assisted decision-making, including evaluating output quality and handling incorrect responses
  • Strong Python and JavaScript
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON and SQL, including authentication, permissions and secure credential handling
  • Analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical capabilities clearly to non-technical colleagues

Desirable

  • Background in systems integration, backend development, DevOps or RPA engineering
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases or AI orchestration frameworks

To apply, send your CV and we will be in touch

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer | Fareham, Hampshire

Permanent

We're working with our client, a growing technology business, to recruit an AI Engineer who will run, secure and build AI across the organisation.

Our client already uses AI day to day: Microsoft Copilot business-wide, Azure AI Foundry, Claude Code for building internal software tools, and locally hosted models running through a self-hosted n8n workflow platform. They now need an engineer to run it all properly, keep it secure, and build what comes next. AI is expected to touch almost every business system over time, so this role will grow with the company.


What you'll do

Run and support the AI platform

  • Deploy and manage AI services and supporting applications on Linux, containers and virtual machines, including monitoring, patching, backup and recovery
  • Maintain and improve the local inference environment and self-hosted automation platform
  • Manage code and deployments through GitLab
  • Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and vulnerability remediation


Secure and govern

  • Build in safeguards: authentication, least-privilege access, input validation, audit logging and human approval for sensitive actions
  • Protect against AI risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, unsafe tool use and over-permissioned agents
  • Apply secure-by-design controls: data classification, encryption, secrets management and separated development, test and production environments
  • Help define AI governance, risk assessments and technical standards, and evaluate models, platforms and suppliers


Build

  • Design, prototype and support AI applications, assistants, agents and workflow automations
  • Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search and knowledge solutions connected safely to company documents, databases and APIs
  • Design, deploy and govern Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, clients and tools
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, data and outputs


Connect to the business

  • Work with the wider business systems used across Engineering, Manufacturing and corporate functions, learning how the processes work so AI can integrate with them properly
  • Troubleshoot integration and authentication issues and coordinate changes with colleagues and suppliers


What you'll bring


Essential

  • Experience deploying and operating applications on Linux, containers and virtual machines, including monitoring, patching, backup and recovery
  • Understanding of secure development, access control, data protection, auditability and responsible AI
  • Practical experience building or supporting AI-enabled applications, integrations or automations (minimum 1 year, or less if you're strong in the areas above)
  • Experience with APIs, structured data, authentication and role-based access control
  • Source control and scripting or automation skills
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and clear communication and documentation


Desirable

  • A software development background
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, AI agents and MCP
  • Experience with n8n or similar workflow tools, GitLab, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot or locally hosted models
  • Exposure to business systems such as PLM, ERP or MES


Why this opportunity

  • A real mix of infrastructure, security and AI build work, not a narrow single-platform role
  • A live environment where AI is already in use, with scope to shape standards and safeguards
  • Direct influence on how AI is adopted across the whole business


Package and working pattern

  • Office-based in Fareham, with up to 2 days a week remote after probation (subject to project and on-site needs)
  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, rising with service, plus holiday buy/sell
  • Flexi working (core hours 10:00-15:00)
  • Private medical insurance, health cash plan, life assurance (3x salary) and group income protection
  • Pension with 5% employer contribution
  • Cycle to Work and Electric Car schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme and professional membership reimbursement

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Senior Databricks Data Engineer

3-Month Contract | Outside IR35 | Fully Remote | £500 per day - January Start

The Opportunity

We're supporting a business that is investing heavily in its data capabilities and is looking for an experienced Senior Databricks Data Engineer to take ownership of a growing cloud-based data platform.

This assignment will focus on building a robust and scalable data ecosystem that supports reporting, analytics and strategic decision-making across a range of business functions. You'll work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform fragmented data sources into trusted, well-governed datasets that drive real business value.

This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who is comfortable leading technical decisions, establishing best practices and delivering production-grade Databricks solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and enhancing data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark and SQL.
  • Designing and implementing scalable Lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake.
  • Integrating data from a variety of platforms through APIs, file-based ingestion and third-party systems.
  • Developing and maintaining Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers to support analytics and reporting requirements.
  • Defining data governance standards, lineage, security controls and access management.
  • Delivering robust ETL/ELT solutions across cloud environments.
  • Establishing monitoring, testing and data quality frameworks to improve reliability and trust in data.
  • Implementing CI/CD practices and automated deployment processes.
  • Optimising Databricks workloads for performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Working closely with analytics, reporting and business teams to turn requirements into technical solutions.
  • Supporting and mentoring other members of the wider data function.

Required Experience

  • Strong commercial experience delivering enterprise-scale data engineering solutions on Databricks.
  • Advanced Python, PySpark and SQL skills.
  • Proven experience designing Lakehouse architectures and working with Delta Lake.
  • Strong understanding of Databricks Workflows and production pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience implementing data governance controls using Unity Catalog or similar tooling.
  • Experience building cloud-native data solutions within Azure, AWS or GCP environments.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and analytical data structures.
  • Experience with source control, automated testing and deployment pipelines.
  • Knowledge of security, governance and compliance requirements when handling sensitive data.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders and translate requirements into technical outcomes.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.
  • Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Power BI integration and optimisation.
  • Experience working with HR, workforce, payroll or other sensitive operational datasets.
  • Previous experience acting as a technical lead or subject matter expert within a Databricks environment.

Ideal Candidate

You'll be a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of platform design and engineering standards. You're equally comfortable discussing architectural decisions with technical teams as you are explaining data solutions to business stakeholders.

This contract would suit someone with deep Databricks expertise who wants to make an immediate impact within a business undergoing significant data transformation.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

Manchester/Remote-on site once a month

£57,650

A Senior Data Engineer is required for our not-for-profit client who are based in Manchester. The successful candidate is required to design, develop and optimise the organisation's modern data platform, ensuring trusted, secure and high-quality data is available to support reporting, business intelligence, analytics and AI-driven decision making. • Build and optimise ETL and ELT processes.

• Develop robust integrations between cloud-based and on-premise systems, ensuring data is accessible, secure and reliable.

• Implement data quality controls, monitoring processes, governance standards and security measures.

• Support the modernisation of legacy reporting and data platforms, helping drive the adoption of Microsoft Fabric and cloud-based technologies.

Skills:

• Driven by high standards and motivated to deliver secure, reliable and scalable data solutions that add value to the organisation.

title: M&A Data Analyst
description:
Recruit Wealth are delighted to be representing one of the largest and fastest growing national Financial Planning businesses who are currently seeking an experienced M&A Data Analyst.

This award winning business has built an excellent reputation for delivering holistic, independent financial advice, providing a whole of market advisory service across financial planning and wealth management.

The position supports the existing M&A and Integration team through the management, analysis and reporting of acquisition related data.

The role combines data analysis, stakeholder coordination, reporting and administrative support throughout the acquisition and integration life-cycle.

Sellick Partnership is currently supporting a large not-for-profit organisation with the recruitment of a Senior Data Engineer to join their technology team on a permanent basis.

* Building and optimising ETL and ELT processes to support reporting, analytics, business intelligence and AI initiatives

* Designing and maintaining modern data architectures including Data Lakes, Lakehouses, Data Warehouses and semantic models

* Developing robust integrations across cloud-based and on-premises systems, applications and third-party data sources

* Implementing data quality controls, monitoring processes, governance standards and security measures

* Supporting the migration and modernisation of legacy reporting and data platforms into Microsoft Fabric environments

* Designing and maintaining scalable data models to support reporting, analytics and advanced data initiatives

* Working closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions

* Producing technical documentation, solution designs and operational procedures

* Supporting platform enhancement, innovation and continuous improvement activities

Required experience/qualifications of the Senior Data Engineer position will include

* Strong experience developing enterprise data solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse Analytics

* Advanced SQL development skills, including query optimisation and performance tuning

* Experience designing and developing complex ETL and ELT processes

* Strong understanding of data warehousing, data lake and Lakehouse architectures

* Experience with data modelling techniques including dimensional modelling and star schemas

* Experience building secure, scalable and high-performing data platforms

* Experience integrating multiple business systems and data sources within cloud-based environments

* Strong understanding of cloud-based reporting, analytics and business intelligence platforms

* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security principles and compliance requirements

* Ability to translate business requirements into practical data engineering solutions

Desirable experience/qualifications will include

* Azure Data Factory

* DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code

* DataOps practices

* AI, machine learning or advanced analytics platforms

* Dynamics 365, CRM or ERP integrations

* Experience delivering cloud modernisation programmes

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys building modern cloud-based data platforms and helping organisations unlock greater value from their data while supporting large-scale transformation initiatives.

Please note that sponsorship is not available for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK.

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Behind that is a strong Investment Operations team making sure our investment products run smoothly, controls work as they should and issues are identified and resolved quickly.

As an Investment Operations Analyst, you’ll play an important part in keeping our funds and Managed Portfolio Services operating effectively.   • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with good attention to detail and confidence working with investment and operational data.

• Experience producing forecasts, reporting and variance analysis

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer - London - Up to £90,000

About the role

A well-established global B2B events and media business is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to build, run and improve its Azure Databricks platform, which supports analytics, customer insight and AI. You will own the infrastructure, tooling and integrations behind the platform, keeping it secure, reliable and easy for engineering teams to use.

Working with the Data Platform Lead and delivery partners, you will help take the platform into ongoing operation and improve its security, reliability and cost efficiency. You will support Data Engineers and provide the environments and tools that data scientists and AI engineers need to build and run models and applications.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage Azure infrastructure through Terraform, including storage, Key Vault and Databricks work spaces across development, staging and production
  • Configure and support Databricks work spaces, compute policies, SQL warehouses and Unity Catalog
  • Operate networking and connectivity, including virtual networks, private endpoints, DNS and VPN
  • Design, build and support integrations between the platform and business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot and registration providers
  • Maintain CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Databricks bundle deployments
  • Implement least-privilege access, managed identities and secrets handling, working with IT on Entra ID
  • Own monitoring, alerting and incident response, plus backup and recovery
  • Improve performance and cost visibility, and document and automate platform operations

Essential skills

  • Experience operating production Azure infrastructure (networking, storage, identity, monitoring)
  • Hands-on Terraform, including remote state and drift detection
  • Practical Azure Databricks administration
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Delta Lake and lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture
  • CI/CD using Git and GitHub Actions or similar
  • Production integration experience using REST APIs and managed connectors
  • Cloud security fundamentals: private networking, service principals, managed identities and secrets management
  • Python, PowerShell or similar for automation and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting production services and managing incidents

Desirable

  • Unity Catalog permissions, masking and audit logging
  • Databricks Asset Bundles and Lakeflow
  • Salesforce, HubSpot or event registration integrations
  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Defender for Cloud
  • Disaster recovery testing and cloud cost optimisation

What you'll bring

A methodical, ownership-driven approach, clear communication, and the confidence to work with data engineers, IT, security colleagues and delivery partners.

Interested? Get in touch with Joshua at for more information.

All applicants MUST be UK-based with full right to work in the UK.

Tenth Revolution Group are the go-to recruiter for Data & AI roles in the UK offering more opportunities across the country than any other recruitment agency. We're the proud sponsor and supporter of SQLBits, Power Platform World Tour, and the London Fabric User Group. We are the global leaders in Data & AI recruitment.

title: People Finance Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a commercially minded People Finance Analyst to join our People team and play a key role in helping the business make confident, data- led decisions around our People costs.

Working alongside the Finance and People teams, you’ll take ownership of key cost and income lines, ensuring high standards of management accounting, reconciliation, reporting, and forecasting.

You’ll turn payroll, bonus, and pay rate data into meaningful commercial insight that supports business profitability, while embracing AI and emerging technology to spot trends and anomalies.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Take ownership of month-end management accounting for People cost lines, preparing monthly prepayments, accruals, journal postings, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Deliver accurate, timely monthly P&L reporting and flash forecasts, providing meaningful variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year.
  • Support the annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes by partnering with budget holders to review costs and drive strong cost control.
  • Calculate, analyse, and report on monthly payroll, pay rates, and bonus numbers, partnering with our Operations team to help them achieve their targets.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external partners, using Excel and Business Objects to create clear reports and dashboards that aid business decision-making.
  • Assist in managing our company fleet vehicles, monitoring lease, fuel, and repair costs while ensuring full policy and insurance compliance.
  • Embrace AI and emerging technology to uncover trends and anomalies in People cost data, turning complex numbers into clear, actionable insights.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis, reporting, and departmental initiatives driven by the wider corporate agenda.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Part-qualified accountant (ACCA/CIMA) or equivalent experience in management accounting, ideally within a retail or multi-site environment.
  • Strong core accounting knowledge, with hands-on experience in accruals, prepayments, variance analysis, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • High attention to detail when handling sensitive data such as payroll, pay rates, and bonus calculations.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI reporting tools (such as Business Objects), paired with an appetite for using AI to improve analysis.
  • The ability to turn complex financial data into clear commercial insight and build trusted relationships with non-finance stakeholders across HR and Operations.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach to cost control, with the confidence to spot anomalies, solve problems, and support ad-hoc projects.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
  • Discretionary Bonus – We love to share our success with you!
  • Access to Stream, to support your financial wellbeing needs, giving you more control and flexibility with your pay.
  • Hybrid Working! 3 days office and 2 days off-site.
  • Access to our TPS Perks which offers you a variety of saving and discount options.
  • Buy & Sell Holiday scheme and Life Assurance.
  • 20% staff discount, as well as discounts at Superdrug and Three Mobile.
  • Round the clock support from our partnership with RetailTrust.

title: Data Analyst Trainee

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

  • Hybrid working in London.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and automation technologies.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Lead Databricks Engineer

£600 - £800 per day

London | Contract

An opportunity for an experienced Lead Databricks Engineer to take ownership of the future-state data platform for a large financial services organisation.

The business is looking to move away from traditional, slow batch processing towards a more modern, scalable and streaming-led data architecture. You'll play a key role in defining the data strategy, shaping the technical roadmap and leading delivery across a complex data environment.

The Company

A well-established organisation within the UK financial services and pensions sector, operating at significant scale with substantial volumes of legacy and live data.

The business is undertaking a major data transformation, focused on improving how data is ingested, managed, governed and made available for analytics. You'll work alongside internal teams and offshore delivery partners, helping to establish technical direction and drive progress across the wider programme.

The Role & Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the end-to-end data strategy, assessing the existing architecture and establishing a clear target-state vision and delivery roadmap.

  • Architect and develop a modern Databricks data platform, implementing medallion architecture principles across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.

  • Establish a robust Gold layer to support reliable, scalable analytics and business reporting.

  • Drive the transition from monthly batch processing towards more frequent, near-real-time and streaming-based data ingestion where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions, helping prioritise data use cases and balance architectural requirements with business objectives.

  • Work closely with internal engineering teams and offshore delivery partners to resolve blockers, establish clear ownership and maintain delivery momentum.

  • Engage with senior stakeholders, providing clear updates on technical progress, priorities, risks and recommended next steps.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience operating as a Lead or Principal Data Engineer, ideally within financial services, pensions or another regulated environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms using Databricks.

  • Deep understanding of medallion architecture, including the design and optimisation of Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.

  • Experience modernising legacy data environments and integrating large, complex datasets into modern cloud-based data platforms.

  • Exposure to streaming technologies and real-time data ingestion, with experience moving away from traditional batch-led architectures.

  • Ability to define technical strategy, shape data architecture and translate business requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience leading delivery across distributed onshore and offshore engineering teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and take ownership of technical direction.

title: Data Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Data Coordinator

Location: Doncaster, South Yorkshire

Salary: £27000 to £30000 per annum

Job Type: Permanent, Full time

About the role:

As the Data Coordinator, you will support the accurate, timely and consistent flow of data across the organisation. The role is focused on monitoring data processes, maintaining datasets, coordinating reporting cycles, carrying out quality checks and ensuring that data is complete, reliable and ready for operational use. You will work closely with internal teams to resolve data issues, improve processes and maintain clear documentation, with limited direct client-facing responsibility.

Data Operations and Monitoring

  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking information.
