  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for working effectively with internal stakeholders.
  • Confidence investigating issues, following defined processes and escalating risks appropriately.
  • A responsible approach to confidential, commercially sensitive and personal data.
  • Desirable Experience

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Our client, a growing specialist consultancy, is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join its engineering team in London (hybrid, 2 days a week in the office).

This is a hands-on engineering role that sits close to client delivery. Roughly half the work is building and hardening the pipelines and data models behind the platform and our core delivery work. The other half is applying them to live client engagements, which means understanding what has actually been asked for, shaping the technical approach with our consultants, and standing behind the output.

You will:

• Build and maintain AI-assisted assessment pipelines that extract and evaluate evidence from company disclosures, with the quality assurance and citation discipline our clients expect

• Own data models and ingestion for portfolio and issuer data

• Work alongside consultants, and sometimes directly with clients, to turn methodology into something reproducible and auditable, and to scale established methodologies across new engagements

• Take responsibility for output quality, including evaluation frameworks, benchmarking of pipeline performance, and the review steps that catch errors before a client does

• Contribute to platform engineering more broadly: APIs, backend services, deployment and observability

• Help shape engineering standards as the team grows, and support more junior engineers

What we are looking for

Essential

• Around four to five years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python

• Practical production experience with large language models, including prompt design, evaluation, and the work of making probabilistic output reliable enough to ship

• Solid relational data modelling and SQL, and experience building pipelines that other people depend on

• Cloud experience (Microsoft Azure or GCP), and comfort owning a piece of work end to end from design through to deployment and monitoring

• The ability to work with non-technical colleagues and clients, explain trade-offs clearly, and push back where a request does not make sense

• Comfort with ambiguity and with small-company reality, where scope is not always defined for you

Desirable

• Financial services, investment management or ESG and sustainability domain exposure

• Experience with document processing and information extraction at scale

• Experience introducing evaluation or testing practice into an AI product


Salary £70,000 – £125,000 plus benefits. Permanent, hybrid (London, 2 days a week in the office).

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

If after 1 year of passing your formal qualifications, we have been unable to help you secure a role, we will refund your study fees minus the cost of the exams.

However, we are normally able to help candidates find their first role within 6 months of qualifying and for locations based close to major cities this is often reduced to less than 3 months.

Check our testimonials from the hundreds of candidates we have already helped.

What Now?

To accommodate candidates, the training element of the package is available on finance terms of up to 1 year. This enables you to get qualified and start in your new role without having to fund all the training costs up front.

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer any questions that you may have and to assist you in taking the first step towards your Data Analyst Career aspirations.

description:
Software Engineer (Agentic AI)

Salary: Up to £65,000

Location: Bristol

Technology: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Next.js, Agentic AI

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join a growing technology business developing innovative software solutions and embracing AI-driven development.

You'll join a collaborative engineering team, initially focusing on building and improving integrations with third-party platforms, applications and services, while also contributing to the development of the wider software platform.

This is a predominantly backend-focused position, although you'll have the opportunity to work across the full stack.

The business is particularly interested in engineers who are already incorporating AI and agentic workflows into their development process and are keen to explore how these technologies can improve software delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain full stack applications, backend services and APIs.

  • Build and improve integrations with third-party platforms, including Microsoft applications, e-commerce systems and authentication services.

  • Take ownership of features from initial design through to production, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable and maintainable.

  • Incorporate AI coding agents and agentic workflows into everyday development, including implementation, testing, refactoring and troubleshooting.

  • Work closely with other engineers, Product and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvements to engineering practices.

  • Support junior engineers through knowledge sharing, pairing and constructive feedback.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Commercial experience developing full stack applications or backend services using modern programming languages.

  • Strong understanding of backend development, API design and software engineering principles.

  • Experience with automated testing, code reviews and deploying applications into production.

  • Practical experience incorporating AI coding agents and agentic workflows into the software development lifecycle, with an understanding of their capabilities and limitations.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of technical tasks.

Desirable:

  • Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript or Next.js.

  • Experience developing integrations with external APIs, platforms or third-party services.

  • Exposure to Microsoft integrations, e-commerce platforms or authentication systems.

  • Knowledge of cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation.

Why Apply?

You'll be joining an engineering team that values curiosity, collaboration and technical innovation, with the opportunity to work on meaningful development challenges.

The business is actively investing in AI-assisted engineering practices and encourages developers to explore new approaches while maintaining high standards of software quality.

This opportunity would suit a capable Full Stack Engineer who enjoys hands-on development, wants to develop greater technical ownership and is interested in shaping how AI is used within modern software engineering.

title: QC Analyst
description:
Quality Control Analyst



Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Pattern: 5 Days Onsite

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for a Quality Control Analyst to join a leading pharmaceutical organisation. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced QC professional to join a regulated pharmaceutical environment, supporting the testing and release of materials while ensuring compliance with GMP, GDP and internal quality standards.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining laboratory quality systems, supporting audits and inspections, investigating deviations and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing of raw materials and other materials in accordance with approved specifications, procedures and agreed timelines.

  • Qualify laboratory equipment, including URS, IQ, OQ and PQ activities.

  • Maintain, calibrate and ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment.

  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems and Quality Management Systems in line with GMP and approved procedures.

  • Assist with the preparation and review of SOPs.

  • Support internal and external audits, audit schedules and regulatory inspections.

  • Raise and assist with investigations into deviations, including associated CAPAs.

  • Support technology transfer projects and QC-related activities.

  • Assist with change control implementation and management.

  • Collect and analyse data for Product Quality Reviews (PQRs) and Quality Assurance performance indicators.

  • Support the implementation and management of stability programmes.

  • Work collaboratively with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Packaging and Regulatory teams to support product release and distribution.

Requirements

  • Previous experience within a pharmaceutical Quality Control environment.

  • Strong understanding of GMP, GDP and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.

  • Knowledge of Quality Control, Quality Assurance and Quality Management Systems.

  • Experience with laboratory equipment maintenance, calibration and qualification.

  • Understanding of deviations, CAPAs, change controls and SOPs.

  • Experience supporting audits, inspections and stability programmes would be advantageous.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings effectively.

  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Excellent communication, organisational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.


Interested? If you have pharmaceutical QC experience and are looking for your next opportunity within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Machine Learning (ML) Engineer
description:
Sanderson are working with a growing SaaS organisation looking to appoint an ML Engineer to join its expanding AI team.

This is a hands-on machine learning engineering opportunity, working across the development and improvement of AI agents and language models. You'll work closely with the existing engineering team and researchers, taking ideas and research through to practical implementation and production.

This is a genuine machine learning role rather than simply integrating third-party AI models. The focus is on understanding how models work, applying machine learning techniques to improve their performance and finding ways to make AI agents more accurate, consistent and effective.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Designing, building and improving AI agents, language models and the systems that support them.

  • Translating research outputs and theoretical concepts into practical, production-ready solutions.

  • Applying machine learning techniques to improve model performance, accuracy and reliability.

  • Working across the different components of an AI agent's request cycle.

  • Designing and running experiments, using measurable criteria to evaluate improvements.

  • Exploring research papers and new techniques to identify opportunities to improve the technology.

What we're looking for

We're keen to speak with engineers who have a strong foundation in machine learning and the software engineering skills to turn ideas into working products.

You'll ideally bring:

  • A background in Data Science, Machine Learning or a related discipline, combined with strong software engineering ability.

  • Commercial experience building and delivering machine learning or AI systems.

  • Practical experience working with language models and improving their behaviour and performance.

  • A good understanding of machine learning fundamentals, model evaluation and meaningful performance metrics.

  • The ability to understand research papers and translate relevant concepts into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience with experimentation, automated testing, code reviews and version control.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, exploring new ideas and solving complex technical problems.

This is a great opportunity to join a growing SaaS organisation where machine learning is central to the product, working on genuine AI and model engineering challenges rather than simply integrating existing tools and services.

The role offers a salary of up to £100,000 (DOE) and requires four days per week onsite.

title: Trainee Field Service Engineer
description:
Trainee Field Service Engineer - Hotpoint

No Experience Needed | Fully Paid Training | Company Van Provided

Ready to start a hands-on career with one of the UK's most trusted appliance brands?

Hotpoint is looking for motivated individuals to join our 12-month Trainee Field Service Engineer Programme. Whether you're currently working in retail, customer service, warehousing, delivery driving, manufacturing, the armed forces, or another practical role, we'll provide all the training and support you need to build a successful engineering career.

If you enjoy problem-solving, fixing things, working independently, helping customers and learning new skills all within your local area, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

What's in it for You?

  • 12-month paid training programme
  • Equivalent of £27,377 per year for the first 6 months, increasing to £28,352 per year thereafter - Paid weekly via umbrella company
  • Uncapped commission opportunities
  • Overtime available
  • Company van and fuel card provided
  • Tools, equipment and uniform supplied
  • Industry-leading training and ongoing support
  • 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • 25 days holiday upon securing a permanent role
  • Opportunity to gain a permanent position within 12 months
  • Long-term career progression with a recognised household brand

The Role

As a Trainee Field Service Engineer no two days are the same, you'll visit customers in their homes to diagnose and repair domestic appliances while delivering outstanding customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Travel to customer appointments in a company van
  • Diagnose faults and complete repairs
  • Deliver excellent customer service
  • Manage tools, parts and van stock
  • Represent the Hotpoint brand professionally
  • Promote approved products and services, with opportunities to earn commission

You'll work on appliances such as:

  • Washing machines
  • Tumble dryers
  • Electric cookers
  • Other domestic appliances as your training develops

Your Training Journey

Weeks 1-3: Residential Training (Peterborough)

Attend our specialist training centre Monday to Friday, returning home at weekends. Travel and accommodation are arranged and paid for by Hotpoint.

Week 1: Induction

  • Meet your support network
  • Receive your tools, uniform and company van
  • Complete health & safety training
  • Undertake a driving assessment

Weeks 2-3: Technical Training

  • Appliance repairs
  • Fault diagnosis
  • Electrical and mechanical troubleshooting
  • Customer service skills
  • Practical hands-on learning

Weeks 4-6: Field Mentoring

Work alongside an experienced engineer, receiving one-to-one coaching and support while developing your skills.

Months 2-12: On-the-Job Development

Continue building your technical knowledge and confidence with ongoing support and real customer experience.

Additional Upskill Training

Further specialist training will be provided to expand your product knowledge and technical capability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Reliable, professional and customer-focused
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Willing to learn and develop new skills
  • Looking for a long-term career
  • Confident communicating with customers
  • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services
  • Motivated by earning additional commission opportunities

Essential Requirements

  • Full UK Manual Driving Licence held for at least 1 year
  • Physically able to move household appliances safely
  • Right to work in the UK

Desirable Experience

  • Engineering, mechanical, electrical or technical experience
  • Repair, maintenance or fault-finding experience
  • Trades, field-based or customer-facing roles
  • Delivery driving or logistics experience
  • Experience using tools or practical hands-on skills

Career Changers Welcome

Many of our successful engineers have come from backgrounds including retail, customer service, logistics, manufacturing, automotive, trades and maintenance.

No previous engineering experience is required. We're looking for people with the right attitude, willingness to learn and commitment to building a long-term career.

Why Choose Hotpoint?

  • Learn a skilled trade with a trusted household brand
  • Gain valuable technical experience
  • Enjoy independence and variety every day
  • Join a supportive team invested in your success
  • Access long-term career progression opportunities

Apply today and start your journey towards becoming a qualified Field Service Engineer with Hotpoint.

APPLY NOW

title: Community Data Administrator
description:
About us

We are a leading integrated media and marketing services company at the heart of a community of over 590,000 UK healthcare professionals. With more than 30 years of experience, we produce industry-leading content and experiences through our award-winning brands, publications, and events. We produce trusted, data-driven content that informs and inspires healthcare professionals across the UK and Europe. We are a Great Place to Work and UK's Best Workplaces for Women certified employer, offering a range of benefits including 28 days annual leave (rising to 30 days after 2 years) excluding bank holidays, private healthcare insurance, flexible working and more.

The Role

Our Community Data Administrator will be responsible for the quality, coverage, depth and development of the organisation's HCP community. The role will ensure we have a high-quality, accurate, comprehensive, current, relevant and growing audience that meets the needs of the business and our clients.

They will develop a detailed understanding of the organisation's HCP data and the wider addressable HCP market, identifying where we have strong coverage, where gaps exist and what actions we can take to address them. They will use first- and third-party data, market intelligence and behavioural and engagement data to understand the composition and health of our community and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

This is a highly analytical role for someone who loves working with data, numbers and solving problems. They will interrogate datasets, spot patterns and anomalies, assess data quality and freshness, identify gaps and translate findings into clear actions.

Working closely with teams across the organisation, they will help source and evaluate new data, improve HCP profiling and segmentation, strengthen our understanding of audience engagement and ensure our HCP community becomes increasingly accurate, complete, current and commercially valuable.

Location: Central London (Hybrid)

Reporting to: Digital Director

Expected start date: January 2027

Salary: £30,000 to £38,000 per annum, depending on experience

Key Responsibilities:

Data Quality & Governance

Take ownership of the overall health of the organisation's HCP database, including accuracy, completeness, recency, duplication, consistency, consent and compliance. Establish clear definitions and standards for data quality and regularly measure the database against them, including agreed definitions for active HCPs, inactive HCPs, dormant records, complete profiles and verified HCPs. Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to implement solutions and continually improve the reliability of our data.

HCP Coverage & Gap Analysis

Build a detailed understanding of the organisation's coverage of the HCP market and identify gaps by profession, specialty, geography, seniority and other relevant characteristics. Develop clear, data-led plans to address priority audience gaps and measure the impact of actions taken.

Data Enrichment

Identify opportunities to enhance existing HCP records with additional data points and attributes, improving the completeness and depth of our profiles. Determine which additional attributes would provide the greatest audience, editorial and commercial value and identify appropriate sources for obtaining them.

Data Freshness & Engagement

Assess how recently and frequently HCPs interact with the organisation across our brands, websites, newsletters, events, CPD platforms, surveys and other products. Develop and maintain an HCP engagement scoring methodology that combines behavioural signals across the business to provide a consistent view of audience engagement. Use engagement and recency data to understand the active audience within our overall community and identify opportunities to increase engagement.

Audience Re-engagement & Cleansing

Identify inactive, ageing, duplicate, incomplete or low-confidence records. Work with relevant teams to determine appropriate approaches for re-engagement, verification, consolidation, suppression or removal. Monitor the effectiveness of re-engagement and cleansing activity and use the findings to continually improve our approach.

Data Matching & Deduplication

Develop approaches for identifying duplicate HCP records and matching individuals across different the organisation datasets, platforms and data sources. Investigate conflicting information and establish appropriate rules for determining the most reliable and current information. Support the development of an increasingly consistent and accurate single view of each HCP across the organisation.

Segmentation & Audience Insight

Develop meaningful HCP segments based on profession, specialty, geography, seniority, demographics, behaviour, engagement, recency and other relevant characteristics. Analyse these segments to identify patterns, opportunities and changes in audience behaviour. Translate complex data into clear insights that can be understood and acted upon by teams across the business.

Data Acquisition & Gap Closure

Research and evaluate new first- and third-party data sources that could strengthen the organisation's HCP community. Assess potential sources based on quality, coverage, accuracy, recency, compliance, cost and likely incremental value. Develop data-led recommendations for acquiring or generating data to address identified audience gaps and measure whether those interventions successfully improve coverage.

Commercial Audience Analysis

Work closely with Sales and other commercial teams to understand current and emerging client audience requirements. Translate these requirements into data needs and assess the organisation's ability to reach relevant HCP audie

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Nottingham

£45,343 - £51,937 per annum


Help us build the data foundations for NCHA’s future


We’re investing in how we use data across NCHA and are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to take a key role in developing our data warehouse, pipelines and wider data platform.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys building reliable, scalable data solutions that people trust and use, while also having the opportunity to shape how our data engineering capability develops.


You’ll act as NCHA’s technical lead, working to connect data from our core systems, creating well-engineered, production-ready datasets that support Power BI, analytics and better decision-making across NCHA.


You won’t simply maintain an established platform. You’ll help shape our architecture, establish engineering standards and influence how our data platform evolves as we deliver our Data & Insight Strategy. As a regulated organisation, data quality, security, governance and reliability are central to everything we do.


What you’ll be doing


Working closely with our Information and Intelligence team, Technology colleagues, business teams and suppliers, you’ll:


  • Lead the technical development and ongoing improvement of our data warehouse and data platform.
  • Design, build and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple source systems.
  • Use technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Microsoft Fabric to develop scalable data solutions.
  • Develop well-modelled, reusable datasets that provide a trusted foundation for Power BI, reporting and analytics.
  • Build data quality, validation and reconciliation into our engineering processes.
  • Establish good engineering practices, including Git, CI/CD, code review and separation of development, test and production environments.
  • Ensure pipelines are designed with performance, reliability, security and cost efficiency in mind.
  • Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and technical standards.
  • Work with system owners and suppliers to ensure new systems integrate effectively with our wider data architecture.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching and knowledge sharing across the Data & Insight team.


What we’re looking for


You’ll be an experienced data engineer with strong technical foundations, a practical mindset and the confidence to take technical ownership.


You will have experience in:


  • Building and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling.
  • Modern cloud data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Data warehousing and integrating data from multiple systems.
  • Data quality, reconciliation, monitoring and automation.
  • Git, source control and CI/CD approaches.
  • Working with Power BI and analytical data models.
  • Developing secure, reliable and scalable data solutions.
  • Explaining technical concepts clearly and working collaboratively with technical and non-technical colleagues.


Why Join NCHA?


This is an opportunity to do more than build pipelines.


You’ll help shape the technical foundations for how NCHA uses data, connecting information across our organisation and helping us move towards a trusted, scalable and increasingly automated data environment.


Your work will enable colleagues to spend less time extracting, preparing and checking data and more time using insight to understand our customers and homes, improve services, manage risk and make better decisions.


Come and shape what’s next


If you’re looking for a role where you can bring your technical expertise, influence our direction and see the impact of what you build, this could be the opportunity for you.


What we can offer you


  • Flexible working: We operate hybrid working, with colleagues expected to work in the office three days per week and remotely for the remainder of the week.
  • Generous annual leave: You'll receive 36.5 days annual leave (including bank holidays), increasing to 38.5 days after five years' service.
  • Excellent pension scheme: We offer a generous pension scheme with employer contributions of up to 10%.
  • Learning and development: We invest in our people, offering a wide variety of internal training courses each year, alongside access to professional qualifications, specialist training and conferences.
  • Family-friendly and flexible benefits: We provide enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption benefits, as well as policies that help colleagues balance work with caring and family responsibilities
  • Health and wellbeing support: Our wellbeing package includes cashback on dental and optical treatments, access to specialist consultations and therapies, and a 24-hour counselling service.

Apply Now

description:

Compass Digital & Technology is where ideas turn into possibilities.

title: Model Governance Manager (AI)
description:
We are seeking a technically accomplished Model Governance Manager to take ownership of the operational delivery and continuous improvement of AI and Machine Learning governance processes within a global information and analytics organisation.

This position sits at the intersection of Data Science, Model Risk Management and Responsible AI, ensuring that AI/ML models are developed, reviewed, approved and monitored within a robust, scalable governance framework.

The successful candidate will combine a hands-on background in Data Science or Machine Learning with practical knowledge of AI governance, model validation and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to influence how AI governance is implemented across a large organisation, supporting responsible innovation while enabling technical teams to develop and deploy AI solutions effectively.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Model Governance

  • Own and manage day-to-day AI and Machine Learning model approval and review processes.

  • Maintain centralised inventories of AI/ML models and third-party AI software across development and production environments.

  • Act as the primary contact for data scientists, model owners and AI software requesters navigating governance requirements.

  • Ensure appropriate model documentation, validation, risk assessments and approvals are completed throughout the model lifecycle.

  • Monitor governance activities and escalate risks, issues and compliance gaps where appropriate.

Governance Framework & Risk Management

  • Support the development and implementation of AI governance policies, standards and model risk assessment methodologies.

  • Ensure governance processes align with relevant regulations and recognised standards, including the EU AI Act and applicable AI risk management frameworks.

  • Support internal audit, regulatory compliance and risk management activities.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation and governance records.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to promote responsible AI practices.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline model approval workflows and improve governance efficiency.

  • Develop and enhance governance tools supporting model inventories, approvals, monitoring and reporting.

  • Introduce automation and self-service capabilities where appropriate.

  • Track and report on model portfolio health, governance effectiveness and approval turnaround times.

  • Contribute to the longer-term development of a scalable AI governance operating model.

Essential Requirements

  • Hands-on Data Science or Machine Learning background, including practical experience developing, training, validating or deploying ML models.

  • Experience in AI governance, model risk management, model validation or a closely related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of the ML lifecycle, including model development, testing, validation, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience implementing, managing or improving structured operational processes.

  • Understanding of AI risks, model controls, regulatory requirements and Responsible AI principles.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage approval workflows, maintain accurate records and coordinate multiple stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication skills, particularly when translating technical concepts into practical governance requirements.

  • Ability to independently manage operational responsibilities while supporting strategic framework improvements.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience managing AI/model inventories and formal model approval processes.

  • Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring or model lifecycle management platforms.

  • Practical experience using Python, SQL or other relevant Data Science technologies.

  • Knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001.

  • Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models and associated governance challenges.

  • Exposure to governance workflow automation, reporting dashboards or self-service approval tools.

  • Experience developing AI governance policies, model risk frameworks or validation standards.

  • Background in regulated industries, financial services, technology, healthcare or scientific research.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have started their career in a hands-on Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering or Quantitative Modelling position before developing expertise in AI governance, model validation or model risk management.

They will understand both how AI models are built and deployed and how to establish effective controls around their use.

Suitable backgrounds could include:

  • AI / Model Governance Manager

  • Model Risk Manager

  • AI / ML Model Validation Manager

  • Responsible AI Manager with a technical background

  • Data Scientist transitioning into AI governance

  • ML Engineer with model governance or risk management experience

Importantly, this role requires someone comfortable taking ownership of operational governance processes rather than focusing exclusively on strategy, policy development or advisory work.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to support the responsible adoption of AI within a globally recognised information and analytics business, working alongside Data Science professionals and governance stakeholders.

The role provides exposure to evolving AI technologies, regulatory frameworks and opportunities to improve governance through automation and scalable processes.

The organisation offers a collaborative working environment, professional development opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.

Robert Walters Operations Limited is an employment business and employment agency and welcomes applications from all candidates

title: Lead Software Engineer, Platform and Delivery
description:

title: Principal Architect – AI
description:
About the Role

Becrypt is creating a new, standalone Principal Architect – AI role to lead the organisation’s approach to artificial intelligence across the business. This is a senior technical position for someone who can look across engineering, product, IT and operations to identify where AI can genuinely improve how Becrypt builds, secures and runs its platforms — and who can then design, build and govern the systems that make that possible.

This is not a team-management role. It is a hands-on, principal-level individual contributor position for someone who leads through technical depth, credibility and influence — working closely with engineering teams, technical architects and internal IT, and setting the policies, risk frameworks and compliance guardrails needed to adopt AI responsibly.

What You’ll Do

Strategic & cross-business

  • Assess processes and systems across the business — engineering, product, customer-facing operations, internal IT — to identify where AI can add genuine value, streamline work, or reduce risk.
  • Act as the go-to technical authority on AI across Becrypt, working directly with engineering teams, technical architects and internal IT rather than through a reporting chain.
  • Develop and own AI-related policy, governance, risk assessment and compliance frameworks, balancing confidentiality, integrity, availability, usability, customer requirements, engineering effort and operational risk.
  • Advise leadership on AI strategy, opportunity areas and risk posture in plain, actionable terms.

Platform & engineering delivery

  • Design and build platforms for long-running agentic workflow systems, including AI gateways and supporting infrastructure services.
  • Design Docker-based services using Linux container environments, Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, MCP/FastMCP, OpenAI and AWS Bedrock.Apply secure boundaries around credentials, service access, tool invocation and human-in-the-loop operation for AI/agentic systems.
  • Build reusable services and integrations, and assess the security, isolation, maintainability and operational implications of emerging AI technologies before they’re adopted.
  • Actively probe AI systems, integrations and agentic workflows for vulnerabilities — thinking like an attacker to uncover weaknesses in credential handling, tool invocation and data exposure before they’re exploited, and feeding findings back into design and policy.
  • Get hands-on with difficult technical problems alongside engineers — investigating, diagnosing and making architectural calls that improve security, assurance, maintainability and long term product direction.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in designing, building, securing and operating complex software platforms, Linux-based systems, distributed services, APIs and integrations.
  • Strong, current hands-on experience with Docker/containerised environments, Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, and AI-specific tooling such as MCP/FastMCP, OpenAI APIs and AWS Bedrock.
  • Practical experience building or integrating AI gateways, agentic workflow systems, or similar AI infrastructure — not just using AI tools, but architecting the systems around them.
  • A track record of enterprise or platform architecture at principal/CTO-advisory level, ideally spanning regulated, security-conscious, or infrastructure-heavy environments (e.g. payments, cloud platforms, integration platforms).
  • Demonstrated ability to design policy-based authorisation, credential/access boundaries, and secure-by-design controls for systems handling sensitive operations.
  • Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — influencing engineering, product, security, customer-facing and leadership stakeholders without relying on formal team management.
  • A working mental model that balances security (CIA), usability, customer needs, engineering effort, operational risk and product strategy when making architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable writing and championing policy, risk and compliance documentation, not just technical designs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a security-focused or highly regulated product company (Becrypt’s own domain).
  • Prior experience introducing AI/agentic capability into an existing engineering organisation from scratch.
  • Familiarity with data-centre/on-prem as well as cloud (AWS) deployment models.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • A clear, prioritised view of where AI can and should be applied across Becrypt, backed by policy and risk frameworks that leadership and engineering trust.
  • A working AI gateway / agentic platform in production use, built to Becrypt’s security and operational standards.
  • Engineering teams and internal IT with a clear, well-governed path to adopt AI capability safely and consistently.

Package & Discretionary Benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave plus an additional 2 days after 2 years’ service
  • 5 days additional holiday purchase available
  • Private medical insurance
  • Heath cashback plan with Healthshield
  • Pension scheme
  • Life cover 4 x salary
  • Season ticket loan
  • Salary exchange benefits (ride2work, pension)
  • Subsidised gym membership
  • Employee referral scheme

Role will be subject to an employment screening process and will require security clearance

We're looking for an experienced Data Governance Manager to help embed and drive data governance across Compass Group UK & Ireland - a global leader in food services. Compass Digital & Technology is where ideas turn into possibilities.  

We’re the technology team behind Compass Group UK&I, part of Compass Group, one of the world’s largest hospitality businesses. We’re shaping the next generation of products, platforms and experiences for Compass Group, harnessing AI to create competitive advantage and accelerate growth.

  • Develop and maintain business glossaries, agreed definitions and governance records to support consistency across the organisation.

  • Partner with Data Quality, Product and Business teams to address governance challenges, clarify ownership and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Monitor governance adoption, identify barriers to compliance and ensure agreed decisions are translated into practical actions.

  • Experience establishing and implementing data governance frameworks, stewardship models and business glossaries across multiple functions.

  • Passion for improving data quality, governance maturity and business confidence in data.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

title: Accounts Payable Analyst
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst

6 month FTC

Based in Hammersmith


Nomad Foods is Europe’s leading frozen food company and one of the largest in the world ??and is home to a portfolio of iconic brands; including Birds Eye, Findus, iglo, Aunt Bessie’s and Goodfella’s. With revenues of €2.6bn and approx. 8000 employees across 22 markets and 19 factories, our aim and propose is to serve the world with better food.

With the opening of our new Shared Finance Centre - housing both our Financial Accounting teams and our Financial Planning and Analysis Centre of Expertise - this provides an outstanding place to work for finance professionals, with new and exciting opportunities to join a growing company and develop your career.


About the role


The Accounts Payable Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring that Nomad Foods maintains strong supplier relationships, accurate invoice processing, and robust financial controls. In addition to processing invoices and credit notes using Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), the Analyst is responsible for managing key supplier accounts, performing regular supplier statement reconciliations, preparing and executing weekly payment runs, undertaking month-end activities, and delivering key SOX controls.


As a system super user, the AP Analyst will act as a point of expertise for VIM and AP processes, helping resolve complex issues and supporting continuous improvement across the Procure to Pay cycle.


Invoice & Credit Note Processing

  • Process supplier invoices and credit notes accurately through VIM according to service levels
  • Investigate and resolve VIM exceptions, identifying missing or incorrect data and taking corrective actions
  • Identify recurring issues and contribute to root cause analysis and process improvements

Supplier Relationship Ownership

  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned key suppliers
  • Build and maintain strong, professional supplier relationships to ensure smooth operations and timely resolutions

Payments & Cash Management

  • Prepare, review, and execute weekly AP payment runs
  • Ensure compliance with payment authorisation matrix, controls, and treasury guidelines

Month-End Close Activities

  • Perform month-end AP activities including: AP accruals
  • GR/IR review
  • Reconciliation of key AP accounts

SOX Controls & Compliance

  • Execute and document SOX controls accurately, ensuring full audit readiness
  • Support internal and external audits with required evidence, explanations, and process walkthroughs

Complex Issue Resolution

  • Use strong AP knowledge and VIM expertise to navigate and resolve complex invoice, PO, or master data issues
  • Partner with Procurement, Receiving, Supply Chain, and IT to troubleshoot and resolve systemic or process-related problems
  • Act as an escalation point for AP Analysts and business stakeholders

System Super User Responsibilities

  • Serve as a VIM super user and AP process expert within the team
  • Support system testing, upgrades, user training, and defect resolution
  • Maintain and improve AP process documentation, SOPs, and training materials
  • Share best practices and mentor junior team members


About you

  • Strong experience in Accounts Payable, with demonstrated capability in handling complex AP issues
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) is required
  • Strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)
  • Good working knowledge of AP accounting, invoice flow, and P2P processes
  • Experience performing payment runs, reconciliations, and month-end tasks
  • Knowledge of SOX controls and compliance requirements (preferred)
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder management abilities


What we offer you


  • The potential of a varied career across different areas of finance or cross-functionally
  • A culture where your ideas make a difference
  • Hybrid working


At Nomad Foods we are proud to represent the world we serve by hiring diverse talent. Our inclusive culture is all about what we can achieve together, and valuing difference as our greatest strength. #justbeyou.

title: Monitoring and Data Analyst (Solar)
description:
Monitoring and Data Analyst (Solar)

Birmingham

£30,000 - £35,000 + Pension + Medical Cash Plan + Wellbeing Benefits + 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays

Are you an analytical and detail-oriented professional with advanced Excel skills looking to build a career within the rapidly growing renewable energy sector?

Do you want to play a key role in monitoring and optimising the performance of one of the UK's largest portfolios of solar assets, working closely with technical and operational teams to identify issues and drive asset performance?

This established renewable energy business operates over 450MW of ground-mounted photovoltaic assets across the UK and is part of a wider European organisation managing more than 1.6GW of renewable energy assets across five countries. With continued growth and a strong focus on maximising plant efficiency, they are looking to appoint a motivated Monitoring and Data Analyst to join their growing Operations team in Birmingham.

In this role, you'll be responsible for the remote monitoring and analysis of solar farm performance across multiple platforms. You'll manage and triage system alarms, track key performance indicators, analyse operational data and coordinate with Project Managers and field teams to support fault diagnosis and corrective actions.

You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to the development of data-driven reporting solutions, support solar farm communication networks and maintain asset information within the company's CMMS. This is a varied position that combines data analysis, operational monitoring and technical problem-solving within an exciting renewable energy environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, advanced Excel experience and the ability to work confidently with large datasets. Experience within the photovoltaic or renewable energy sector would be advantageous, although candidates with strong transferable analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation at the forefront of renewable energy operations, where you'll gain valuable exposure to large-scale solar assets while working within a supportive and collaborative team.

The Role
  • Remotely monitor and analyse the performance of solar farms using multiple monitoring platforms.
  • Manage and triage system alarms, ensuring faults are identified and escalated promptly.
  • Calculate, track and report key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Work closely with Project Managers and field teams to support fault diagnosis and corrective actions.
  • Collect, validate, analyse and report operational and performance data.
The Person
  • Advanced Excel skills with experience analysing large datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a wider team.

title: Senior Research Engineer - Scientific AI
description:
Senior Research Engineer - Scientific AI


Newton Colmore is proud to be supporting a highly ambitious technology company that is developing an entirely new imaging capability. Their technology has the potential to reveal the internal structure of complex objects that conventional inspection methods struggle to see, creating applications across aerospace, energy, advanced manufacturing and national infrastructure.


We are assisting them in their search for an expert engineer to help build the machine learning and reconstruction systems at the heart of the platform. The challenge sits at the intersection of physics, simulation, AI and real-world engineering, and the role can be tailored, from senior engineer through to department head.


In terms of the challenge, every day you will work on problems that have no established answer.


You will develop AI systems capable of transforming complex data into accurate three-dimensional reconstructions, combining modern machine learning with first-principles physics.


You will have the freedom to own major technical decisions, influence architecture from day one and work closely with a small team solving incredibly complex problems.


Regarding the day-to-day, it should be a role where no one day would be the same, but here are some general responsibilities of the role;

  • Developing advanced machine learning models to reconstruct spatial information from large-scale sensor datasets.
  • Building graph neural networks and point-cloud based architectures for signal interpretation and track reconstruction
  • Creating physics-informed AI systems that combine learned models with mechanistic understanding.
  • Developing differentiable simulation frameworks that support both training and inference.
  • Designing uncertainty-aware reconstruction methods with robust confidence estimation.
  • Building end-to-end pipelines spanning simulation, training, validation and deployment.
  • Working with GPU and HPC infrastructure to solve computationally demanding challenges.


We are looking for expert engineers, and with the nature of this type of role, a lot of the time, it's difficult to pinpoint the exact profile needed. In short, that means the role can be tailored to the right person, but in terms of fundamentals, here are some of the attributes we are looking for;

  • Machine learning domain knowledge for scientific, industrial or engineering applications.
  • Computational imaging, inverse problems or reconstruction algorithms, ideally.
  • Graph Neural Networks, geometric deep learning or point-cloud processing.
  • Physics-informed machine learning experience.


Experience with complex sensor systems, simulation environments, high-performance computing or scientific instrumentation would be particularly valuable, but curiosity and problem-solving ability matter just as much.


It's an exciting company, developing a novel technology, and in terms of the package that is built around that, they offer the change to work autonomously, leaning on the leadership team whenever you need, with tailored salaries, equity, access to world-class compute infrastructure, and much more.


For obvious reasons, further details regarding the company, technology and applications will be discussed on a confidential basis with suitable candidates. Please do get in touch, or make an application, and a member of our team will be in touch.

Career Changers Welcome

No previous engineering experience is required. We're looking for people with the right attitude, willingness to learn and commitment to building a long-term career.

Why Choose Hotpoint?

  • Gain valuable technical experience
  • Enjoy independence and variety every day
  • Join a supportive team invested in your success
  • Access long-term career progression opportunities

Apply today and start your journey towards becoming a qualified Field Service Engineer with Hotpoint.

title: Mobile Telecom Network Engineer
description:
Mobile Network Engineer (Mobile RAN Performance)

Hybrid | UK | Contract Opportunity

Duration: 6 months+

Rate: £500 per day (inside IR35)

Location: London or Bristol (Hybrid)


Are you an experienced Mobile Network Performance Engineer with a passion for optimising critical telecommunications infrastructure? We're working with a leading UK telecommunications organisation that is investing heavily in the performance and evolution of its mobile network estate and is seeking a specialist to support the delivery of high-profile network performance and optimisation initiatives.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on business-critical mobile network services, helping to maintain and enhance network performance, reliability, and customer experience across large-scale 4G and emerging 5G environments.


The Role

As a Network Engineering Specialist, you will be responsible for analysing network performance, identifying root causes of service degradation, and driving improvements across radio access network (RAN) environments. You'll work closely with internal stakeholders, project teams, equipment vendors, and third-party suppliers to deliver performance enhancements and support future network strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed performance investigations using UE logs, protocol traces, Wireshark analysis, and drive test data.
  • Perform root cause analysis on network issues and identify corrective actions to improve KPIs and customer experience.
  • Analyse LTE signalling, SIP traffic, and application-level performance across the network stack.
  • Review performance trends and support optimisation activities within large-scale mobile RAN environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and supplier teams to implement network improvements and resolve technical issues.
  • Support the definition of future network performance strategies and best practice guidelines.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Extensive experience within mobile telecommunications network performance and optimisation.
  • Strong expertise in UE log analysis and troubleshooting tools such as Accuver, Nemo, TEMS, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of LTE networks, radio performance analysis, and optimisation techniques.
  • Experience analysing drive test logs, protocol traces, and Wireshark captures.
  • Strong knowledge of LTE signalling, SIP, and network troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Understanding of Nokia RAN environments.
  • Familiarity with KPI measurement, analysis, and optimisation.
  • Experience working with performance management, OSS, and network monitoring data.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of public safety or mission-critical communications environments.
  • Experience with Ericsson RAN technologies.
  • Understanding of 3GPP and ETSI standards.
  • Knowledge of SRTP, DTLS, Push-to-Talk (PTT), and related mobile communications technologies.
  • Exposure to 5G network technologies and future network evolution programmes.


If you're a Mobile Network Performance SME with strong LTE optimisation and troubleshooting experience and are looking for your next contract opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Junior Maintenance Engineer
description:
Junior Maintenance Engineer – Wolverhampton

Permanent | Site-Based | Maintenance | 40 Hours Per Week

Develop your engineering skills. Improve equipment reliability. Help keep production moving safely.

We are looking for a Junior Maintenance Engineer to join our Perrin & Rowe brand and support the safe operation, routine care and repair of production equipment and site services at Wolverhampton. Working alongside experienced engineers and a named mentor, you will develop your mechanical, electrical and fault-finding capability through structured training and supervised experience.

This role sits within our Maintenance team and plays an important part in improving equipment reliability while developing the next generation of engineering capability.

title: Research Analyst/Writer
description:
Overview Join our Insight team at Chambers and Partners as a Research Analyst/Writer. This is a hybrid position, working 2 days per week in either our London or Birmingham office.

As a Research Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming commentary compiled by our research teams into valuable insights for law firms. The success of our Insight team is integral to the overall success of our business, and we are continuously looking for qualified individuals to contribute to this success. Main Duties and Responsibilities

This role involves parsing the quantitative and qualitative data compiled by research teams for all of our published guides and turning it into useful information for law firms. Law firms find these reports invaluable, both as a source of information on how to improve their submission for recognition within our tables, as well as tools to help shape their strategy in the global legal landscape.

Research Analysts on Chambers’ Insight team are assigned a law firm’s report to write and must use the data provided by research to draw sensible conclusions about what the reasons for the firm and its lawyers’ rankings were.

They write 200/400 words of compelling copy in every chapter of their report, with the aim of answering all of a firm’s potential questions about the rankings. Part of their training involves learning how to write the most sophisticated CMI reports, which include an analysis of the entire market, including a comparison to competitor firms. They take ownership of each report assigned to them and regularly discuss their work with their manager.

As a Research Analyst, your main duties include:

  • Using the research database to find relevant raw data
  • Tidying interview comments for sense and clarity
  • Rendering comments anonymous by removing any information that could reveal the identity of the speaker
  • Coming to appropriate conclusions regarding how the final ranking decisions were arrived at, incorporating research notes left by the research team
  • Writing compelling copy that is clear, concise and easily understood by a layperson
  • Summarising findings in a short executive summary
  • Maintaining a high standard of accuracy in reports by ensuring that factual information is correct and up to date
Why you should apply
  • Make a genuine impact: your analysis helps law firms understand their rankings, benchmark against competitors and make informed strategic decisions.
  • Build a unique blend of research and writing expertise: transform complex qualitative and quantitative data into clear, compelling insights for a global audience.
  • Be part of a growing product at the heart of Chambers' long-term strategic plans.
Skills, Experience & Personal Attributes
  • Excellent writing skills, particularly the ability to write clearly and concisely
  • Ability to draw broad conclusions after examining raw data and research notes
  • Reliable time management and the ability to meet tight deadlines while maintaining quality.
  • The ability to closely follow house style
  • Intellectually curious
  • High attention to detail
Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to fostering and promoting an inclusive professional environment for all of our employees, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusion are integral values of Chambers and Partners and are key in our culture. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, race, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. This commitment applies across all of our employment policies and practices, from recruiting and hiring to training and career development. We support our employees through our internal INSPIRE committee with Executive Sponsors, Chairs and Ambassadors throughout the business promoting knowledge and effecting change.

Applicants who identify as Disabled and/or Neurodiverse will be entitled to an interview if they meet the minimum criteria as specified in the Job Description, additionally we will offer reasonable adjustments to those who require them. Some examples of reasonable adjustments are extra time in assessments, video interviews to combat travel-based issues and advice on expected interview topics/questions.
 

About Us Chambers is the leading legal data and intelligence partner for lawyers, firms, and in-house teams.

We conduct over 350,000 research interviews and surveys with in-house counsel every year, and receive 62,000 submissions from 9,000 firms worldwide, giving us unrivalled insight into the legal sector.

This research powers Chambers Rankings - the definitive guide to the best legal talent - and our Intelligence, which delivers the insights helping firms and in-house teams to succeed.

Our independent, rigorous research identifies the exceptional and charts the path to success, enabling legal professionals to see with clarity, decide with confidence, and plan with ambition. Advert Closing Date 23 Nov 2026 Advert Salary £30,000
