title: Finance AI Lead
description:
The Organisation

Nigel Wright Group is delighted to be working with a leading organisation to recruit a Finance AI Transformation Lead, an exciting opportunity for an experienced finance professional to play a major role in shaping how AI, automation and technology are used across the Finance function.

This is much more than a traditional AI or technology position. We’re looking for someone who understands how a complex Finance function actually operates and can identify where processes can be redesigned, automated and improved through the practical application of AI and modern technology.

It’s an opportunity to combine deep Finance knowledge with transformation, systems thinking and emerging technology to help create a more efficient, insightful and future-focused Finance function.



The Opportunity

The Finance AI Transformation Lead will work across the Finance function to identify where AI, automation and technology can make a meaningful difference to processes, controls and ways of working.

Rather than simply introducing new technology, you’ll take the time to understand how existing Finance processes operate, where inefficiencies or manual interventions exist, and how those processes can be redesigned before determining where AI and automation can add genuine value.

You’ll work across areas including FP&A, accounting and reporting, treasury, controls and broader Finance operations, helping to take opportunities from initial idea and process design through to implementation and adoption.

It’s a role that requires somebody who can comfortably bridge the gap between Finance, Technology and Transformation, combining strong financial knowledge with the ability to challenge existing ways of working and translate emerging technology into practical improvements.


What youll be doing

You’ll have a broad remit across Finance transformation, process improvement, AI and automation, including:

  • Working with Finance teams to understand and map existing processes, systems, controls and pain points.
  • Identifying and prioritising opportunities to use AI, automation and technology across Finance.
  • Redesigning Finance processes rather than simply automating existing ways of working.
  • Improving processes across areas such as FP&A, budgeting and forecasting, accounting and reporting, month-end, treasury, reconciliations and Finance operations.
  • Developing clear business cases for transformation initiatives, including expected efficiency, productivity and financial benefits.
  • Taking AI and automation opportunities from initial concept through to practical implementation.
  • Ensuring appropriate financial controls, reconciliations, governance and human oversight remain embedded within redesigned processes.
  • Working with Finance, Technology and other stakeholders to ensure new solutions integrate effectively with existing systems and data.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve management information, reporting and decision-making through better use of Finance data.
  • Supporting the adoption of new tools and ways of working across Finance teams.
  • Helping colleagues understand how AI can be used safely and effectively within their day-to-day roles.
  • Measuring the impact of transformation initiatives and ensuring they deliver tangible improvements to Finance operations.

About You

We’re looking for somebody who combines genuine Finance experience with transformation, systems and AI capability.

You may have progressed through roles such as Finance Director, Financial Controller, Head of FP&A, Finance Operations Lead or Finance Transformation Lead before becoming increasingly involved in digital transformation, automation and AI.

Alternatively, you may already work within Finance Transformation but have previously spent a significant part of your career working directly within an operational Finance function.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Significant experience working within a substantial or complex Finance function.
  • Strong understanding of core Finance processes, ideally spanning areas such as FP&A, accounting and reporting, treasury, financial controls and Finance operations.
  • Experience improving, redesigning or transforming Finance processes.
  • Practical experience applying AI, automation or digital technology within Finance.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations, governance and audit requirements.
  • Experience working with enterprise Finance systems, data and reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power BI, GenAI, RPA or other AI and automation tools would be advantageous.
  • The ability to understand a Finance problem first and determine the right technology solution second.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the credibility to work effectively with senior Finance and Technology leaders.
  • A commercial mindset with the ability to identify and demonstrate measurable value from transformation initiatives.

We are particularly interested in people who started their careers in Finance and have subsequently developed strong transformation, systems, automation or AI experience.

This isn’t a role for a pure technologist who happens to have delivered solutions into Finance. The Finance knowledge is fundamental. You’ll need to understand the underlying processes, controls and requirements well enough to challenge them and determine how they should operate differently.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
• Senior AI
  • Python
  • LangChain
Senior AI Engineer
Contract - 500pd
Permanent - 80,000 - 100,000
Remote first - LDN Office Optional
About the role
We're building an AI workflow product that lets teams turn repetitive, multi-step work into reliable automated workflows powered by large language models, agents and integrations with the tools they already use.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the product technically — owning architecture, setting engineering standards and shipping the core of the platform end to end. You'll be the most senior engineer on the product, working directly with founders/leadership, design and customers to decide what we build and how we build it.
This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll write a lot of code, but you'll also shape the roadmap, make the key technical calls and help grow the team around you.
What you'll do
  • Lead the product technically — own the architecture, technical roadmap and delivery of the AI workflow platform from prototype to production at scale.
  • Build LLM-powered workflows and agents — design orchestration for multi-step workflows, tool/function calling, retrieval (RAG), memory and human-in-the-loop approval steps.
  • Make AI reliable in production — build evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, fallbacks and cost/latency controls so workflows behave predictably for customers.
  • Ship full-stack features — from backend services and APIs to the workflow builder UI, working closely with design to make complex automation feel simple.
  • Integrate with the outside world — connectors to SaaS tools, webhooks, queues and third-party APIs, with sensible auth, rate-limiting and error handling.
  • Set the engineering bar — code review, testing, CI/CD, security and documentation practices that let a small team move fast without breaking things.
  • Work with customers and stakeholders — translate real user problems into technical solutions and help prioritise what matters.
  • Mentor and hire — support and level up other engineers, and help shape how the team grows.
What we're looking for
Essential
  • Strong commercial software engineering experience (typically 6+ years), with a track record of leading the technical delivery of a product or major platform area.
  • Hands-on experience building production features on top of LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models) — prompting, tool calling, RAG, structured outputs and evaluation.
  • Excellent backend skills in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, designing clean APIs and distributed services.
  • Experience with workflow, event-driven or queue-based systems (e.g. Temporal, Celery, SQS/Kafka, Step Functions or similar).
  • Solid cloud and DevOps fundamentals — AWS, GCP or Azure, Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure as code.
  • Good data skills — PostgreSQL, plus vector stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar).
  • A product mindset: you care about the user, make pragmatic trade-offs and can explain technical decisions to non-technical people.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
Nice to have
  • Experience with agent frameworks and tooling (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP, or custom orchestration).
  • LLM evaluation and observability tools (e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry).
  • Front-end experience with React/Next.js, ideally on visual builders or canvas-style UIs.
  • Background in SaaS integrations, iPaaS or automation products (Zapier, n8n, Make-style tools).
  • Knowledge of security, data privacy and compliance for AI systems (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer, tech lead or in a scale-up.

title: AI Builder
description:
AI Builder


  • Salary from £40k to £75k + benefits
  • Role based onsite 4-5 days per week at either central Manchester, central Cheltenham or London Westminster offices (your choice).


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).


This company is a Workflow & AI Orchestration Specialist. They deliver workflow and orchestration solutions that modernise casework, data, and citizen services. They connect fragmented systems to create coherent experiences with AI agents deployed safely at scale. They operate across two pillars: 1) advise and implement to provide end-to-end technology solutions that integrate cutting edge orchestration and 2) agentic AI capabilities. They’re growing fast and looking for bright, dynamic people to help build their business.


Role Overview


They're looking for an AI Builder to join their growing team: someone who builds AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems. They’re looking for someone who can help solve both these questions. First and foremost, they’re looking for someone who can help build these systems. Historically this would have required candidates with a deep understanding of machine learning and AI engineering, but in the new world of agentic coding and high-performance generalised reasoning models, things are clearly a little different.


They build solutions using a combination of APIs, self-hosted models, agentic frameworks and agentic builders integrated into other technology solutions. They use third party products and integrations where useful, but they also design and build their own bespoke systems either when the problem requires or when it makes sense commercially. They generally build their backend systems in Python, although increasingly leverage agentic coding tools so that they are less in the weeds of coding itself, and more building at the system level.


Core to all of this is being able to navigate complex but often poorly defined and open-ended questions effectively. They are looking for candidates who can build solutions quickly and efficiently whilst ensuring these systems are well designed and extensible, who can balance speed with engineering quality and ensure they avoid overengineering solutions too early whilst then productionising and scaling solutions effectively when proven, who can work closely with clients and end users to understand problems whilst iterating towards desired outcomes, and who remain curious and motivated across a rapidly evolving technology and business landscape.


They expect candidates to be comparatively stronger across different areas depending on background and experience, and they are happy to consider candidates from a diverse range of backgrounds from both academia and industry. This includes machine learning and AI engineers, software developers who are looking to focus more on AI, product designers and architects who are looking to move into more technical delivery, and technical researchers (physics, mathematics, computer science etc.) who want to move into more applied development and delivery.


They are also open to different levels of experience and seniority, which is reflected in the relatively wide salary bracket. Most important is experience and interest in building these systems in some form, some level of technical understanding and experience, and curiosity and motivation to continue to learn how to build effective AI and agentic systems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Working directly with the Head of AI & Data to design, develop, deploy and scale AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems, both for clients and internally.
  • Collaborate with service designers, engineers and business analysts to identify and frame AI use cases.
  • Build rapid proof-of-concepts (PoC) and prototype AI systems to demonstrate possible solutions, test technical feasibility, gain feedback on design and gauge overall usefulness.
  • Work with engineering teams to productionise and scale AI and agentic systems within wider products and platforms.
  • Iterate and improve AI and agentic systems already deployed within client organisations and internally to improve performance, quality, robustness, resilience, cost etc. and to further extend features.
  • Build solutions using agentic coding tools, with a strong eye on system design and quality.
  • Advise on AI strategy, adoption and scaling for clients.
  • Contribute to internal R&D, tooling, thought leadership and the company’s AI proposition.
  • Support bids and client engagements where AI capability is a key differentiator.
  • Help maintain awareness of and critically analyse the evolving AI landscape, both at a model / product level and more at a business / strategic level.


Essential Skills and Experience


  • Demonstrable experience building systems that incorporate AI and/or agentic AI, whether that’s in industry, academic or personal projects.
  • Some technical knowledge and experience, either more foundational (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science etc.) or applied (programming, software development etc.).
  • Experience and proficiency developing in Python, including wider system design principles.
  • Some experience developing with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex etc.).
  • Strong system-design judgement: structuring systems so you retain a clear understanding of how they work, even when you didn't hand-write every line, and a sense of how to test and prove them.


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).

title: Trainee Data Analyst
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

If you are detail orientated, perceptive, organised, competent, analytical and can communicate well with those around you; you could have a truly rewarding future as a Data Analyst

We do this using our specialised Data Analyst career programme which looks to assist and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Analysis.

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for Data Analysts has grown 20% year on year with experienced analysts easily commanding salaries of £50k+. All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

We have been helping candidates start and build careers in the project management industry since 2007 and have a 4.8 Trustscore on Trustpilot.

Our Recruitment Support team will help you work through job applications, interviews and provide you with a full cv review based around your new qualification and written to maximise your chances of obtaining a role in the project management sector.

They will provide you with guidance as to which roles our most suitable for you as an entry level project sector worker aiming to become a project manager. This will include mock job interviews as well as any help you feel you need.

Our money back guarantee

Why AI?

AI is reshaping every industry you can think of. Healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing – they’re all scrambling for skilled professionals.

The demand far outstrips supply, which means excellent salaries, flexible working arrangements, and genuine job security.


How It Works

Step 1 – AI Engineering Fundamentals

Start with the basics of AI, including neural networks and large language models, to build a solid foundation in AI engineering.

Step 2 – Data Fundamentals

Understand the data workflow, from collection to cleaning, and learn how to prepare data for AI applications.

Step 3 – Notebooks & IDEs

Get hands-on with industry-standard tools like Jupyter Notebooks and VS Code to develop AI systems.

Step 4 – Python Programming

Master Python, covering everything from the basics to object-oriented programming (OOP).

Step 5 – Python Streamlit Project

Apply your Python skills by building a car price prediction app using Python and Streamlit.

Step 6 – Python for Data

Learn essential Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for data manipulation and visualisation.

Step 7 – AI Sentiment Analysis Project

Work with Hugging Face to build a sentiment analysis classifier using real-world AI techniques.

Step 8 – AI Prompt Engineering

Master prompt engineering, learning how to craft effective prompts for controlling AI outputs.

Step 9 – Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Learn how to integrate external knowledge into AI systems using RAG techniques and vector databases.

Step 10 – AI Specialised Customer Service Chatbot Project

Combine prompt engineering and RAG to build an AI-powered customer service chatbot, delivering intelligent responses using vector databases and knowledge bases.

Step 11 – Machine Learning Fundamentals

Understand machine learning principles and algorithms, and how to train and test models using scikit-learn.

Step 12 – Machine Learning Project

Put your machine learning knowledge into practice with a hands-on project.

Step 13 – AI & Data Ethics

Study the ethical considerations in AI, including issues of bias, fairness, and data privacy.

Step 14 – Oral Exam

Complete a virtual oral exam to assess your understanding and ability to apply your learning.

Step 15 – AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Finish with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course and exam to gain essential cloud computing knowledge.

Our job programmes include certified tutors, UK-accredited qualifications, and one-on-one support from a recruitment adviser focused on placing you.

We don't believe in empty promises. Complete our programme, follow the process, and if you don't land a job, you get your money back.

title: Data Analyst
description:
DATA ANALYST

London (Hybrid, 2 days per week) | £45,000 - £47,000 + Benefits

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Data Analyst to join a well-known consumer-focused organisation with a large and engaged customer base. You'll work with rich customer and digital datasets, helping stakeholders better understand audience behaviour, engagement, retention, and performance.

The Company

They are a recognised organisation with millions of customer interactions across digital and in-person channels. Data plays a central role in decision-making, with the analytics team partnering closely with marketing, membership, digital, and commercial teams to deliver actionable insights. The environment offers a strong mix of strategic analysis, stakeholder engagement, and hands-on technical work.

The Role

  • Deliver ad hoc analysis and deep-dives using SQL to answer key business questions.
  • Explore customer behaviour, segmentation, retention, loyalty, and engagement trends.
  • Build and enhance reporting solutions in Power BI and Excel.
  • Create dashboards and performance reporting for a range of business stakeholders.
  • Analyse customer journeys across digital and offline touchpoints.
  • Work with web analytics data to support digital performance measurement.
  • Present insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support testing and optimisation initiatives across CRM and customer engagement programmes.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in customer analytics, audience insight, or marketing analytics.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analysing large customer datasets.
  • Experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Exposure to digital analytics tools such as GA4.
  • Ability to translate analysis into clear and actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with retention, loyalty, customer value, or audience insight projects.

What They Offer

  • Salary of £45,000 to £47,000.
  • Hybrid working with two days per week in the London office.
  • Excellent benefits package.
  • The chance to work with diverse customer, membership, digital, and behavioural datasets.
  • Genuine opportunities to influence decision-making across the organisation and develop your analytics expertise.

How to Apply

If you have the right skillset and are interested for this role, please feel free to apply below.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Are you looking to benefit from a new career in Data Analysis?

Please note this career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience, so please do not apply if you are already an experience Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

All business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and therefore the role of the data analyst in the new digital world has become essential for business owners.

Below are current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Analysts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Data Analyst - £67,500
  • Data Analytics Analyst - £80,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Analysis.

The courses in the package have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the UK/European and International Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Whether you are working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks. Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps listed below.

Step 1 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification is achieved by completing a 1-hour multiple choice exam.

The course is provided online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will be provided with access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to sitting your exam.

This qualification will set you on a route to becoming a data analyst.

Step 2 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

Therefore, we will provide you with access to the following additional courses to ensure you are suitably employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approximately 30-60 hours and qualification is achieved through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

Adding a Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you much more employable and enable you to cross over into business analyst roles and hybrid roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS (The British Computer Society also known as the Chartered Institute of IT).

Study time for this course is approximately 15 hours and qualification is achieved through an online BCS exam.

Step 4 - Recruitment Support

Now you are qualified for an entry level data analyst position our recruitment support team will now begin collaborating with you to help you secure your first a suitable role based on your new qualifications and any other experience you may have.

title: Data & AI Product Owner
description:
DATA & AI PRODUCT OWNER

London (Hybrid, 3 days per week) | Up to £80,000 + Bonus + Benefits

A fantastic opportunity to join a global professional services organisation investing heavily in Data, AI and digital transformation. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of data and AI products, owning initiatives from discovery through to delivery while working alongside senior stakeholders, data scientists and engineering teams.

The Company

They are a leading international organisation undertaking a significant investment in data and AI capabilities. With a growing specialist team and strong executive sponsorship, they are developing innovative products that support business performance, operational efficiency and decision-making. This is an opportunity to join at an exciting stage and help shape the direction of a newly established Data & AI Product function.

The Role
  • Own Data and AI products throughout the product lifecycle, from idea through to launch and adoption
  • Gather and refine requirements from business stakeholders
  • Define product vision, use cases and priorities
  • Manage and maintain product backlogs
  • Work closely with Data Scientists, Engineers and technical teams during delivery
  • Balance competing stakeholder demands and drive informed prioritisation decisions
  • Shape product roadmaps and influence longer-term strategy
  • Support the successful deployment and adoption of new products across the business
Your Skills & Experience
  • Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager
  • Strong experience delivering products from discovery through to launch
  • Proven stakeholder management and requirements gathering skills
  • Experience owning and prioritising product backlogs
  • Exposure to Data, Analytics or AI products
  • Comfortable working alongside Data Science and Engineering teams
  • Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services or other complex business environments is advantageous
  • Understanding of modern data platforms and AI use cases is beneficial
What They Offer
  • Salary up to £80,000
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Clear progression opportunities within a growing Data & AI function
  • Exposure to innovative AI and data initiatives with organisation-wide impact
How to Apply

If you're a Product Owner looking to take ownership of impactful Data and AI products within a highly visible transformation programme, please apply below to learn more.
